verses.ar:
بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
الفَاتِحَةُ لَنَا وَلَكُمْ يَا حَاضِرِينْ
verses.tr: Bismillāhi-r-Raḥmāni-r-Raḥīm · Al-Fātiḥatu lanā wa-lakum yā ḥāḍirīn
verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. Recite the Fatiha — for us and for you, O those present.

verses.ar: وَلِوَالِدِينَا وَوَالِدِيكُمْ، وَلِأَهَالِينَا وَلِأَوْلَادِنَا
verses.tr: Wa li-wālidīnā wa-wālidīkum, wa li-ahālīnā wa li-awlādinā
verses.en: And for our parents and yours, for our families and our children.

verses.ar: وَلِمَشَايِخِنَا وَلِمَنْ حَضَرَنَا وَلِمَنْ غَابَ عَنَّا
verses.tr: Wa li-mashāyikhinā wa liman ḥaḍaranā wa liman ghāba ʿannā
verses.en: And for our shaykhs, for those here with us, and for those absent.

verses.ar: وَلِأَحْيَائِنَا وَلِأَمْوَاتِنَا وَلِلْمُوَاظِبِينَ عَلٰى هٰذَا الْمَجْلِسِ وَلِمَنْ كَانَ سَبَبًا فِي جَمْعِنَا
verses.tr: Wa li-aḥyā'inā wa li-amwātinā wa li-l-muwāẓibīna ʿalā hādhā-l-majlis wa liman kāna sababan fī jamʿinā
verses.en: For our living and our departed, for those constant in attending this gathering, and for whoever was a cause of our coming together.

verses.ar: بِأَنَّ اللّٰهَ الْكَرِيمَ يُنَوِّرُ الْقُلُوبْ، وَيَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبْ، وَيَسْتُرُ الْعُيُوبْ، وَيَحْفَظُنَا بِمَا حَفِظَ بِهِ الذِّكْرْ، وَيَنْصُرُنَا بِمَا نَصَرَ بِهِ الرُّسُلْ
verses.tr: Bi-anna-Llāha-l-karīma yunawwiru-l-qulūb, wa yaghfiru-dh-dhunūb, wa yasturu-l-ʿuyūb, wa yaḥfaẓunā bimā ḥafiẓa bihi-dh-dhikr, wa yanṣurunā bimā naṣara bihi-r-rusul
verses.en: That Allah the Generous illuminate the hearts, forgive the sins, veil the faults, guard us as He guarded His Remembrance, and grant us the victory He granted His messengers.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّ اللّٰهَ الْكَرِيمَ يَجْعَلُ مَجْلِسَنَا هٰذَا مُحَاطًا بِالْخَيْرَاتِ وَالْمَسَرَّاتِ وَالْأَنْوَارِ وَالْبَرَكَاتْ، وَيَقْضِي لَنَا جَمِيعَ الْحَاجَاتْ، بِجَاهِ خَيْرِ الْبَرِيَّاتْ
verses.tr: Wa anna-Llāha-l-karīma yajʿalu majlisanā hādhā muḥāṭan bi-l-khayrāti wa-l-masarrāti wa-l-anwāri wa-l-barakāt, wa yaqḍī lanā jamīʿa-l-ḥājāt, bi-jāhi khayri-l-bariyyāt
verses.en: And that Allah the Generous surround this gathering of ours with goodness, joy, lights and blessings, and fulfill all our needs — for the sake of the best of creation.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَنْصُرُ الْمُسْلِمِينْ
verses.tr: Wa anna-Llāha yanṣuru-l-muslimīn
verses.en: And that Allah give victory to the Muslims.

verses.ar: وَعَلٰى نِيَّةِ أَنَّ اللّٰهَ الْكَرِيمَ يَنْصُرُ سُلْطَانَ الْأَوْلِيَاءْ، الشَّيْخ مُحَمَّد نَاظِم عَادِل الْحَقَّانِي، وَيَحْفَظُهُ وَيُوَفِّقُهُ عَلٰى الدَّوَامِ بِجَاهِ خَيْرِ الْأَنَامْ
verses.tr: Wa ʿalā niyyati anna-Llāha-l-karīma yanṣuru sulṭāna-l-awliyā', ash-Shaykh Muḥammad Nāẓim ʿĀdil al-Ḥaqqānī, wa yaḥfaẓuhu wa yuwaffiquhu ʿalā-d-dawām bi-jāhi khayri-l-anām
verses.en: And with the intention that Allah the Generous support the Sultan of Saints, Shaykh Muhammad Nazim Adil al-Haqqani, and preserve him and grant him success always, for the sake of the best of mankind.

verses.ar: وَعَلٰى كُلِّ نِيَّةٍ صَالِحَةٍ مَعْ حُسْنِ الْخَاتِمَةِ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ بَعْدَ الْعُمْرِ الْمَدِيدِ فِي طَاعَةِ اللّٰهِ، وَإِلَى حَضْرَةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ ۞ الْفَاتِحَةْ
verses.tr: Wa ʿalā kulli niyyatin ṣāliḥatin maʿ ḥusni-l-khātimah ʿinda-l-mawt baʿda-l-ʿumri-l-madīd fī ṭāʿati-Llāh, wa ilā ḥaḍrati-n-Nabiyy ﷺ · al-Fātiḥah
verses.en: And upon every righteous intention, with the best of endings at death after a long life spent in obedience to Allah — and offered to the presence of the Prophet ﷺ: al-Fatiha.

verses.ar:
أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
verses.tr: Aʿūdhu billāhi mina-sh-shayṭāni-r-rajīm · Bismillāhi-r-Raḥmāni-r-Raḥīm
verses.en: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan. In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.

verses.ar: إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا
verses.tr: Innā fataḥnā laka fatḥan mubīnā
verses.en: Truly We have granted you a clear victory. (48:1)

verses.ar: لِيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللّٰهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَاطًا مُسْتَقِيمًا
verses.tr: Li-yaghfira laka-Llāhu mā taqaddama min dhanbika wa mā ta'akhkhara wa yutimma niʿmatahu ʿalayka wa yahdiyaka ṣirāṭan mustaqīmā
verses.en: So that Allah may forgive you what came before and what is to come, complete His favor upon you, and guide you on a straight path. (48:2)

verses.ar: وَيَنْصُرَكَ اللّٰهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا
verses.tr: Wa yanṣuraka-Llāhu naṣran ʿazīzā
verses.en: And that Allah may aid you with a mighty victory. (48:3)

verses.ar: لَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ
verses.tr: Laqad jā'akum rasūlun min anfusikum ʿazīzun ʿalayhi mā ʿanittum ḥarīṣun ʿalaykum bi-l-mu'minīna ra'ūfun raḥīm
verses.en: There has come to you a Messenger from among yourselves; your suffering weighs heavily upon him; he is deeply concerned for you, and to the believers he is kind and merciful. (9:128)

verses.ar: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللّٰهُ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
verses.tr: Fa-in tawallaw fa-qul ḥasbiya-Llāhu lā ilāha illā Huwa ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbu-l-ʿarshi-l-ʿaẓīm
verses.en: But if they turn away, say: Allah is enough for me; there is no god but Him; in Him I place my trust, and He is the Lord of the Tremendous Throne. (9:129)

verses.ar: إِنَّ اللّٰهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلٰى النَّبِيِّ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا
verses.tr: Inna-Llāha wa malā'ikatahu yuṣallūna ʿalā-n-Nabiyy, yā ayyuhā-lladhīna āmanū ṣallū ʿalayhi wa sallimū taslīmā
verses.en: Truly Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who believe, send blessings upon him and greet him abundantly with peace. (33:56)

verses.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينْ. اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَجْمَعِينْ. جَعَلَنَا اللّٰهُ وَإِيَّاكُمْ مِمَّنْ يَسْتَوْجِبُ شَفَاعَتَهْ، وَيَرْجُو مِنَ اللّٰهِ رَحْمَتَهُ وَرَأْفَتَهْ
verses.tr: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi Rabbi-l-ʿālamīn. Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi ajmaʿīn. Jaʿalana-Llāhu wa iyyākum mimman yastawjibu shafāʿatah, wa yarjū mina-Llāhi raḥmatahu wa ra'fatah
verses.en: All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, bless him and grant him peace, and his family and all his companions. May Allah make us and you among those who merit his intercession and who hope for Allah's mercy and tenderness.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ بِحُرْمَةِ هٰذَا النَّبِيِّ الْكَرِيمْ، وَآلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ التَّابِعِينَ عَلٰى مَنْهَجِهِ الْقَوِيمْ، اجْعَلْنَا مِنْ خِيَارِ أُمَّتِهْ، وَاسْتُرْنَا بِذَيْلِ حُرْمَتِهْ، وَاحْشُرْنَا غَدًا فِي زُمْرَتِهْ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْ أَلْسِنَتَنَا فِي مَدْحِهِ وَنُصْرَتِهْ، وَأَحْيِنَا مُتَمَسِّكِينَ بِسُنَّتِهْ وَطَاعَتِهْ، وَأَمِتْنَا اللّٰهُمَّ عَلٰى حُبِّهِ وَجَمَاعَتِهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma bi-ḥurmati hādhā-n-nabiyyi-l-karīm, wa ālihi wa aṣḥābihi-t-tābiʿīna ʿalā manhajihi-l-qawīm, ijʿalnā min khiyāri ummatih, wa-sturnā bi-dhayli ḥurmatih, wa-ḥshurnā ghadan fī zumratih, wa-staʿmil alsinatanā fī madḥihi wa nuṣratih, wa aḥyinā mutamassikīna bi-sunnatih wa ṭāʿatih, wa amitnā-Llāhumma ʿalā ḥubbihi wa jamāʿatih
verses.en: O Allah, by the sanctity of this noble Prophet and of his family and companions who kept to his upright way: place us among the best of his community, shelter us under the hem of his sanctity, gather us tomorrow in his company, employ our tongues in praising and defending him, keep us alive holding fast to his Sunnah and obedience, and let us die, O Allah, upon love of him and of his community.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ ادْخِلْنَا مَعَهُ الْجَنَّةَ فَإِنَّهُ أَوَّلُ مَنْ يَدْخُلُهَا، وَأَنْزِلْنَا مَعَهُ فِي قُصُورِهَا فَإِنَّهُ أَوَّلُ مَنْ يَنْزِلُهَا، وَارْحَمْنَا يَوْمَ يَشْفَعُ لِلْخَلَائِقِ فَتَرْحَمُهَا
verses.tr: Allāhumma adkhilnā maʿahu-l-jannata fa-innahu awwalu man yadkhuluhā, wa anzilnā maʿahu fī quṣūrihā fa-innahu awwalu man yanziluhā, wa-rḥamnā yawma yashfaʿu li-l-khalā'iqi fa-tarḥamuhā
verses.en: O Allah, bring us into the Garden with him, for he is the first to enter it; settle us with him in its palaces, for he is the first to dwell in them; and have mercy on us on the day he intercedes for creation and You show it mercy.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا زِيَارَتَهُ فِي كُلِّ سَنَةْ، وَلَا تَجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ عَنْكَ وَلَا عَنْهُ قَدْرَ سَنَةْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma-rzuqnā ziyāratahu fī kulli sanah, wa lā tajʿalnā mina-l-ghāfilīna ʿanka wa lā ʿanhu qadra sanah
verses.en: O Allah, grant us his visit every year, and do not let us be heedless of You or of him for even the span of a year.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْ فِي مَجْلِسِنَا هٰذَا أَحَدًا إِلَّا غَسَلْتَ بِمَاءِ التَّوْبَةِ ذُنُوبَهْ، وَسَتَرْتَ بِرِدَاءِ الْمَغْفِرَةِ عُيُوبَهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma lā tajʿal fī majlisinā hādhā aḥadan illā ghasalta bi-mā'i-t-tawbati dhunūbah, wa satarta bi-ridā'i-l-maghfirati ʿuyūbah
verses.en: O Allah, leave no one in this gathering of ours except that You wash their sins with the water of repentance and cover their faults with the cloak of forgiveness.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مَعَنَا فِي السَّنَةِ الْمَاضِيَةِ إِخْوَانٌ مَنَعَهُمُ الْقَضَاءُ عَنِ الْوُصُولِ إِلَى مِثْلِهَا، فَلَا تَحْرِمْهُمْ ثَوَابَ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَفَضْلَهَا ۞ رَحِمَهُمُ اللّٰه
verses.tr: Allāhumma innahu kāna maʿanā fī-s-sanati-l-māḍiyati ikhwānun manaʿahumu-l-qaḍā'u ʿani-l-wuṣūli ilā mithlihā, fa-lā taḥrimhum thawāba hādhihi-l-laylati wa faḍlahā · raḥimahumu-Llāh
verses.en: O Allah, brothers and sisters were with us last year whom Your decree kept from reaching another like it — do not deprive them of the reward and merit of this night. May Allah have mercy on them.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ ارْحَمْنَا إِذَا صِرْنَا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْقُبُورْ، وَوَفِّقْنَا لِعَمَلٍ صَالِحٍ يَبْقَى سَنَاهُ عَلٰى مَمَرِّ الدُّهُورْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma-rḥamnā idhā ṣirnā min aṣḥābi-l-qubūr, wa waffiqnā li-ʿamalin ṣāliḥin yabqā sanāhu ʿalā mamarri-d-duhūr
verses.en: O Allah, have mercy on us when we become people of the graves, and grant us righteous deeds whose radiance endures through the passing of ages.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنَا لِآلَائِكَ ذَاكِرِينْ، وَلِنَعْمَائِكَ شَاكِرِينْ، وَلِيَوْمِ لِقَائِكَ مِنَ الذَّاكِرِينْ، أَحْيِنَا بِطَاعَتِكَ مَشْغُولِينْ، وَإِذَا تَوَفَّيْتَنَا فَتَوَفَّنَا غَيْرَ مَفْتُونِينَ وَلَا مَخْذُولِينْ، وَاخْتِمْ لَنَا مِنْكَ بِخَيْرٍ أَجْمَعِينْ ۞ اللّٰهُمَّ اكْفِنَا شَرَّ الظَّالِمِينْ (٣x)
verses.tr: Allāhumma-jʿalnā li-ālā'ika dhākirīn, wa li-naʿmā'ika shākirīn, wa li-yawmi liqā'ika mina-dh-dhākirīn, aḥyinā bi-ṭāʿatika mashghūlīn, wa idhā tawaffaytanā fa-tawaffanā ghayra maftūnīna wa lā makhdhūlīn, wa-khtim lanā minka bi-khayrin ajmaʿīn · Allāhumma-kfinā sharra-ẓ-ẓālimīn (3x)
verses.en: O Allah, make us mindful of Your bounties, thankful for Your blessings, and remembering the Day we meet You. Keep us alive occupied in Your obedience, and when You take us, take us untried by temptation and unforsaken, and seal all our affairs with good from You. O Allah, protect us from the evil of the oppressors (3x).

verses.ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ فِتْنَةِ هٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا سَالِمِينْ
verses.tr: Wa-jʿalnā min fitnati hādhihi-d-dunyā sālimīn
verses.en: And keep us safe from the trials of this world.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ هٰذَا النَّبِيَّ الْكَرِيمَ لَنَا شَفِيعًا، وَارْزُقْنَا بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَقَامًا رَفِيعًا
verses.tr: Allāhumma-jʿal hādhā-n-nabiyya-l-karīma lanā shafīʿā, wa-rzuqnā bihi yawma-l-qiyāmati maqāman rafīʿā
verses.en: O Allah, make this noble Prophet our intercessor, and through him grant us an exalted station on the Day of Rising.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اسْقِنَا مِنْ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَرْبَةً هَنِيئَةً مَرِيئَةً لَا نَظْمَأُ بَعْدَهَا أَبَدًا، وَاحْشُرْنَا تَحْتَ لِوَائِهِ غَدًا
verses.tr: Allāhumma-sqinā min ḥawḍi nabiyyika Muḥammadin ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallama sharbatan hanī'atan marī'atan lā naẓma'u baʿdahā abadā, wa-ḥshurnā taḥta liwā'ihi ghadā
verses.en: O Allah, give us to drink from the Pool of Your Prophet Muhammad ﷺ a wholesome, satisfying drink after which we never thirst again, and gather us beneath his banner tomorrow.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَنَا بِهِ وَلِآبَائِنَا وَلِأُمَّهَاتِنَا، وَلِمَشَايِخِنَا وَذَوِي الْحُقُوقِ عَلَيْنَا، وَلِمَنْ أَجْرَى هٰذَا الْخَيْرَ فِي هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةْ، وَلِجَمِيعِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتْ، وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتْ، الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma-ghfir lanā bihi wa li-ābā'inā wa li-ummahātinā, wa li-mashāyikhinā wa dhawī-l-ḥuqūqi ʿalaynā, wa liman ajrā hādhā-l-khayra fī hādhihi-l-laylah, wa li-jamīʿi-l-mu'minīna wa-l-mu'mināt, wa-l-muslimīna wa-l-muslimāt, al-aḥyā'i minhum wa-l-amwāt
verses.en: O Allah, through him forgive us, our fathers and our mothers, our shaykhs and all who hold rights over us, whoever brought about this goodness tonight, and all believing and Muslim men and women, the living among them and the departed.

verses.ar: إِنَّكَ قَرِيبٌ مُجِيبُ الدَّعَوَاتْ ۞ وَقَاضِيَ الْحَاجَاتْ (٣x) ۞ وَغَافِرَ الذُّنُوبِ وَالْخَطِيئَاتْ ۞ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينْ (٣x)
verses.tr: Innaka qarībun mujību-d-daʿawāt · wa qāḍiya-l-ḥājāt (3x) · wa ghāfira-dh-dhunūbi wa-l-khaṭī'āt · yā arḥama-r-rāḥimīn (3x)
verses.en: Truly You are Near, the Answerer of supplications, the Fulfiller of needs (3x), the Forgiver of sins and faults — O Most Merciful of the merciful (3x).

verses.ar: وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمْ. سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ، وَسَلَامٌ عَلٰى الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۞ الْفَاتِحَةْ
verses.tr: Wa ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi wa sallam. Subḥāna Rabbika Rabbi-l-ʿizzati ʿammā yaṣifūn, wa salāmun ʿalā-l-mursalīn, wa-l-ḥamdu lillāhi Rabbi-l-ʿālamīn · al-Fātiḥah
verses.en: And may Allah bless our master Muhammad and his family and companions, and grant them peace. Glorified is your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they describe; peace be upon the messengers; and all praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. Al-Fatiha.

QASIDAS.titleEnglish: 2 · The Opening Qasida — Yā Rabbi Ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalayhi wa-sallim
verses.en: O my Lord, send blessings upon Muhammad; O my Lord, bless him and grant him peace.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ بَلِّغْهُ الْوَسِيلَةْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi ballighhu-l-wasīlah
verses.en: O my Lord, grant him the Wasilah, the highest station of intercession.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ خُصَّهُ بِالْفَضِيلَةْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi khuṣṣahu bi-l-faḍīlah
verses.en: O my Lord, single him out with the loftiest eminence.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَارْضَ عَنِ الصَّحَابَةْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-rḍa ʿani-ṣ-ṣaḥābah
verses.en: O my Lord, be pleased with the Companions.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَارْضَ عَنِ السُّلَالَةْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-rḍa ʿani-s-sulālah
verses.en: O my Lord, be pleased with his descendants.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَارْضَ عَنِ الْمَشَايِخْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-rḍa ʿani-l-mashāyikh
verses.en: O my Lord, be pleased with the shaykhs.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ فَارْحَمْ وَالِدِينَا
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi fa-rḥam wālidīnā
verses.en: O my Lord, have mercy on our parents.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَارْحَمْنَا جَمِيعًا
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-rḥamnā jamīʿā
verses.en: O my Lord, have mercy on us all.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَارْحَمْ كُلَّ مُسْلِمْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-rḥam kulla muslim
verses.en: O my Lord, have mercy on every Muslim.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَاغْفِرْ لِكُلِّ مُذْنِبْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-ghfir li-kulli mudhnib
verses.en: O my Lord, forgive every sinner.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ يَا سَامِعْ دُعَانَا
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi yā sāmiʿ duʿānā
verses.en: O my Lord, O Hearer of our supplication.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ لَا تَقْطَعْ رَجَانَا
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi lā taqṭaʿ rajānā
verses.en: O my Lord, do not cut off our hope.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ بَلِّغْنَا نَزُورُهْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi ballighnā nazūruh
verses.en: O my Lord, bring us to visit him.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ تَغْشَانَا بِنُورِهْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi taghshānā bi-nūrih
verses.en: O my Lord, envelop us in his light.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ حِفْظَانَكْ وَأَمَانَكْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi ḥifẓānak wa-amānak
verses.en: O my Lord, grant us Your protection and Your safety.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَاسْكِنَّا جِنَانَكْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-skinnā jinānak
verses.en: O my Lord, settle us in Your gardens of Paradise.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ أَجِرْنَا مِنْ عَذَابِكْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi ajirnā min ʿadhābik
verses.en: O my Lord, deliver us from Your punishment.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَارْزُقْنَا الشَّهَادَةْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-rzuqnā-sh-shahādah
verses.en: O my Lord, grant us the rank of the martyrs.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ حِطْنَا بِالسَّعَادَةْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi ḥiṭnā bi-s-saʿādah
verses.en: O my Lord, surround us with felicity.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَاصْلِحْ كُلَّ مُصْلِحْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-ṣliḥ kulla muṣliḥ
verses.en: O my Lord, set right everyone who seeks to set things right.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَاكْفِ كُلَّ مُؤْذِي
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-kfi kulla mu'dhī
verses.en: O my Lord, shield us from every harmful one.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ نَخْتِمْ بِالْمُشَفَّعْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi nakhtim bi-l-mushaffaʿ
verses.en: O my Lord, we close with the one granted intercession.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalayhi wa-sallim
verses.en: O my Lord, bless him and grant him peace.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālih
verses.en: O Allah, bless him and his family, grant them peace, and pour blessings upon them.

QASIDAS.titleEnglish: 7 · The Caravaner's Qasida — Ṣalātullāhi mā lāḥat kawākib

verses.ar: صَلَاةُ اللّٰهِ مَا لَاحَتْ كَوَاكِبْ ۞ عَلٰى أَحْمَدْ خَيْرِ مَنْ رَكِبَ النَّجَائِبْ
verses.tr: Ṣalātullāhi mā lāḥat kawākib · ʿalā Aḥmad khayri man rakiba-n-najā'ib
verses.en: Allah's blessings, for as long as stars shine, upon Ahmad, the best who ever rode the noble camels.

verses.ar: حَدَى حَادِي السُّرَى بِاسْمِ الْحَبَائِبْ ۞ فَهَزَّ السُّكْرُ أَعْطَافَ الرَّكَائِبْ
verses.tr: Ḥadā ḥādī-s-surā bi-smi-l-ḥabā'ib · fa-hazza-s-sukru aʿṭāfa-r-rakā'ib
verses.en: The night caravaner sang the names of the beloved ones, and rapture swayed the flanks of the mounts.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَهَا وَقَدْ مَدَّتْ خُطَاهَا ۞ وَسَالَتْ مِنْ مَدَامِعِهَا سَحَائِبْ
verses.tr: Alam tarahā wa qad maddat khuṭāhā · wa sālat min madāmiʿihā saḥā'ib
verses.en: Did you not see how the camels lengthened their strides, while clouds of tears streamed from their eyes?

verses.ar: وَمَالَتْ لِلْحِمَى طَرَبًا وَحَنَّتْ ۞ إِلَى تِلْكَ الْمَعَالِمِ وَالْمَلَاعِبْ
verses.tr: Wa mālat li-l-ḥimā ṭaraban wa ḥannat · ilā tilka-l-maʿālimi wa-l-malāʿib
verses.en: They leaned toward the sanctuary in joy, yearning for those landmarks and beloved grounds.

verses.ar: فَدَعْ جَذْبَ الزِّمَامِ وَلَا تَسُقْهَا ۞ فَقَائِدُ شَوْقِهَا لِلْحَيِّ جَاذِبْ
verses.tr: Fa-daʿ jadhba-z-zimāmi wa lā tasuqhā · fa-qā'idu shawqihā li-l-ḥayyi jādhib
verses.en: So let go of the reins and do not drive them — the pull of their longing already draws them to the dwelling.

verses.ar: فَهِمْ طَرَبًا كَمَا هَامَتْ وَإِلَّا ۞ فَإِنَّكَ فِي طَرِيقِ الْحُبِّ كَاذِبْ
verses.tr: Fa-him ṭaraban kamā hāmat wa illā · fa-innaka fī ṭarīqi-l-ḥubbi kādhib
verses.en: Be swept with rapture as they are — or else you are no true traveler on the path of love.

verses.ar: أَمَا هٰذَا الْعَقِيقُ بَدَا وَهَذِي ۞ قِبَابُ الْحَيِّ لَاحَتْ وَالْمَضَارِبْ
verses.tr: Amā hādhā-l-ʿaqīqu badā wa hādhī · qibābu-l-ḥayyi lāḥat wa-l-maḍārib
verses.en: Look — the valley of al-Aqiq has appeared, and there the domes of the quarter and its tents come into view.

verses.ar: وَتِلْكَ الْقُبَّةُ الْخَضْرَا وَفِيهَا ۞ نَبِيٌّ نُورُهُ يَجْلُو الْغَيَاهِبْ
verses.tr: Wa tilka-l-qubbatu-l-khaḍrā wa fīhā · nabiyyun nūruhu yajlū-l-ghayāhib
verses.en: And that is the Green Dome — within it rests a Prophet whose light dispels every darkness.

verses.ar: وَقَدْ صَحَّ الرِّضَى وَدَنَا التَّلَاقِي ۞ وَقَدْ جَاءَ الْهَنَا مِنْ كُلِّ جَانِبْ
verses.tr: Wa qad ṣaḥḥa-r-riḍā wa danā-t-talāqī · wa qad jā'a-l-hanā min kulli jānib
verses.en: Acceptance is assured and the meeting draws near; happiness has arrived from every side.

verses.ar: فَقُلْ لِلنَّفْسِ دُونَكِ وَالتَّمَلِّي ۞ فَمَا دُونَ الْحَبِيبِ الْيَوْمَ حَاجِبْ
verses.tr: Fa-qul li-n-nafsi dūnaki wa-t-tamallī · fa-mā dūna-l-ḥabībi-l-yawma ḥājib
verses.en: So tell the soul: take your fill of gazing — today no veil stands before the Beloved.

verses.ar: تَمَلِّي بِالْحَبِيبِ بِكُلِّ قَصْدٍ ۞ فَقَدْ حَصَلَ الْهَنَا وَالضِّدُّ غَائِبْ
verses.tr: Tamallī bi-l-ḥabībi bi-kulli qaṣdin · fa-qad ḥaṣala-l-hanā wa-ḍ-ḍiddu ghā'ib
verses.en: Delight fully in the Beloved with every intent — joy has been attained and all that opposes it is gone.

verses.ar: نَبِيُّ اللّٰهِ خَيْرُ الْخَلْقِ جَمْعًا ۞ لَهُ أَعْلَى الْمَنَاصِبِ وَالْمَرَاتِبْ
verses.tr: Nabiyyullāhi khayru-l-khalqi jamʿā · lahu aʿlā-l-manāṣibi wa-l-marātib
verses.en: The Prophet of Allah is the best of all creation; his are the highest offices and ranks.

verses.ar: لَهُ الْجَاهُ الرَّفِيعُ لَهُ الْمَعَالِي ۞ لَهُ الشَّرَفُ الْمُؤَبَّدُ وَالْمَنَاقِبْ
verses.tr: Lahu-l-jāhu-r-rafīʿu lahu-l-maʿālī · lahu-sh-sharafu-l-mu'abbadu wa-l-manāqib
verses.en: His is the exalted esteem, his the heights of glory, his the everlasting honor and noble virtues.

verses.ar: فَلَوْ أَنَّا سَعَيْنَا كُلَّ حِينٍ ۞ عَلٰى الْأَحْدَاقِ لَا فَوْقَ النَّجَائِبْ
verses.tr: Fa-law annā saʿaynā kulla ḥīnin · ʿalā-l-aḥdāqi lā fawqa-n-najā'ib
verses.en: Were we to journey to him at every moment upon our very eyes rather than on camels —

verses.ar: وَلَوْ أَنَّا عَمِلْنَا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ ۞ لِأَحْمَدَ مَوْلِدًا قَدْ كَانَ وَاجِبْ
verses.tr: Wa law annā ʿamilnā kulla yawmin · li-Aḥmada mawlidan qad kāna wājib
verses.en: and were we to celebrate a mawlid for Ahmad every single day — it would only be his due.

verses.ar: عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمُهَيْمِنِ كُلَّ وَقْتٍ ۞ صَلَاةٌ مَا بَدَا نُورُ الْكَوَاكِبْ
verses.tr: ʿAlayhi mina-l-Muhaymini kulla waqtin · ṣalātun mā badā nūru-l-kawākib
verses.en: Upon him, from the Guardian, in every moment, be blessings for as long as starlight shines —

verses.ar: تَعُمُّ الْآلَ وَالْأَصْحَابَ طُرًّا ۞ جَمِيعَهُمْ وَعِتْرَتَهُ الْأَطَايِبْ
verses.tr: Taʿummu-l-āla wa-l-aṣḥāba ṭurrā · jamīʿahum wa ʿitratahu-l-aṭāyib
verses.en: embracing all his family and companions together, every one of them, and his pure descendants.

QASIDAS.titleEnglish: 13 · Yā Nabī Salām ʿAlayka — Mawlid version (Ashraqa-l-kawn)

verses.ar:
يَا نَبِي سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ
يَا رَسُولْ سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ
يَا حَبِيبْ سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ
يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰه
صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهْ عَلَيْكَ
verses.tr: Yā Nabī salām ʿalayka · Yā Rasūl salām ʿalayka · Yā Ḥabīb salām ʿalayka · Yā Rasūlallāh · Ṣalawātullāh ʿalayka
verses.en: O Prophet, peace be upon you; O Messenger, peace be upon you; O Beloved, peace be upon you; O Messenger of Allah — the blessings of Allah be upon you.

verses.ar: أَشْرَقَ الْكَوْنُ ابْتِهَاجًا ۞ بِوُجُودِ الْمُصْطَفَى أَحْمَدْ
verses.tr: Ashraqa-l-kawnu-btihājā · bi-wujūdi-l-Muṣṭafā Aḥmad
verses.en: The universe lit up with joy at the coming of the Chosen One, Ahmad.

verses.ar: وَلِأَهْلِ الْكَوْنِ أُنْسٌ ۞ وَسُرُورٌ قَدْ تَجَدَّدْ
verses.tr: Wa li-ahli-l-kawni unsun · wa surūrun qad tajaddad
verses.en: For all who dwell in creation there is intimacy, and a joy made ever new.

verses.ar: فَاطْرَبُوا يَا أَهْلَ الْمَثَانِي ۞ فَهَزَارُ الْيُمْنِ غَرَّدْ
verses.tr: Fa-ṭrabū yā ahla-l-mathānī · fa-hazāru-l-yumni gharrad
verses.en: So rejoice, O people of the oft-repeated verses — the nightingale of blessedness has burst into song.

verses.ar: وَاسْتَضِيئُوا بِجَمَالٍ ۞ فَاقَ فِي الْحُسْنِ تَفَرَّدْ
verses.tr: Wa-staḍī'ū bi-jamālin · fāqa fī-l-ḥusni tafarrad
verses.en: And seek light from a beauty that surpasses all — unique and unrivaled in loveliness.

verses.ar: وَلَنَا الْبُشْرَى بِسَعْدٍ ۞ مُسْتَمِرٍّ لَيْسَ يَنْفَدْ
verses.tr: Wa lanā-l-bushrā bi-saʿdin · mustamirrin laysa yanfad
verses.en: Ours is the glad tiding of a happiness that continues and never runs out.

verses.ar: حَيْثُ أُوتِينَا عَطَاءً ۞ جَمَعَ الْفَخْرَ الْمُؤَبَّدْ
verses.tr: Ḥaythu ūtīnā ʿaṭā'an · jamaʿa-l-fakhra-l-mu'abbad
verses.en: For we were given a gift that gathered everlasting glory within it.

verses.ar: فَلِرَبِّي كُلُّ حَمْدٍ ۞ جَلَّ أَنْ يَحْصُرَهُ الْعَدْ
verses.tr: Fa-li-Rabbī kullu ḥamdin · jalla an yaḥṣurahu-l-ʿadd
verses.en: So to my Lord belongs all praise — too majestic for numbers to contain.

verses.ar: إِذْ حَبَانَا بِوُجُودِ ۞ الْمُصْطَفَى الْهَادِي مُحَمَّدْ
verses.tr: Idh ḥabānā bi-wujūdi · l-Muṣṭafā-l-hādī Muḥammad
verses.en: For He graced us with the presence of the Chosen One, the Guide — Muhammad.

QASIDAS.titleEnglish: Yā Nabī Salām ʿAlayka — Anta Shamsun version

verses.ar:
يَا نَبِي سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ
يَا رَسُولْ سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ
يَا حَبِيبْ سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ
يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰه
صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهْ عَلَيْكَ
verses.tr: Yā Nabī salām ʿalayka · Yā Rasūl salām ʿalayka · Yā Ḥabīb salām ʿalayka · Yā Rasūlallāh · Ṣalawātullāh ʿalayka
verses.en: O Prophet, peace be upon you; O Messenger, peace be upon you; O Beloved, peace be upon you; O Messenger of Allah — the blessings of Allah be upon you.

verses.ar:
أَنْتَ شَمْسٌ أَنْتَ بَدْرٌ
أَنْتَ نُورٌ فَوْقَ نُورِ
أَنْتَ إِكْسِيرٌ وَغَالِي
يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰه
أَنْتَ مِصْبَاحُ الصُّدُورِ
verses.tr: Anta shamsun anta badrun · Anta nūrun fawqa nūri · Anta iksīrun wa-ghālī · Yā Rasūlallāh · Anta miṣbāḥu-ṣ-ṣudūri
verses.en: You are a sun, you are a full moon; you are light upon light; you are the precious quintessence, O Messenger of Allah; you are the lamp within every chest.

verses.ar:
يَا حَبِيبِي يَا مُحَمَّد
يَا عَرُوسَ الْخَافِقَيْنِ
يَا مُؤَيَّد يَا مُمَجَّد
يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰه
يَا إِمَامَ الْقِبْلَتَيْنِ
verses.tr: Yā ḥabībī yā Muḥammad · Yā ʿarūsa-l-khāfiqayni · Yā mu'ayyad yā mumajjad · Yā Rasūlallāh · Yā imāma-l-qiblatayni
verses.en: O my beloved, O Muhammad ﷺ; O bridegroom of the East and the West; O you whom Allah supported and exalted; O Messenger of Allah; O Imam of the two directions of prayer.

verses.ar:
يَا اَللّٰهُ يَا مُحَمَّد
يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيق
يَا عُمَرْ عُثْمَانْ يَا عَلِي
يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰه
فَاطِمَة بِنْتِ الرَّسُولِ
verses.tr: Yā Allāhu yā Muḥammad · Yā Abā Bakrini-ṣ-Ṣiddīq · Yā ʿUmar ʿUthmān yā ʿAlī · Yā Rasūlallāh · Fāṭima binti-r-Rasūli
verses.en: O Allah, O Muhammad ﷺ; O Abu Bakr the ever-truthful; O Umar, Uthman, O Ali; O Messenger of Allah; O Fatima, daughter of the Messenger.

verses.ar: مَرْحَبًا مَرْحَبًا يَا نُورَ عَيْنِي ۞ مَرْحَبًا مَرْحَبًا جَدَّ الْحُسَيْنِ
verses.tr: Marḥaban marḥaban yā nūra ʿaynī · Marḥaban marḥaban jadda-l-Ḥusayni
verses.en: Welcome, welcome, O light of my eyes! Welcome, welcome, grandfather of al-Husayn!

verses.ar: مَرْحَبًا يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰهِ أَهْلًا ۞ مَرْحَبًا بِكَ إِنَّا بِكَ نُسْعَدْ
verses.tr: Marḥaban yā Rasūlallāhi ahlan · Marḥaban bika innā bika nusʿad
verses.en: Welcome, O Messenger of Allah, and greetings! Welcome to you — through you we are made happy.

verses.ar: مَرْحَبًا.. وَبِجَاهِهْ يَا إِلَهِي ۞ مَرْحَبًا.. جُدْ وَبَلِّغْ كُلَّ مَقْصَدْ
verses.tr: Marḥaban.. wa bi-jāhih yā ilāhī · Marḥaban.. jud wa balligh kulla maqṣad
verses.en: Welcome! For the sake of his high rank, O my God — welcome! — give generously and bring every aim to fulfillment.

verses.ar: مَرْحَبًا.. وَاهْدِنَا نَهْجَ سَبِيلِهْ ۞ مَرْحَبًا.. كَيْ بِهِ نُسْعَدْ وَنُرْشَدْ
verses.tr: Marḥaban.. wa-hdinā nahja sabīlih · Marḥaban.. kay bihi nusʿad wa nurshad
verses.en: Welcome! Guide us along the way of his path — welcome! — that through him we may find happiness and right guidance.

verses.ar: رَبِّ فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي يَا اللّٰه ۞ بِبَرْكَةِ الْهَادِي مُحَمَّدْ يَا اللّٰه
verses.tr: Rabbi fa-ghfir lī dhunūbī yā Allāh · Bi-barakati-l-hādī Muḥammad yā Allāh
verses.en: My Lord, forgive me my sins, O Allah — by the blessing of the Guide, Muhammad, O Allah.

verses.ar: رَبِّ بَلِّغْنَا بِجَاهِهْ يَا اللّٰه ۞ فِي جِوَارِهْ خَيْرَ مَقْعَدْ يَا اللّٰه
verses.tr: Rabbi ballighnā bi-jāhih yā Allāh · Fī jiwārih khayra maqʿad yā Allāh
verses.en: My Lord, for the sake of his rank bring us, O Allah, to the best of seats in his nearness, O Allah.

verses.ar: وَصَلَاةُ اللّٰهِ تَغْشَى يَا اللّٰه ۞ أَشْرَفَ الرُّسْلِ مُحَمَّدْ يَا اللّٰه
verses.tr: Wa ṣalātullāhi taghshā yā Allāh · Ashrafa-r-rusli Muḥammad yā Allāh
verses.en: And may the blessings of Allah envelop, O Allah, the noblest of messengers, Muhammad, O Allah.

verses.ar: وَسَلَامٌ مُسْتَمِرٌّ يَا اللّٰه ۞ كُلَّ حِينٍ يَتَجَدَّدْ يَا اللّٰه
verses.tr: Wa salāmun mustamirrun yā Allāh · Kulla ḥīnin yatajaddad yā Allāh
verses.en: And peace unending, O Allah, renewed at every moment, O Allah.

verses.ar:
طَلَعَ الْبَدْرُ عَلَيْنَا ۞ مِنْ ثَنِيَّاتِ الْوَدَاعْ
وَجَبَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَيْنَا ۞ مَا دَعَا لِلّٰهِ دَاعْ
verses.tr: Ṭalaʿa-l-badru ʿalaynā · min thaniyyāti-l-wadāʿ · Wajaba-sh-shukru ʿalaynā · mā daʿā lillāhi dāʿ
verses.en: The full moon has risen over us from the valley of Wada — gratitude is due from us for as long as any caller calls to Allah.

verses.ar: أَيُّهَا الْمَبْعُوثُ فِينَا ۞ جِئْتَ بِالْأَمْرِ الْمُطَاعْ
verses.tr: Ayyuhā-l-mabʿūthu fīnā · ji'ta bi-l-amri-l-muṭāʿ
verses.en: O you who were sent among us, you came with a command to be obeyed.

verses.ar: كُنْ شَفِيعًا يَا حَبِيبِي ۞ يَوْمَ حَشْرٍ وَاجْتِمَاعْ
verses.tr: Kun shafīʿan yā ḥabībī · yawma ḥashrin wa-jtimāʿ
verses.en: Be our intercessor, O my beloved, on the day of gathering and assembly.

verses.ar: رَبَّنَا صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ ۞ حَلَّ فِي خَيْرِ الْبِقَاعْ
verses.tr: Rabbanā ṣalli ʿalā man · ḥalla fī khayri-l-biqāʿ
verses.en: Our Lord, send blessings upon the one who came to dwell in the best of lands.

verses.ar: أَنْتَ غَوْثُنَا جَمِيعًا ۞ يَا مُجَمَّلَ الطِّبَاعْ
verses.tr: Anta ghawthunā jamīʿā · yā mujammala-ṭ-ṭibāʿ
verses.en: You are the refuge of us all, O you of perfected character.

verses.ar: وَلَبِسْنَا ثَوْبَ عِزٍّ ۞ بَعْدَ تَلْفِيقِ الرِّقَاعْ
verses.tr: Wa labisnā thawba ʿizzin · baʿda talfīqi-r-riqāʿ
verses.en: Through you we put on the robe of honor after wearing stitched-together rags.

verses.ar: أَسْبِلِ السِّتْرَ عَلَيْنَا ۞ يَا مُجِيبًا كُلَّ دَاعْ
verses.tr: Asbili-s-sitra ʿalaynā · yā mujīban kulla dāʿ
verses.en: Let the veil of covering fall over our faults, O Answerer of every caller.

verses.ar: وَصَلَاةُ اللّٰهِ عَلٰى أَحْمَدْ ۞ عَدَّ تَحْرِيرِ الرِّقَاعْ
verses.tr: Wa ṣalātullāhi ʿalā Aḥmad · ʿadda taḥrīri-r-riqāʿ
verses.en: And Allah's blessings upon Ahmad, as many as all the pages ever penned.

verses.ar: وَكَذَا آلٍ وَصَحْبٍ ۞ مَا سَعَى لِلّٰهِ سَاعْ
verses.tr: Wa kadhā ālin wa ṣaḥbin · mā saʿā lillāhi sāʿ
verses.en: And likewise upon his family and companions, for as long as any striver strives for Allah.

verses.ar:
طَالَمَا أَشْكُو غَرَامِي ۞ يَا نُورَ الْوُجُودْ
وَأُنَادِي يَا تِهَامِي ۞ يَا مَعْدِنَ الْجُودْ
verses.tr: Ṭālamā ashkū gharāmī · yā nūra-l-wujūd · Wa unādī yā Tihāmī · yā maʿdina-l-jūd
verses.en: How long I have poured out my love-longing, O Light of existence, calling out: O Tihami, O wellspring of generosity!

verses.ar: مُنْيَتِي أَقْصَى مَرَامِي ۞ أَحْظَى بِالشُّهُودْ
verses.tr: Munyatī aqṣā marāmī · aḥẓā bi-sh-shuhūd
verses.en: My wish, the utmost of my aims: to be granted the vision of beholding you.

verses.ar: وَأَرَى بَابَ السَّلَامِ ۞ يَا زَاكِي الْجُدُودْ
verses.tr: Wa arā bāba-s-salāmi · yā zākī-l-judūd
verses.en: And to see the Gate of Peace, O you of the purest ancestors.

verses.ar: يَا طِرَازَ الْكَوْنِ إِنِّي ۞ عَاشِقٌ مُسْتَهَامْ
verses.tr: Yā ṭirāza-l-kawni innī · ʿāshiqun mustahām
verses.en: O adornment of the universe, truly I am a lover lost in longing.

verses.ar: مُغْرَمٌ وَالْمَدْحُ فَنِّي ۞ يَا بَدْرَ التَّمَامْ
verses.tr: Mughramun wa-l-madḥu fannī · yā badra-t-tamām
verses.en: Enraptured — and praising you is my art, O full moon of perfection.

verses.ar: اِصْرِفِ الْإِعْرَاضَ عَنِّي ۞ أَضْنَانِي الْغَرَامْ
verses.tr: Iṣrifi-l-iʿrāḍa ʿannī · aḍnānī-l-gharām
verses.en: Turn all turning-away from me — this love has worn me thin.

verses.ar: فِيكَ قَدْ أَحْسَنْتُ ظَنِّي ۞ يَا سَامِي الْعُهُودْ
verses.tr: Fīka qad aḥsantu ẓannī · yā sāmī-l-ʿuhūd
verses.en: In you I have placed my best expectation, O keeper of the loftiest covenants.

verses.ar: يَا سِرَاجَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ ۞ يَا عَالِي الْجَنَابْ
verses.tr: Yā sirāja-l-anbiyā'i · yā ʿālī-l-janāb
verses.en: O lamp of the prophets, O possessor of the most exalted presence.

verses.ar: يَا إِمَامَ الْأَتْقِيَاءِ ۞ إِنَّ قَلْبِي ذَابْ
verses.tr: Yā imāma-l-atqiyā'i · inna qalbī dhāb
verses.en: O leader of the God-fearing — truly my heart has melted.

verses.ar: وَعَلَيْكَ اللّٰهُ صَلَّى ۞ رَبِّي ذُو الْجَلَالْ
verses.tr: Wa ʿalayka-Llāhu ṣallā · Rabbī dhū-l-jalāl
verses.en: And upon you Allah sends blessings — my Lord, the Possessor of Majesty.

verses.ar: يَكْفِي يَا نُورَ الْأَهِلَّةْ ۞ إِنَّ هَجْرِي طَالْ
verses.tr: Yakfī yā nūra-l-ahillah · inna hajrī ṭāl
verses.en: Enough, O light of the crescent moons — my separation has lasted too long.

verses.ar: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمْ (٢x)
verses.tr: Ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalā Muḥammad · Ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam (2x)
verses.en: Allah's blessings be upon Muhammad; Allah bless him and grant him peace.

verses.ar: رَبِّ وَاجْعَلْ مُجْتَمَعْنَا ۞ غَايَتُهُ حُسْنُ الْخِتَامِ
verses.tr: Rabbi wa-jʿal mujtamaʿnā · ghāyatuhu ḥusnu-l-khitāmi
verses.en: My Lord, make the goal of our gathering the best of endings.

verses.ar: وَاعْطِنَا مَا قَدْ سَأَلْنَا ۞ مِنْ عَطَايَاكَ الْجِسَامِ
verses.tr: Wa-ʿṭinā mā qad sa'alnā · min ʿaṭāyāka-l-jisāmi
verses.en: And grant us what we have asked of Your immense gifts.

verses.ar: وَاكْرِمِ الْأَرْوَاحَ مِنَّا ۞ بِلِقَا خَيْرِ الْأَنَامِ
verses.tr: Wa-krimi-l-arwāḥa minnā · bi-liqā khayri-l-anāmi
verses.en: Honor our souls with the meeting of the best of created beings.

verses.ar: وَابْلِغِ الْمُخْتَارَ عَنَّا ۞ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَسَلَامِ
verses.tr: Wa-blighi-l-mukhtāra ʿannā · min ṣalātin wa salāmi
verses.en: And convey to the Chosen One, from us, blessings and greetings of peace.

verses.ar: يَا اللّٰهُ يَا مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ يَا صِدِّيقْ
verses.tr: Yā Allāhu yā Muḥammad · Yā Abā Bakrin yā Ṣiddīq
verses.en: O Allah, O Muhammad ﷺ; O Abu Bakr, O ever-truthful one.

verses.ar: يَا عُمَرْ عُثْمَانْ يَا عَلِي ۞ فَاطِمَةْ بِنْتَ الرَّسُولِ
verses.tr: Yā ʿUmar ʿUthmān yā ʿAlī · Fāṭimah binta-r-Rasūli
verses.en: O Umar, Uthman, O Ali; O Fatima, daughter of the Messenger.

verses.ar:
يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينْ (٣x)
يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينْ ۞ فَرِّجْ عَلٰى الْمُسْلِمِينْ
verses.tr: Yā arḥama-r-rāḥimīn (3x) · Yā arḥama-r-rāḥimīn · farrij ʿalā-l-muslimīn
verses.en: O Most Merciful of the merciful (3x) — O Most Merciful of the merciful, bring relief to the Muslims.

verses.ar: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا كَرِيمْ ۞ يَا رَبَّنَا يَا رَحِيمْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbanā yā Karīm · yā Rabbanā yā Raḥīm
verses.en: O our Lord, O Generous One; O our Lord, O Merciful One.

verses.ar: أَنْتَ الْجَوَادُ الْحَلِيمْ ۞ وَأَنْتَ نِعْمَ الْمُعِينْ
verses.tr: Anta-l-Jawādu-l-Ḥalīm · wa anta niʿma-l-muʿīn
verses.en: You are the Bestower, the Forbearing — and You are the best of helpers.

verses.ar: وَمَا لَنَا رَبَّنَا ۞ سِوَاكَ يَا حَسْبُنَا
verses.tr: Wa mā lanā Rabbanā · siwāka yā ḥasbunā
verses.en: We have none, our Lord, besides You — O our Sufficiency.

verses.ar: يَا ذَا الْعُلَا وَالْغِنَى ۞ وَيَا قَوِيُّ يَا مَتِينْ
verses.tr: Yā dhā-l-ʿulā wa-l-ghinā · wa yā Qawiyyu yā Matīn
verses.en: O Possessor of highness and all-sufficiency, O Strong One, O Firm One.

verses.ar: وَلَيْسَ نَرْجُو سِوَاكْ ۞ فَأَدْرِكْ إِلَهِي دَرَاكْ
verses.tr: Wa laysa narjū siwāk · fa-adrik ilāhī darāk
verses.en: We hope in none but You — so reach us, my God, with swift rescue,

verses.ar: قَبْلَ الْفَنَا وَالْهَلَاكْ ۞ يَعُمُّ دُنْيَا وَدِينْ
verses.tr: Qabla-l-fanā wa-l-halāk · yaʿummu dunyā wa dīn
verses.en: before ruin and destruction engulf both worldly life and religion.

verses.ar: بِجَاهِ طٰهٰ الرَّسُولْ ۞ جُدْ رَبَّنَا بِالْقَبُولْ
verses.tr: Bi-jāhi Ṭāhā-r-Rasūl · jud Rabbanā bi-l-qabūl
verses.en: For the sake of Taha the Messenger, grant us, our Lord, Your acceptance.

verses.ar: وَهَبْ لَنَا كُلَّ سُولْ ۞ رَبِّ اسْتَجِبْ لِي آمِينْ
verses.tr: Wa hab lanā kulla sūl · Rabbi-stajib lī āmīn
verses.en: Bestow on us all that we ask — my Lord, answer me. Amin.

verses.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِي كُلَّ الذُّنُوبْ ۞ وَاسْتُرْ لِي كُلَّ الْعُيُوبْ
verses.tr: Wa-ghfir lī kulla-dh-dhunūb · wa-stur lī kulla-l-ʿuyūb
verses.en: Forgive me all my sins, and cover all my faults.

verses.ar: وَاكْشِفْ لِي كُلَّ الْكُرُوبْ ۞ وَاكْفِ أَذَى الْمُؤْذِينْ
verses.tr: Wa-kshif lī kulla-l-kurūb · wa-kfi adhā-l-mu'dhīn
verses.en: Lift from me every distress, and shield me from the harm of those who harm.

verses.ar: وَاخْتِمْ بِأَحْسَنْ خِتَامْ ۞ إِذَا دَنَا الْاِنْصِرَامْ
verses.tr: Wa-khtim bi-aḥsan khitām · idhā danā-l-inṣirām
verses.en: And seal my life with the best of endings when the departure draws near,

verses.ar: وَحَانَ حَيْنُ الْحِمَامْ ۞ وَزَادَ رَشْحُ الْجَبِينْ
verses.tr: Wa ḥāna ḥaynu-l-ḥimām · wa zāda rashḥu-l-jabīn
verses.en: when the appointed hour arrives and the brow beads with sweat.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامْ ۞ عَلٰى شَفِيعِ الْأَنَامْ
verses.tr: Thumma-ṣ-ṣalātu wa-s-salām · ʿalā shafīʿi-l-anām
verses.en: Then blessings and peace upon the intercessor of humankind,

verses.ar: وَالْآلِ نِعْمَ الْكِرَامْ ۞ وَالصَّحْبِ وَالتَّابِعِينْ
verses.tr: Wa-l-āli niʿma-l-kirām · wa-ṣ-ṣaḥbi wa-t-tābiʿīn
verses.en: and upon his family — the finest of nobles — his companions, and those who followed them.

verses.ar: يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰهِ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكْ ۞ يَا رَفِيعَ الشَّانِ وَالدَّرَجِ
verses.tr: Yā Rasūlallāhi salāmun ʿalayk · yā rafīʿa-sh-shāni wa-d-daraji
verses.en: O Messenger of Allah, peace be upon you — O possessor of the loftiest station and rank.

verses.ar: عَطْفَةً يَا جِيرَةَ الْعَلَمِ ۞ يَا أُهَيْلَ الْجُودِ وَالْكَرَمِ
verses.tr: ʿAṭfatan yā jīrata-l-ʿalami · yā uhayla-l-jūdi wa-l-karami
verses.en: A glance of kindness, O neighbors of the landmark, O people of giving and generosity.

verses.ar: نَحْنُ جِيرَانٌ بِذَا الْحَرَمِ ۞ حَرَمُ الْإِحْسَانِ وَالْحَسَنِ
verses.tr: Naḥnu jīrānun bi-dhā-l-ḥarami · ḥaramu-l-iḥsāni wa-l-ḥasani
verses.en: We are neighbors of this sanctuary — the sanctuary of excellence and beauty.

verses.ar: نَحْنُ مِنْ قَوْمٍ بِهِ سَكَنُوا ۞ وَبِهِ مِنْ خَوْفِهِمْ أَمِنُوا
verses.tr: Naḥnu min qawmin bihi sakanū · wa bihi min khawfihim aminū
verses.en: We are of a people who found rest in him, and through him were made safe from their fears,

verses.ar: وَبِآيَاتِ الْقُرْآنِ عُنُوا ۞ فَاتَّئِدْ فِينَا أَخَا الْوَهَنِ
verses.tr: Wa bi-āyāti-l-Qur'āni ʿunū · fa-tta'id fīnā akhā-l-wahani
verses.en: a people devoted to the verses of the Quran — so tread gently with us, O faint of heart.

verses.ar: نَعْرِفُ الْبَطْحَا وَتَعْرِفُنَا ۞ وَالصَّفَا وَالْبَيْتُ يَأْلَفُنَا
verses.tr: Naʿrifu-l-baṭḥā wa taʿrifunā · wa-ṣ-Ṣafā wa-l-Baytu ya'lafunā
verses.en: We know the valley of Batha and it knows us; Safa and the Sacred House are familiar with us.

verses.ar: وَلَنَا الْمَعْلَى وَخَيْفُ مِنَى ۞ فَاعْلَمَنْ هٰذَا وَكُنْ رَكِنِ
verses.tr: Wa lanā-l-Maʿlā wa Khayfu Minā · fa-ʿlaman hādhā wa kun rakini
verses.en: Ours are al-Ma'la and the Khayf of Mina — know this well, and rest assured.

verses.ar: وَلَنَا خَيْرُ الْأَنَامِ أَبٌ ۞ وَعَلِيُّ الْمُرْتَضَى حَسَبُ
verses.tr: Wa lanā khayru-l-anāmi abun · wa ʿAliyyu-l-Murtaḍā ḥasabu
verses.en: The best of creation is our father, and Ali al-Murtada is our noble lineage.

verses.ar: وَإِلَى السِّبْطَيْنِ نَنْتَسِبُ ۞ نَسَبًا مَا فِيهِ مِنْ دَخَنِ
verses.tr: Wa ilā-s-sibṭayni nantasibu · nasaban mā fīhi min dakhani
verses.en: To the two grandsons we trace our descent — a lineage without any blemish.

verses.ar: كَمْ إِمَامٍ بَعْدَهُ خَلَفُوا ۞ مِنْهُ سَادَاتٌ بِذَا عُرِفُوا
verses.tr: Kam imāmin baʿdahu khalafū · minhu sādātun bi-dhā ʿurifū
verses.en: How many imams succeeded after him — masters descended from him, known for exactly this.

verses.ar: وَبِهٰذَا الْوَصْفِ قَدْ وُصِفُوا ۞ مِنْ قَدِيمِ الدَّهْرِ وَالزَّمَنِ
verses.tr: Wa bi-hādhā-l-waṣfi qad wuṣifū · min qadīmi-d-dahri wa-z-zamani
verses.en: By this description they have been described since the earliest of eras and times:

verses.ar: مِثْلُ زَيْنِ الْعَابِدِينَ عَلِي ۞ وَابْنِهِ الْبَاقِرِ خَيْرِ وَلِي
verses.tr: Mithlu Zayni-l-ʿĀbidīna ʿAlī · wa-bnihi-l-Bāqiri khayri walī
verses.en: such as Ali Zayn al-Abidin, and his son al-Baqir, the best of saints,

verses.ar: وَالْإِمَامِ الصَّادِقِ الْحَفِلِ ۞ وَعَلِيٍّ ذِي الْعُلَا الْيَقِنِ
verses.tr: Wa-l-Imāmi-ṣ-Ṣādiqi-l-ḥafili · wa ʿAliyyin dhī-l-ʿulā-l-yaqini
verses.en: and the celebrated Imam as-Sadiq, and Ali of lofty rank and certainty.

verses.ar: فَهُمُ الْقَوْمُ الَّذِينَ هُدُوا ۞ وَبِفَضْلِ اللّٰهِ قَدْ سُعِدُوا
verses.tr: Fa-humu-l-qawmu-lladhīna hudū · wa bi-faḍli-Llāhi qad suʿidū
verses.en: They are the people who were guided, and by Allah's grace were made felicitous.

verses.ar: وَلِغَيْرِ اللّٰهِ مَا قَصَدُوا ۞ وَمَعَ الْقُرْآنِ فِي قَرَنِ
verses.tr: Wa li-ghayri-Llāhi mā qaṣadū · wa maʿa-l-Qur'āni fī qarani
verses.en: They aimed at none but Allah, and were joined with the Quran as inseparable companions.

verses.ar: أَهْلُ بَيْتِ الْمُصْطَفَى الطُّهُرِ ۞ هُمْ أَمَانُ الْأَرْضِ فَادَّكِرِ
verses.tr: Ahlu bayti-l-Muṣṭafā-ṭ-ṭuhuri · hum amānu-l-arḍi fa-ddakiri
verses.en: The pure Household of the Chosen One — they are the earth's safeguard, so take heed.

verses.ar: شُبِّهُوا بِالْأَنْجُمِ الزُّهُرِ ۞ مِثْلَمَا قَدْ جَاءَ فِي السُّنَنِ
verses.tr: Shubbihū bi-l-anjumi-z-zuhuri · mithlamā qad jā'a fī-s-sunani
verses.en: They were likened to radiant stars, just as it has come down in the traditions,

verses.ar: وَسَفِينٌ لِلنَّجَاةِ إِذَا ۞ خِفْتَ مِنْ طُوفَانِ كُلِّ أَذَى
verses.tr: Wa safīnun li-n-najāti idhā · khifta min ṭūfāni kulli adhā
verses.en: and to a ship of salvation when you fear the flood of every harm —

verses.ar: فَانْجُ فِيهَا لَا تَكُونُ كَذَا ۞ وَاعْتَصِمْ بِاللّٰهِ وَاسْتَعِنِ
verses.tr: Fa-nju fīhā lā takūnu kadhā · wa-ʿtaṣim billāhi wa-staʿini
verses.en: so board it and be saved, do not stand aside; hold fast to Allah and seek His help.

verses.ar: رَبِّ فَانْفَعْنَا بِبَرْكَتِهِمْ ۞ وَاهْدِنَا الْحُسْنَى بِحُرْمَتِهِمْ
verses.tr: Rabbi fa-nfaʿnā bi-barakatihim · wa-hdinā-l-ḥusnā bi-ḥurmatihim
verses.en: My Lord, benefit us through their blessing, and guide us to goodness by their sanctity,

verses.ar: وَأَمِتْنَا فِي طَرِيقَتِهِمْ ۞ وَمُعَافَاةٍ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ
verses.tr: Wa amitnā fī ṭarīqatihim · wa muʿāfātin mina-l-fitani
verses.en: and let us die upon their path, safe and sound from all trials.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ بِالْمُصْطَفَى بَلِّغْ مَقَاصِدَنَا ۞ وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا مَا مَضَى يَا وَاسِعَ الْكَرَمِ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi bi-l-Muṣṭafā balligh maqāṣidanā · wa-ghfir lanā mā maḍā yā wāsiʿa-l-karami
verses.en: O my Lord, by the Chosen One bring us to our goals, and forgive us what has passed, O Vast in generosity.

verses.ar: يَا أَكْرَمَ الْخَلْقِ مَا لِي مَنْ أَلُوذُ بِهِ ۞ سِوَاكَ عِنْدَ حُلُولِ الْحَادِثِ الْعَمَمِ
verses.tr: Yā akrama-l-khalqi mā lī man alūdhu bihi · siwāka ʿinda ḥulūli-l-ḥādithi-l-ʿamami
verses.en: O most generous of creation, I have no one to shelter with but you when the all-encompassing calamity descends.

verses.ar: وَلَنْ يَضِيقَ رَسُولَ اللّٰهِ جَاهُكَ بِي ۞ إِذَا الْكَرِيمُ تَجَلَّى بِاسْمِ مُنْتَقِمِ
verses.tr: Wa lan yaḍīqa Rasūlallāhi jāhuka bī · idhā-l-Karīmu tajallā bi-smi muntaqimi
verses.en: Your standing, O Messenger of Allah, will not fall short of me when the Generous One manifests with the name of the Avenger.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّ مِنْ جُودِكَ الدُّنْيَا وَضَرَّتَهَا ۞ وَمِنْ عُلُومِكَ عِلْمَ اللَّوْحِ وَالْقَلَمِ
verses.tr: Fa-inna min jūdika-d-dunyā wa ḍarratahā · wa min ʿulūmika ʿilma-l-lawḥi wa-l-qalami
verses.en: For of your bounty is this world and the next, and of your knowledge is knowledge of the Tablet and the Pen.

verses.ar: يَا نَفْسُ لَا تَقْنَطِي مِنْ زَلَّةٍ عَظُمَتْ ۞ إِنَّ الْكَبَائِرَ فِي الْغُفْرَانِ كَاللَّمَمِ
verses.tr: Yā nafsu lā taqnaṭī min zallatin ʿaẓumat · inna-l-kabā'ira fī-l-ghufrāni ka-l-lamami
verses.en: O soul, do not despair over an enormous slip — before forgiveness, the gravest sins are as small ones.

verses.ar: لَعَلَّ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّي حِينَ يَقْسِمُهَا ۞ تَأْتِي عَلٰى حَسَبِ الْعِصْيَانِ فِي الْقِسَمِ
verses.tr: Laʿalla raḥmata Rabbī ḥīna yaqsimuhā · ta'tī ʿalā ḥasabi-l-ʿiṣyāni fī-l-qisami
verses.en: Perhaps my Lord's mercy, when He apportions it, will arrive in measure with the extent of one's sins.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ وَاجْعَلْ رَجَائِي غَيْرَ مُنْعَكِسٍ ۞ لَدَيْكَ وَاجْعَلْ حِسَابِي غَيْرَ مُنْخَرِمِ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi wa-jʿal rajā'ī ghayra munʿakisin · ladayka wa-jʿal ḥisābī ghayra munkharimi
verses.en: O my Lord, let not my hope in You be overturned, and let not my account be found wanting.

verses.ar: وَالْطُفْ بِعَبْدِكَ فِي الدَّارَيْنِ إِنَّ لَهُ ۞ صَبْرًا مَتَى تَدْعُهُ الْأَهْوَالُ يَنْهَزِمِ
verses.tr: Wa-lṭuf bi-ʿabdika fī-d-dārayni inna lahu · ṣabran matā tadʿuhu-l-ahwālu yanhazimi
verses.en: Be gentle with Your servant in both abodes, for his patience flees whenever terrors summon it.

verses.ar: وَائْذَنْ لِسُحْبِ صَلَاةٍ مِنْكَ دَائِمَةٍ ۞ عَلٰى النَّبِيِّ بِمُنْهَلٍّ وَمُنْسَجِمِ
verses.tr: Wa'dhan li-suḥbi ṣalātin minka dā'imatin · ʿalā-n-Nabiyyi bi-munhallin wa munsajimi
verses.en: And bid clouds of Your blessings to pour perpetually upon the Prophet, in downpour and in steady stream,

verses.ar: وَالْآلِ وَالصَّحْبِ ثُمَّ التَّابِعِينَ فَهُمْ ۞ أَهْلُ التُّقَى وَالنَّقَى وَالْحِلْمِ وَالْكَرَمِ
verses.tr: Wa-l-āli wa-ṣ-ṣaḥbi thumma-t-tābiʿīna fa-hum · ahlu-t-tuqā wa-n-naqā wa-l-ḥilmi wa-l-karami
verses.en: and upon the family, the companions, then the followers — for they are the people of piety, purity, forbearance and generosity.

verses.ar:
قُلْ يَا عَظِيمْ أَنْتَ الْعَظِيمْ ۞ قَدْ هَمَّنَا هَمٌّ عَظِيمْ
وَكُلُّ هَمٍّ هَمَّنَا ۞ يَهُونُ بِاسْمِكَ يَا عَظِيمْ
verses.tr: Qul yā ʿAẓīm anta-l-ʿAẓīm · qad hammanā hammun ʿaẓīm · Wa kullu hammin hammanā · yahūnu bi-smika yā ʿAẓīm
verses.en: Say: O Tremendous One, You are the Tremendous — a tremendous worry has befallen us, yet every worry that troubles us becomes light through Your name, O Tremendous One.

verses.ar:
أَنْتَ الْقَدِيمْ قَدِيمٌ فِي الْأَزَلْ ۞ أَنْتَ اللَّطِيفْ لَطِيفٌ لَمْ تَزَلْ
عَنَّا أَزِلْ مَا قَدْ نَزَلْ ۞ مِنْ فَادِحِ الْخَطْبِ الشَّدِيدْ
verses.tr: Anta-l-Qadīm qadīmun fī-l-azal · anta-l-Laṭīf laṭīfun lam tazal · ʿAnnā azil mā qad nazal · min fādiḥi-l-khaṭbi-sh-shadīd
verses.en: You are the Eternal, eternal from before beginning; You are the Subtle, ever-subtle without cease — remove from us what has descended of crushing, severe affliction.

verses.ar:
حَيٌّ قَدِيمْ قَدِيمٌ وَاجِدُ ۞ بَاقِي غَنِيْ غَنِيٌّ مَاجِدُ
عَدْلٌ إِلَهْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدُ ۞ بَرٌّ رَؤُوفْ رَؤُوفٌ بِالْعَبِيدْ
verses.tr: Ḥayyun Qadīm qadīmun Wājidu · Bāqī Ghanī ghaniyyun Mājidu · ʿAdlun Ilāh ilāhun Wāḥidu · Barrun Ra'ūf ra'ūfun bi-l-ʿabīd
verses.en: Living, Eternal, Eternal and Perceiving; Everlasting, Rich, Rich and Glorious; Just, God, One God alone; Kind, Tender — tender with His servants.

verses.ar:
وَلِلنَّبِيِّ صَلِّ يَا سَلَامْ ۞ مِنَّا صَلَاةً مَعْ سَلَامْ
يَوْمَ الْجَزَا امْنَحْنَا سَلَامْ ۞ مِمَّا نَخَافُ يَا مَجِيدْ
verses.tr: Wa li-n-Nabiyyi ṣalli yā Salām · minnā ṣalātan maʿ salām · Yawma-l-jazā-mnaḥnā salām · mimmā nakhāfu yā Majīd
verses.en: And bless the Prophet, O Source of Peace, with blessings and peace from us — and on the Day of Recompense grant us safety from all we fear, O Glorious One.

QASIDAS.titleArabic: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى النَّبِيِّ مُحَمَّدٍ
QASIDAS.note: Repeat each verse twice before reciting the next one.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى النَّبِيِّ مُحَمَّدٍ ۞ خَيْرِ الْأَنَامِ وَمَنْ بِهِ يُتَشَفَّعُ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā-n-Nabiyyi Muḥammadin · khayri-l-anāmi wa man bihi yutashaffaʿu
verses.en: O my Lord, send blessings upon the Prophet Muhammad, the best of mankind, the one through whom intercession is sought.

verses.ar: يَا مَنْ يَرَى مَا فِي الضَّمِيرِ وَيَسْمَعُ ۞ أَنْتَ الْمُعَدُّ لِكُلِّ مَا يُتَوَقَّعُ
verses.tr: Yā man yarā mā fī-ḍ-ḍamīri wa yasmaʿu · anta-l-muʿaddu li-kulli mā yutawaqqaʿu
verses.en: O You who see and hear what lies in the innermost heart — You are the One prepared for all that may come.

verses.ar: يَا مَنْ يُرَجَّى لِلشَّدَائِدِ كُلِّهَا ۞ يَا مَنْ إِلَيْهِ الْمُشْتَكَى وَالْمَفْزَعُ
verses.tr: Yā man yurajjā li-sh-shadā'idi kullihā · yā man ilayhi-l-mushtakā wa-l-mafzaʿu
verses.en: O You in whom hope is placed in every hardship; O You to whom all complaint and refuge return.

verses.ar: يَا مَنْ خَزَائِنُ مُلْكِهِ فِي قَوْلِ كُنْ ۞ اُمْنُنْ فَإِنَّ الْخَيْرَ عِنْدَكَ أَجْمَعُ
verses.tr: Yā man khazā'inu mulkihi fī qawli kun · umnun fa-inna-l-khayra ʿindaka ajmaʿu
verses.en: O You whose treasuries lie in the word 'Be' — bestow Your grace, for all goodness is gathered with You.

verses.ar: مَا لِي سِوَى فَقْرِي إِلَيْكَ وَسِيلَةٌ ۞ فَبِالِافْتِقَارِ إِلَيْكَ فَقْرِي أَدْفَعُ
verses.tr: Mā lī siwā faqrī ilayka wasīlatun · fa-bi-l-iftiqāri ilayka faqrī adfaʿu
verses.en: I have no means to You except my poverty — by my utter need of You I ward off my need.

verses.ar: مَا لِي سِوَى قَرْعِي لِبَابِكَ حِيلَةٌ ۞ فَلَئِنْ رُدِدْتُ فَأَيُّ بَابٍ أَقْرَعُ
verses.tr: Mā lī siwā qarʿī li-bābika ḥīlatun · fa-la'in rudidtu fa-ayyu bābin aqraʿu
verses.en: I have no recourse but to knock at Your door — and if I am turned away, at what door could I knock?

verses.ar: وَمَنِ الَّذِي أَدْعُو وَأَهْتِفُ بِاسْمِهِ ۞ إِنْ كَانَ فَضْلُكَ عَنْ فَقِيرِكَ يُمْنَعُ
verses.tr: Wa mani-lladhī adʿū wa ahtifu bi-smihi · in kāna faḍluka ʿan faqīrika yumnaʿu
verses.en: And on whom would I call, whose name would I cry out, if Your bounty were withheld from Your poor one?

verses.ar: حَاشَا لِجُودِكَ أَنْ تُقَنِّطَ عَاصِيًا ۞ الْفَضْلُ أَجْزَلُ وَالْمَوَاهِبُ أَوْسَعُ
verses.tr: Ḥāshā li-jūdika an tuqanniṭa ʿāṣiyan · al-faḍlu ajzalu wa-l-mawāhibu awsaʿu
verses.en: Far be it from Your generosity to drive a sinner to despair — Your bounty is too abundant, Your gifts too vast.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ الصَّلَاةُ عَلٰى النَّبِيِّ مُحَمَّدٍ ۞ خَيْرِ الْأَنَامِ وَمَنْ بِهِ يُتَشَفَّعُ
verses.tr: Thumma-ṣ-ṣalātu ʿalā-n-Nabiyyi Muḥammadin · khayri-l-anāmi wa man bihi yutashaffaʿu
verses.en: Then blessings upon the Prophet Muhammad, the best of mankind, the one through whom intercession is sought.

verses.ar:
النَّبِي صَلُّوا عَلَيْه — صَلُّوا عَلَيْه
صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْه — صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْه
وَيَنَالُ الْبَرَكَاتْ — الْبَرَكَاتْ
كُلُّ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْه — صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْه
verses.tr: An-nabī ṣallū ʿalayh — ṣallū ʿalayh · Ṣalawātullāhi ʿalayh — ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayh · Wa yanālu-l-barakāt — al-barakāt · Kullu man ṣallā ʿalayh — ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayh
verses.en: The Prophet — send blessings upon him, send blessings! Allah's blessings upon him — may Allah bless him. And blessings, blessings will be received by everyone who sends blessings upon him — may Allah bless him.

verses.ar:
مَرْحَبًا يَا نُورَ عَيْنِي — مَرْحَبًا
مَرْحَبًا يَا مَرْحَبًا — أَلْفَيْ مَرْحَبًا
مَرْحَبًا جَدَّ الْحُسَيْنِ — مَرْحَبًا
مَرْحَبًا يَا مَرْحَبًا — أَلْفَيْ مَرْحَبًا
verses.tr: Marḥaban yā nūra ʿaynī — marḥabā · Marḥaban yā marḥaban — alfay marḥabā · Marḥaban jadda-l-Ḥusayni — marḥabā · Marḥaban yā marḥaban — alfay marḥabā
verses.en: Welcome, O light of my eyes — welcome! Welcome, O welcome — two thousand welcomes! Welcome, grandfather of al-Husayn — welcome! Welcome, O welcome — two thousand welcomes!

verses.ar:
النَّبِي صَلُّوا عَلَيْه — صَلُّوا عَلَيْه
صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْه — صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْه
وَيَنَالُ الْبَرَكَاتْ — الْبَرَكَاتْ
كُلُّ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْه — صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْه
verses.tr: An-nabī ṣallū ʿalayh — ṣallū ʿalayh · Ṣalawātullāhi ʿalayh — ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayh · Wa yanālu-l-barakāt — al-barakāt · Kullu man ṣallā ʿalayh — ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayh
verses.en: The Prophet — send blessings upon him! Allah's blessings upon him — may Allah bless him. And blessings will be received by everyone who sends blessings upon him.

verses.ar:
النَّبِي يَا مَنْ حَضَرْ — يَا مَنْ حَضَرْ
النَّبِي خَيْرُ الْبَشَرْ — خَيْرُ الْبَشَرْ
مَنْ دَنَا لَهُ الْقَمَرْ — لَهُ الْقَمَرْ
وَالْغَزَالْ سَلَّمْ عَلَيْه — صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْه
verses.tr: An-nabī yā man ḥaḍar — yā man ḥaḍar · An-nabī khayru-l-bashar — khayru-l-bashar · Man danā lahu-l-qamar — lahu-l-qamar · Wa-l-ghazāl sallam ʿalayh — ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayh
verses.en: The Prophet — O those present! The Prophet is the best of humankind, the best of humankind; the one to whom the moon drew near, and the gazelle offered greetings — may Allah bless him.

verses.ar:
النَّبِي ذَاكَ الْعَرُوسْ — ذَاكَ الْعَرُوسْ
ذِكْرُهُ يُحْيِي النُّفُوسْ — يُحْيِي النُّفُوسْ
النَّصَارَى وَالْمَجُوسْ — قُلْ وَالْمَجُوسْ
أَسْلَمُوا عَلٰى يَدَيْه — صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْه
verses.tr: An-nabī dhāka-l-ʿarūs — dhāka-l-ʿarūs · Dhikruhu yuḥyī-n-nufūs — yuḥyī-n-nufūs · An-naṣārā wa-l-majūs — qul wa-l-majūs · Aslamū ʿalā yadayh — ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayh
verses.en: The Prophet is the radiant bridegroom; remembering him brings souls to life. Christians and Zoroastrians alike accepted Islam at his hands — may Allah bless him.

verses.ar:
النَّبِي ذَاكَ الْمَلِيحْ — ذَاكَ الْمَلِيحْ
قَوْلُهُ قَوْلٌ فَصِيحْ — قَوْلٌ فَصِيحْ
وَالْقُرْآنْ شَيْءٌ صَحِيحْ — شَيْءٌ صَحِيحْ
الَّذِي أُنْزِلْ عَلَيْه — صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْه
verses.tr: An-nabī dhāka-l-malīḥ — dhāka-l-malīḥ · Qawluhu qawlun faṣīḥ — qawlun faṣīḥ · Wa-l-Qur'ān shay'un ṣaḥīḥ — shay'un ṣaḥīḥ · Alladhī unzil ʿalayh — ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayh
verses.en: The Prophet, that most beautiful one; his speech is eloquent speech, and the Quran is pure truth — that which was revealed to him. May Allah bless him.

verses.ar:
النَّبِي يَا حَاضِرِينْ — يَا حَاضِرِينْ
اِعْلَمُوا عِلْمَ الْيَقِينْ — عِلْمَ الْيَقِينْ
أَنَّ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينْ — الْعَالَمِينْ
أَفْرَضَ الصَّلَاةَ عَلَيْه — صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْه
verses.tr: An-nabī yā ḥāḍirīn — yā ḥāḍirīn · Iʿlamū ʿilma-l-yaqīn — ʿilma-l-yaqīn · Anna Rabba-l-ʿālamīn — al-ʿālamīn · Afraḍa-ṣ-ṣalāta ʿalayh — ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayh
verses.en: The Prophet — O those present, know with certain knowledge that the Lord of the worlds made sending blessings upon him an obligation. May Allah bless him.

verses.ar:
النَّبِيُّ الْمُجْتَبَى — الْمُجْتَبَى
الَّذِي نَزَلْ قُبَا — نَزَلْ قُبَا
أَظْهَرَ الدِّينَ وَنَبَا — قُلْ وَنَبَا
كُلُّكُمْ صَلُّوا عَلَيْه — صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْه
verses.tr: An-nabiyyu-l-mujtabā — al-mujtabā · Alladhī nazal Qubā — nazal Qubā · Aẓhara-d-dīna wa nabā — qul wa nabā · Kullukum ṣallū ʿalayh — ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayh
verses.en: The Prophet, the elect one, who alighted at Quba; he made the religion manifest and brought the tidings. All of you, send blessings upon him — may Allah bless him.

verses.ar:
النَّبِيُّ الْمُصْطَفَى — الْمُصْطَفَى
اِبْنُ زَمْزَمْ وَالصَّفَا — زَمْزَمْ وَالصَّفَا
مَنْ تَعَالَى شَرَفًا — قُلْ شَرَفًا
كُلُّكُمْ صَلُّوا عَلَيْه — صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْه
verses.tr: An-nabiyyu-l-Muṣṭafā — al-Muṣṭafā · Ibnu Zamzam wa-ṣ-Ṣafā — Zamzam wa-ṣ-Ṣafā · Man taʿālā sharafā — qul sharafā · Kullukum ṣallū ʿalayh — ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayh
verses.en: The Prophet, the Chosen One, son of Zamzam and Safa, whose honor rose above all. All of you, send blessings upon him — may Allah bless him.

verses.ar:
وَامْتَدِحْ زَوْجَ الْبَتُولْ — زَوْجَ الْبَتُولْ
اِبْنُ عَمٍّ لِلرَّسُولْ — قُلْ لِلرَّسُولْ
مَنْ أَحَبَّهُمْ فِي قَبُولْ — قُلْ فِي قَبُولْ
وَالْإِلَهْ يَرْضَى عَلَيْه — صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْه
verses.tr: Wa-mtadiḥ zawja-l-batūl — zawja-l-batūl · Ibnu ʿammin li-r-rasūl — qul li-r-rasūl · Man aḥabbahum fī qabūl — qul fī qabūl · Wa-l-ilāh yarḍā ʿalayh — ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayh
verses.en: And praise the husband of al-Batul (Fatima), the cousin of the Messenger. Whoever loves them is received in acceptance, and God is pleased with him — may Allah bless him.

verses.ar:
الْحَسَنْ ثُمَّ الْحُسَيْنْ — ثُمَّ الْحُسَيْنْ
لِلنَّبِي قُرَّةُ عَيْنْ — قُرَّةُ عَيْنْ
نُورُهُمْ كَالْكَوْكَبَيْنْ — كَالْكَوْكَبَيْنْ
جَدُّهُمْ صَلُّوا عَلَيْه — صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْه
verses.tr: Al-Ḥasan thumma-l-Ḥusayn — thumma-l-Ḥusayn · Li-n-nabī qurratu ʿayn — qurratu ʿayn · Nūruhum ka-l-kawkabayn — ka-l-kawkabayn · Jadduhum ṣallū ʿalayh — ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayh
verses.en: Hasan and then Husayn — the coolness of the Prophet's eyes; their light is like two shining stars. Their grandfather — send blessings upon him! May Allah bless him.

verses.ar:
أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرْ — قُلْ وَعُمَرْ
نُورُهُمْ يَعْلُو الْقَمَرْ — يَعْلُو الْقَمَرْ
مَنْ أَبْغَضَهُمْ فِي سَقَرْ — قُلْ فِي سَقَرْ
وَالْإِلَهْ يَسْخَطْ عَلَيْه — يَسْخَطْ عَلَيْه
verses.tr: Abū Bakrin wa ʿUmar — qul wa ʿUmar · Nūruhum yaʿlū-l-qamar — yaʿlū-l-qamar · Man abghaḍahum fī saqar — qul fī saqar · Wa-l-ilāh yaskhaṭ ʿalayh — yaskhaṭ ʿalayh
verses.en: Abu Bakr and Umar — their light rises above the moon. Whoever hates them ends in the Fire, and God is displeased with him.

verses.ar:
وَتَرَضَّوْا عَنْ ذِي النُّورَيْن — عَنْ ذِي النُّورَيْن
مَنْ تَزَوَّجْ قَمَرَيْن — قُلْ قَمَرَيْن
مَنْ تَرَضَّى فِي خَيْرَيْن — قُلْ فِي خَيْرَيْن
وَالْمَوْلَى يَرْضَى عَلَيْه — يَرْضَى عَلَيْه
verses.tr: Wa taraḍḍaw ʿan dhī-n-nūrayn — ʿan dhī-n-nūrayn · Man tazawwaj qamarayn — qul qamarayn · Man taraḍḍā fī khayrayn — qul fī khayrayn · Wa-l-Mawlā yarḍā ʿalayh — yarḍā ʿalayh
verses.en: And ask Allah's pleasure for the Possessor of the Two Lights, who married two moons — the Prophet's two daughters. Whoever seeks pleasure gains two goods, and the Lord is pleased with him.

verses.ar:
النَّبِي صَلُّوا عَلَيْه — صَلُّوا عَلَيْه
صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْه — صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْه
وَيَنَالُ الْبَرَكَاتْ — الْبَرَكَاتْ
كُلُّ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْه — صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْه
verses.tr: An-nabī ṣallū ʿalayh — ṣallū ʿalayh · Ṣalawātullāhi ʿalayh — ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayh · Wa yanālu-l-barakāt — al-barakāt · Kullu man ṣallā ʿalayh — ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayh
verses.en: The Prophet — send blessings upon him! Allah's blessings upon him — may Allah bless him. And blessings will be received by everyone who sends blessings upon him — may Allah bless him.

verses.ar:
يَا إِمَامَ الرُّسْلِ يَا سَنَدِي ۞ أَنْتَ بَابُ اللّٰهِ مُعْتَمَدِي
فَبِدُنْيَايَ وَآخِرَتِي ۞ يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰهِ خُذْ بِيَدِي
verses.tr: Yā imāma-r-rusli yā sanadī · anta bābu-Llāhi muʿtamadī · Fa-bi-dunyāya wa ākhiratī · yā Rasūlallāhi khudh bi-yadī
verses.en: O leader of the messengers, O my support — you are the door of Allah on whom I rely. In my worldly life and my hereafter, O Messenger of Allah, take my hand.

verses.ar: قَسَمًا بِالنَّجْمِ حِينَ هَوَى ۞ مَا الْمُعَافَى وَالسَّقِيمُ سَوَا
verses.tr: Qasaman bi-n-najmi ḥīna hawā · mā-l-muʿāfā wa-s-saqīmu sawā
verses.en: By the star as it descends, I swear: the healthy and the ailing are not equal —

verses.ar: فَاخْلَعِ الْكَوْنَيْنِ عَنْكَ سِوَى ۞ حُبِّ مَوْلَى الْعُرْبِ وَالْعَجَمِ
verses.tr: Fa-khlaʿi-l-kawnayni ʿanka siwā · ḥubbi mawlā-l-ʿurbi wa-l-ʿajami
verses.en: so cast off both worlds from yourself, keeping only love of the master of Arabs and non-Arabs.

verses.ar: سَيِّدُ السَّادَاتِ مِنْ مُضَرِ ۞ غَوْثُ أَهْلِ الْبَدْوِ وَالْحَضَرِ
verses.tr: Sayyidu-s-sādāti min Muḍari · ghawthu ahli-l-badwi wa-l-ḥaḍari
verses.en: Master of masters from Mudar, the succor of desert dwellers and settled folk alike,

verses.ar: صَاحِبُ الْآيَاتِ وَالسُّوَرِ ۞ مَنْبَعُ الْأَحْكَامِ وَالْحِكَمِ
verses.tr: Ṣāḥibu-l-āyāti wa-s-suwari · manbaʿu-l-aḥkāmi wa-l-ḥikami
verses.en: keeper of the verses and the chapters, wellspring of rulings and of wisdoms.

verses.ar: قَمَرٌ طَابَتْ سَرِيرَتُهُ ۞ وَسَجَايَاهُ وَسِيرَتُهُ
verses.tr: Qamarun ṭābat sarīratuhu · wa sajāyāhu wa sīratuhu
verses.en: A moon whose inner essence is pure, and pure too his character and his way of life —

verses.ar: صَفْوَةُ الْبَارِي وَخِيرَتُهُ ۞ عَدْلُ أَهْلِ الْحِلِّ وَالْحَرَمِ
verses.tr: Ṣafwatu-l-Bārī wa khīratuhu · ʿadlu ahli-l-ḥilli wa-l-ḥarami
verses.en: the purest elect of the Maker and His chosen one, trusted just witness for all people, within the sanctuary and beyond.

verses.ar: مَا رَأَتْ عَيْنٌ وَلَيْسَ تَرَى ۞ مِثْلَ طٰهٰ فِي الْوَرَى بَشَرَا
verses.tr: Mā ra'at ʿaynun wa laysa tarā · mithla Ṭāhā fī-l-warā basharā
verses.en: No eye has seen, nor shall it ever see, a human being like Taha among creation —

verses.ar: خَيْرُ مَنْ مَسَّ الثَّرَى أَثَرَا ۞ طَاهِرُ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَالشِّيَمِ
verses.tr: Khayru man massa-th-tharā atharā · ṭāhiru-l-akhlāqi wa-sh-shiyami
verses.en: the best whose footsteps ever touched the earth, pure in morals and in noble traits.

verses.ar:
صَلَاةُ اللّٰهِ سَلَامُ اللّٰهِ ۞ عَلٰى طٰهٰ رَسُولِ اللّٰهِ
صَلَاةُ اللّٰهِ سَلَامُ اللّٰهِ ۞ عَلٰى يَس حَبِيبِ اللّٰهِ
verses.tr: Ṣalātullāh salāmullāh · ʿalā Ṭāhā Rasūlillāh · Ṣalātullāh salāmullāh · ʿalā Yāsīn Ḥabībillāh
verses.en: The blessings of Allah, the peace of Allah, upon Taha, the Messenger of Allah; the blessings of Allah, the peace of Allah, upon Yasin, the Beloved of Allah.

verses.ar:
تَوَسَّلْنَا بِبِسْمِ اللّٰهِ ۞ وَبِالْهَادِي رَسُولِ اللّٰهِ
وَكُلِّ مُجَاهِدٍ لِلّٰهِ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Tawassalnā bi-bismillāh · wa bi-l-hādī Rasūlillāh · Wa kulli mujāhidin lillāh · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: We seek our means through the name of Allah, through the Guide, the Messenger of Allah, and through every striver in Allah's way — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
إِلَهِي سَلِّمِ الْأُمَّةْ ۞ مِنَ الْآفَاتِ وَالنِّقْمَةْ
وَمِنْ هَمٍّ وَمِنْ غُمَّةْ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Ilāhī sallimi-l-ummah · mina-l-āfāti wa-n-niqmah · Wa min hammin wa min ghummah · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: My God, keep the community safe from afflictions and retribution, and from worry and from grief — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
إِلَهِي نَجِّنَا وَاكْشِفْ ۞ جَمِيعَ أَذِيَّةٍ وَاصْرِفْ
مَكَائِدَ الْعِدَا وَالْطُفْ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Ilāhī najjinā wa-kshif · jamīʿa adhiyyatin wa-ṣrif · Makā'ida-l-ʿidā wa-lṭuf · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: My God, deliver us, lift away every harm, turn aside the schemes of enemies, and be gentle with us — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
إِلَهِي نَفِّسِ الْكُرَبَا ۞ مِنَ الْعَاصِينَ وَالْعَطْبَا
وَكُلِّ بَلِيَّةٍ وَوَبَاءْ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Ilāhī naffisi-l-kurabā · mina-l-ʿāṣīna wa-l-ʿaṭbā · Wa kulli baliyyatin wa wabā' · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: My God, relieve the distress of the sinful and the ruined, and remove every trial and epidemic — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
فَكَمْ مِنْ رَحْمَةٍ حَصَلَتْ ۞ وَكَمْ مِنْ ذِلَّةٍ فَصَلَتْ
وَكَمْ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ وَصَلَتْ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Fa-kam min raḥmatin ḥaṣalat · wa kam min dhillatin faṣalat · Wa kam min niʿmatin waṣalat · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: How many a mercy has come to pass, how many a humiliation has been removed, how many a blessing has arrived — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
وَكَمْ أَغْنَيْتَ ذَا الْفَقْرِ ۞ وَكَمْ أَوْلَيْتَ ذَا الْعُمْرِ
وَكَمْ عَافَيْتَ ذَا الْوِزْرِ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Wa kam aghnayta dhā-l-faqri · wa kam awlayta dhā-l-ʿumri · Wa kam ʿāfayta dhā-l-wizri · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: How many a poor one You have enriched, how many an aged one You have cared for, how many a burdened one You have healed — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
لَقَدْ ضَاقَتْ عَلٰى الْقَلْبِ ۞ جَمِيعُ الْأَرْضِ مَعْ رَحْبِ
فَأَنْجِ مِنَ الْبَلَا الصَّعْبِ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Laqad ḍāqat ʿalā-l-qalbi · jamīʿu-l-arḍi maʿ raḥbi · Fa-anji mina-l-balā-ṣ-ṣaʿbi · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: The whole earth, for all its breadth, has closed in upon the heart — so rescue us from the harsh ordeal, through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
أَتَيْنَا طَالِبِي الرِّفْقِ ۞ وَجُلِّ الْخَيْرِ وَالسَّعْدِ
فَوَسِّعْ مِنْحَةَ الْأَيْدِي ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Ataynā ṭālibī-r-rifqi · wa julli-l-khayri wa-s-saʿdi · Fa-wassiʿ minḥata-l-aydī · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: We have come seeking gentleness, abundant goodness and felicity — so widen the gift of Your hands, through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
فَلَا تَرْدُدْ مَعَ الْخَيْبَةْ ۞ بَلِ اجْعَلْنَا عَلٰى الطَّيْبَةْ
أَيَا ذَا الْعِزِّ وَالْهَيْبَةْ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Fa-lā tardud maʿa-l-khaybah · bali-jʿalnā ʿalā-ṭ-ṭaybah · Ayā dhā-l-ʿizzi wa-l-haybah · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: Do not turn us back in disappointment, but set us upon goodness, O Possessor of might and awe — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
وَإِنْ تَرْدُدْ فَمَنْ نَأْتِي ۞ بِنَيْلِ جَمِيعِ حَاجَاتِي
أَيَا جَالِي الْمُلِمَّاتِ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Wa in tardud fa-man na'tī · bi-nayli jamīʿi ḥājātī · Ayā jālī-l-mulimmāti · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: And if You turn us away, to whom would we go for the fulfilling of all my needs? O Remover of calamities — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
إِلَهِي اغْفِرْ وَأَكْرِمْنَا ۞ بِنَيْلِ مَطَالِبٍ مِنَّا
وَدَفْعِ مَسَاءَةٍ عَنَّا ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Ilāhī-ghfir wa akrimnā · bi-nayli maṭālibin minnā · Wa dafʿi masā'atin ʿannā · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: My God, forgive us and honor us by granting our requests and warding harm away from us — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
إِلَهِي أَنْتَ ذُو لُطْفٍ ۞ وَذُو فَضْلٍ وَذُو عَطْفٍ
وَكَمْ مِنْ كُرْبَةٍ تَنْفِي ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Ilāhī anta dhū luṭfin · wa dhū faḍlin wa dhū ʿaṭfin · Wa kam min kurbatin tanfī · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: My God, You are full of gentleness, of grace, of compassion — how many a hardship You dispel, through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
وَصَلِّ عَلٰى النَّبِي الْبَرِّ ۞ بِلَا عَدٍّ وَلَا حَصْرِ
وَآلٍ سَادَةٍ غُرِّ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Wa ṣalli ʿalā-n-nabī-l-barri · bilā ʿaddin wa lā ḥaṣri · Wa ālin sādatin ghurri · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: And send blessings upon the righteous Prophet, beyond all count and limit, and upon his family, the radiant masters — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

QASIDAS.titleEnglish: Qaṣīdatu s-Salām — The Poem of Peace
QASIDAS.note: Repeat the refrain after each set of verses.

verses.ar:
لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهْ ۞ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهْ
لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهْ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللّٰهْ
verses.tr: Lā ilāha illa Llāh · lā ilāha illa Llāh · Lā ilāha illa Llāh · Muḥammadun Rasūlu Llāh
verses.en: There is no god but Allah, there is no god but Allah. There is no god but Allah; Muhammad is the Emissary of Allah.

verses.ar:
سَلَامٌ عَلٰى قَبْرٍ يُزَارُ مِنَ الْبُعْدِ ۞
سَلَامٌ عَلٰى الرَّوْضَةْ وَفِيهَا مُحَمَّدِ
verses.tr: Salāmun ʿalā qabrin yuzāru mina l-buʿdi · Salāmun ʿalā r-Rawḍa wa fīhā Muḥammadin
verses.en: Peace and greetings to a grave that is visited from afar. Peace be upon the Garden wherein lies Muhammad.

verses.ar:
سَلَامٌ عَلٰى مَنْ زَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ رَبَّهُ ۞
فَبَلَّغَهُ الْمَرْغُوبَ فِي كُلِّ مَقْصَدِ
verses.tr: Salāmun ʿalā man zāra fī l-layli Rabbahu · Fa-ballaghahu l-marghūba fī kulli maqṣadin
verses.en: Peace upon him who in the night visited his Lord, who granted him attainment of his desire in all he aspired to.

verses.ar:
سَلَامٌ عَلٰى مَنْ قَالَ لِلضَّبِّ مَنْ أَنَا ۞
فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللّٰهِ أَنْتَ مُحَمَّدِ
verses.tr: Salāmun ʿalā man qāla li-ḍ-ḍabbi man anā · Fa-qāla Rasūlu Llāhi anta Muḥammadin
verses.en: Peace be upon him who asked a lizard, “Who am I?” And it replied, “The Emissary of Allah. You are Muhammad.”

verses.ar:
سَلَامٌ عَلٰى الْمَدْفُونِ فِي أَرْضِ طَيْبَةَ ۞
وَمَنْ خَصَّهُ الرَّحْمَانُ بِالْفَضْلِ وَالْمَجْدِ
verses.tr: Salāmun ʿalā l-madfūni fī arḍi Ṭaybata · wa man khaṣṣahu r-Raḥmānu bi-l-faḍli wa l-majdi
verses.en: Peace upon the one buried in the land of Tayba (Madinah), and whom the All-Merciful singled out for pre-eminence and glory.

verses.ar:
نَبِيٌّ حَبَاهُ اللّٰهُ بِالْحُسْنِ وَالْبَهَا ۞
فَطُوبَى لِعَبْدٍ زَارَ قَبْرَ مُحَمَّدِ
verses.tr: Nabiyyun ḥabāhu Llāhu bi-l-ḥusni wa l-bahā · Fa-ṭūbā li-ʿabdin zāra qabra Muḥammadin
verses.en: A Prophet whom Allah granted beauty and splendour. Blessed, then, is any servant of Allah who visits the grave of Muhammad.

verses.ar:
أَيَا رَاكِبًا نَحْوَ الْمَدِينَةِ قَاصِدًا ۞
فَبَلِّغْ سَلَامِي لِلْحَبِيبِ مُحَمَّدِ
verses.tr: Ayā rākiban naḥwa l-Madīnati qāṣidan · fa-balligh salāmī li-l-ḥabībi Muḥammadin
verses.en: O you who are riding straight ahead towards Madinah, convey my greetings to the Beloved Muhammad.

verses.ar:
فِي رَوْضَتِهِ الْحُسْنَى مُنَايَ وَبُغْيَتِي ۞
وَفِيهَا شِفَا قَلْبِي وَرُوحِي وَرَاحَتِي
verses.tr: Fī Rawḍatihi l-ḥusnā munāya wa bughyatī · wa fīhā shifā qalbī wa rūḥī wa rāḥatī
verses.en: Within his most lovely Garden is my sole desire and goal; therein lies the remedy for my heart and soul, and therein my comfort.

verses.ar:
فَإِنْ بَعُدَتْ عَنِّي وَعَزَّ مَزَارُهَا ۞
فَتِمْثَالُهَا لَدَيَّ أَحْسَنُ صُورَةِ
verses.tr: Fa-in baʿudat ʿannī wa ʿazza mazāruhā · fa-timthāluhā ladayya aḥsanu ṣūratin
verses.en: For although it is far from me and difficult to visit, the picture of it in my mind's eye is the loveliest of forms.

verses.ar:
أُنَزِّهُ طَرْفَ الْعَيْنِ فِي حُسْنِ رَوْضِهَا ۞
فَيَسْلُو بِهَا لُبِّي وَسِرِّي وَمُهْجَتِي
verses.tr: Unazzihu ṭarfa l-ʿayni fī ḥusni rawḍihā · fa-yaslū bihā lubbī wa sirrī wa muhjatī
verses.en: I cleanse my eyesight by picturing the beauty of its gardens, so that my mind, being and inmost soul find solace.

verses.ar:
فَهَا أَنَا يَا قُطْبَ الْعَوَالِمِ كُلِّهَا ۞
أُقَبِّلُهَا شَوْقًا لِإِشْفَاءِ عِلَّتِي
verses.tr: Fa-hā anā yā Quṭba l-ʿAwālimi kullihā · Uqabbiluhā shawqan li-ishfā'i ʿillatī
verses.en: So here I am, O Axis of the entire Universe! I place my lips on it in yearning, to have my ailment healed.

verses.ar:
وَصَلِّ عَلٰى قُطْبِ الْوُجُودِ مُحَمَّدِ ۞
صَلَاةً بِهَا تَمْحُو عَنَّا كُلَّ زَلَّةِ
verses.tr: Wa ṣalli ʿalā Quṭbi l-wujūdi Muḥammadin · Ṣalātan bihā tamḥū ʿannā kulla zallatin
verses.en: Send prayers upon the Centre of all creation, Muhammad, prayers through which all our shortcomings are effaced.

QASIDAS.titleEnglish: Wishlōn Anām al-Layl — How Can I Sleep at Night?
QASIDAS.note: A traditional Iraqi qasida in praise of the Prophet ﷺ. Repeat the refrain after each verse.

verses.ar: وِشْلُون أَنَام اللَّيل وِشْلُون أَنَامَه ۞ حَبِيبِي مُحَمَّد جَوْهَر كَلَامَه
verses.tr: Wishlōn anām il-layl, wishlōn anāmuh · Ḥabībī Muḥammad, jawhar kalāmuh
verses.en: How can I sleep at night — how could I ever sleep? My beloved is Muhammad, whose words are jewels.

verses.ar: سَفِّن بِاللهْ يَا سَفَّان دِير السَّفِينَة ۞ أَنْوَار أَبِي الْقَاسِم لَاحَت عَلَيْنَا
verses.tr: Saffin billāh yā saffān, dīr is-safīna · Anwār Abī l-Qāsim lāḥat ʿalaynā
verses.en: Set sail in God's name, O sailor — turn the ship! The lights of Abū l-Qāsim have dawned upon us.

verses.ar: يَا رَافِق الْعُرْبَان وَاشْرَب لَبَنْهِن ۞ كُل الصَّحَابَة نْجُوم، طٰهٰ قَمَرْهِن
verses.tr: Yā rāfiq il-ʿurbān w-ishrab labanhin · Kull iṣ-ṣaḥāba njūm, Ṭāhā qamarhin
verses.en: O you who travel with the Bedouin and drink their milk — all the Companions are stars, and Ṭāhā is their moon.

verses.ar: يَا طَيْر الطَّايِر فُوگ أَبْيَض يَا بُو جْنَاح ۞ سَلِّم عَلٰى أَبِي الزَّهْرَاء گُلَّه الْعُمُر رَاح
verses.tr: Yā ṭayr iṭ-ṭāyir fōg, abyaḍ yā bū jnāḥ · Sallim ʿalā Abī z-Zahrāʾ, gulluh il-ʿumur rāḥ
verses.en: O bird soaring above, white one with wings — greet the father of Zahrāʾ; tell him life has slipped away.

verses.ar: يَا طَيْر الطَّايِر فُوگ أَخْضَر يَا بُو رِيش ۞ سَلِّم عَلٰى طٰهٰ گُلَّه دَرَاوِيش
verses.tr: Yā ṭayr iṭ-ṭāyir fōg, akhḍar yā bū rīsh · Sallim ʿalā Ṭāhā, gulluh darāwīsh
verses.en: O bird soaring above, green one with feathers — greet Ṭāhā; tell him we've become dervishes, poor wanderers in love.

verses.ar: مَا أَرِيد أَمُوت الْيَوم، كَفْنِي عَبَاتِي ۞ دِزُّوا عَلٰى طٰهٰ يِحْضَر وَفَاتِي
verses.tr: Mā arīd amūt il-yōm, kafnī ʿabātī · Dizzū ʿalā Ṭāhā yiḥḍar wafātī
verses.en: I don't wish to die today — my cloak is my only shroud; send word to Ṭāhā, that he may attend my passing.

verses.ar: فَسُبْحَانَ مَنْ خَصَّهُ ﷺ بِأَشْرَفِ الْمَنَاصِبِ وَالْمَرَاتِبِ
verses.tr: Fa-subḥāna man khaṣṣahu ﷺ bi-ashrafi l-manāṣibi wa l-marātib
verses.en: Glory be to the One who singled him ﷺ out with the noblest of offices and ranks.

verses.ar: أَحْمَدُهُ عَلٰى مَا مَنَحَ مِنَ الْمَوَاهِبِ
verses.tr: Aḥmaduhu ʿalā mā manaḥa mina l-mawāhib
verses.en: I praise Him for the gifts He has bestowed.

verses.ar: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ رَبُّ الْمَشَارِقِ وَالْمَغَارِبِ
verses.tr: Wa ashhadu an lā ilāha illā-Llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu Rabbu l-mashāriqi wa l-maghārib
verses.en: And I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, having no partner, Lord of every east and every west.

verses.ar: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ الْمَبْعُوثُ إِلَى سَائِرِ الْأَعَاجِمِ وَالْأَعَارِبِ
verses.tr: Wa ashhadu anna sayyidanā Muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa Rasūluhu l-mabʿūthu ilā sāʾiri l-aʿājimi wa l-aʿārib
verses.en: And I bear witness that our master Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger, sent to all peoples, non-Arab and Arab alike.

verses.ar: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ أُولِي الْمَآثِرِ وَالْمَنَاقِبِ
verses.tr: Ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallama wa ʿalā ālihi wa aṣḥābihi ulī l-maʾāthiri wa l-manāqib
verses.en: May Allah bless him and grant him peace, and his family and his companions, possessors of noble deeds and virtues.

verses.ar: صَلَاةً وَسَلَامًا دَائِمَيْنِ مُتَلَازِمَيْنِ يَأْتِي قَائِلُهُمَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ غَيْرَ خَائِبٍ
verses.tr: Ṣalātan wa salāman dāʾimayni mutalāzimayni yaʾtī qāʾiluhumā yawma l-qiyāmati ghayra khāʾib
verses.en: Blessings and peace, lasting and inseparable — whoever utters them will come on the Day of Rising not disappointed.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālih
verses.en: O Allah, bless him, grant him peace, and pour Your blessings upon him and his family.

QASIDAS.note: The refrain is sung twice, and repeated after each verse.

verses.ar: يَا تَوَّابُ تُبْ عَلَيْنَا ۞ وَارْحَمْنَا وَانْظُرْ إِلَيْنَا
verses.tr: Yā Tawwābu tub ʿalaynā · wa-rḥamnā wa-nẓur ilaynā
verses.en: O Ever-Relenting, turn to us in forgiveness; have mercy on us and look upon us.

verses.ar: خُذْ يَمِينًا خُذْ يَمِينًا ۞ عَنْ سَبِيلِ الظَّالِمِينَا
verses.tr: Khudh yamīnan khudh yamīnan · ʿan sabīli ẓ-ẓālimīnā
verses.en: Keep to the right, keep to the right, away from the path of the wrongdoers.

verses.ar: وَاتَّقِ اللّٰهَ تَعَالَى ۞ عَنْ مَقَالِ الْمُلْحِدِينَا
verses.tr: Wa-ttaqi-Llāha taʿālā · ʿan maqāli l-mulḥidīnā
verses.en: And be mindful of Allah Most High, turning away from the talk of those who deny Him.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُ الْحَقُّ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ ۞ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَا
verses.tr: Allāhu l-Ḥaqqu Rabbu l-ʿArshi · Rabbu l-ʿālamīnā
verses.en: Allah, the Real, is Lord of the Throne, Lord of all the worlds.

verses.ar: هُوَ رَبُّ الْأَوَّلِينَا ۞ هُوَ رَبُّ الْآخِرِينَا
verses.tr: Huwa Rabbu l-awwalīnā · huwa Rabbu l-ākhirīnā
verses.en: He is the Lord of those who came first; He is the Lord of those who come last.

verses.ar: هُوَ رَبِّي هُوَ حَسْبِي ۞ هُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَا
verses.tr: Huwa Rabbī huwa ḥasbī · huwa khayru r-rāziqīnā
verses.en: He is my Lord, He is my sufficiency; He is the best of providers.

verses.ar: هُوَ غَفَّارُ الْخَطَايَا ۞ هُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَا
verses.tr: Huwa ghaffāru l-khaṭāyā · huwa khayru r-rāḥimīnā
verses.en: He is the Forgiver of faults; He is the best of those who show mercy.

verses.ar: رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنَا جَمِيعًا ۞ فِي الْعِبَادِ الصَّالِحِينَا
verses.tr: Rabbi adkhilnā jamīʿan · fi l-ʿibādi ṣ-ṣāliḥīnā
verses.en: My Lord, admit us all among Your righteous servants.

verses.ar: وَارْضَ عَنَّا وَاعْفُ عَنَّا ۞ وَأَجِرْنَا أَجْمَعِينَا
verses.tr: Wa-rḍa ʿannā wa-ʿfu ʿannā · wa ajirnā ajmaʿīnā
verses.en: Be pleased with us, pardon us, and grant us all Your protection —

verses.ar: مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي جَحِيمٍ ۞ أُرْصِدَتْ لِلْمُجْرِمِينَا
verses.tr: Min ʿadhābin fī jaḥīmin · urṣidat li-l-mujrimīnā
verses.en: from a punishment in the blazing Fire, made ready for the guilty,

verses.ar: مِنْ عُصَاةٍ فَاسِقِينَا ۞ وَعُتَاةٍ كَافِرِينَا
verses.tr: Min ʿuṣātin fāsiqīnā · wa ʿutātin kāfirīnā
verses.en: for the disobedient and depraved, and the insolent who disbelieve.

verses.ar: رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنَا جِنَانًا ۞ أُزْلِفَتْ لِلْمُتَّقِينَا
verses.tr: Rabbi adkhilnā jinānan · uzlifat li-l-muttaqīnā
verses.en: My Lord, admit us into gardens brought near for the God-fearing,

verses.ar: إِذْ يُنَادَوْنَ ادْخُلُوهَا ۞ بِسَلَامٍ آمِنِينَا
verses.tr: Idh yunādawna-dkhulūhā · bi-salāmin āminīnā
verses.en: when they are called: enter them in peace, secure.

verses.ar: وَصَلَاةُ اللّٰهِ تَغْشَى ۞ أَحْمَدَ الْهَادِي الْأَمِينَا
verses.tr: Wa ṣalātu-Llāhi taghshā · Aḥmada l-hādī l-amīnā
verses.en: And may Allah's blessings envelop Ahmad, the guide, the trustworthy,

verses.ar: وَعَلٰى الْآلِ وَالصَّحْبِ ۞ وَجَمِيعِ التَّابِعِينَا
verses.tr: Wa ʿalā l-āli wa ṣ-ṣaḥbi · wa jamīʿi t-tābiʿīnā
verses.en: and upon his family and companions, and all who followed after them,

verses.ar: مَا تَلَا تَالٍ قُرْآنًا ۞ جَاءَ بِالْحَقِّ الْمُبِينَا
verses.tr: Mā talā tālin Qurʾānan · jāʾa bi-l-ḥaqqi l-mubīnā
verses.en: for as long as any reciter recites the Qur'an, which came with the manifest truth.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālih
verses.en: O Allah, bless him, grant him peace, and pour Your blessings upon him and his family.

verses.ar: يَا بَدْرُ تَمَّ فَحَازَ كُلَّ كَمَالِ ۞ مَاذَا يُعَبِّرُ عَنْ عُلَاكَ مَقَالِي
verses.tr: Yā badru tamma fa-ḥāza kulla kamāli · mādhā yuʿabbiru ʿan ʿulāka maqālī
