verses.en: O full moon, complete, having gathered every perfection — what can my speech convey of your loftiness?

verses.ar: أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَشْرَقْتَ فِي أُفُقِ الْعُلَا ۞ فَمَحَوْتَ بِالْأَنْوَارِ كُلَّ ضَلَالِ
verses.tr: Anta lladhī ashraqta fī ufuqi l-ʿulā · fa-maḥawta bi-l-anwāri kulla ḍalāli
verses.en: You are the one who rose in the horizon of the heights, and with your lights you effaced every misguidance.

verses.ar: وَبِكَ اسْتَنَارَ الْكَوْنُ يَا عَلَمَ الْهُدَى ۞ بِالنُّورِ وَالْإِنْعَامِ وَالْإِفْضَالِ
verses.tr: Wa bika-stanāra l-kawnu yā ʿalama l-hudā · bi-n-nūri wa l-inʿāmi wa l-ifḍāli
verses.en: Through you the universe was lit, O banner of guidance — with light, with blessing, and with bounty.

verses.ar: صَلَّى عَلَيْكَ اللّٰهُ رَبِّي دَائِمًا ۞ أَبَدًا مَعَ الْإِبْكَارِ وَالْآصَالِ
verses.tr: Ṣallā ʿalayka-Llāhu Rabbī dāʾiman · abadan maʿa l-ibkāri wa l-āṣāli
verses.en: May Allah, my Lord, send blessings upon you always and forever, at every dawn and every evening,

verses.ar: وَعَلٰى جَمِيعِ الْآلِ وَالْأَصْحَابِ مَنْ ۞ قَدْ خَصَّهُمْ رَبُّ الْعُلَا بِكَمَالِ
verses.tr: Wa ʿalā jamīʿi l-āli wa l-aṣḥābi man · qad khaṣṣahum Rabbu l-ʿulā bi-kamāli
verses.en: and upon all the family and the companions, whom the Lord of the heights singled out with perfection.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālih
verses.en: O Allah, bless him, grant him peace, and pour Your blessings upon him and his family.

QASIDAS.note: Each verse opens with the blessed name; the refrain is repeated after each.

verses.ar: سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ يَا نَبِي سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ سَيِّدِي ۞ يَا نَبِي يَا إِمَامَ الْحَرَمَيْنِ
verses.tr: Salāmun ʿalayk yā Nabī, salāmun ʿalayk sayyidī · yā Nabī yā Imāma l-ḥaramayn
verses.en: Peace be upon you, O Prophet; peace be upon you, my master — O Prophet, O Imam of the two sanctuaries.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ أَشْرَفُ الْأَعْرَابِ وَالْعَجَمِ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ خَيْرُ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلٰى قَدَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun ashrafu l-aʿrābi wa l-ʿajami · Muḥammadun khayru man yamshī ʿalā qadami
verses.en: Muhammad is the noblest of Arabs and non-Arabs; Muhammad is the best of all who ever walked upon a foot.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ بَاسِطُ الْمَعْرُوفِ جَامِعُهُ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ صَاحِبُ الْإِحْسَانِ وَالْكَرَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun bāsiṭu l-maʿrūfi jāmiʿuhu · Muḥammadun ṣāḥibu l-iḥsāni wa l-karami
verses.en: Muhammad spreads what is good and gathers it in himself; Muhammad is the possessor of kindness and generosity.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ تَاجُ رُسْلِ اللّٰهِ قَاطِبَةً ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ صَادِقُ الْقَوْلِ وَالْكَلِمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun tāju rusli-Llāhi qāṭibatan · Muḥammadun ṣādiqu l-qawli wa l-kalimi
verses.en: Muhammad is the crown of all Allah's messengers; Muhammad is truthful in speech and in word.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ ثَابِتُ الْمِيثَاقِ حَافِظُهُ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ طَيِّبُ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَالشِّيَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun thābitu l-mīthāqi ḥāfiẓuhu · Muḥammadun ṭayyibu l-akhlāqi wa sh-shiyami
verses.en: Muhammad holds firm to the covenant and keeps it; Muhammad is sweet in character and disposition.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ رُوِيَتْ بِالنُّورِ طِينَتُهُ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ لَمْ يَزَلْ نُورًا مِنَ الْقِدَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun ruwiyat bi-n-nūri ṭīnatuhu · Muḥammadun lam yazal nūran mina l-qidami
verses.en: Muhammad — his very clay was steeped in light; Muhammad has never ceased to be a light from eternity.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ حَاكِمٌ بِالْعَدْلِ ذُو شَرَفٍ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ مَعْدِنُ الْإِنْعَامِ وَالْحِكَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun ḥākimun bi-l-ʿadli dhū sharafin · Muḥammadun maʿdinu l-inʿāmi wa l-ḥikami
verses.en: Muhammad rules with justice, possessed of honour; Muhammad is the wellspring of blessing and wisdom.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ خَيْرُ خَلْقِ اللّٰهِ مِنْ مُضَرٍ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ خَيْرُ رُسْلِ اللّٰهِ كُلِّهِمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun khayru khalqi-Llāhi min Muḍarin · Muḥammadun khayru rusli-Llāhi kullihimi
verses.en: Muhammad is the best of Allah's creation, of the line of Mudar; Muhammad is the best of all Allah's messengers.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ دِينُهُ حَقٌّ نَدِينُ بِهِ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ مُجْمَلًا حَقًّا عَلٰى عَلَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun dīnuhu ḥaqqun nadīnu bihi · Muḥammadun mujmalan ḥaqqan ʿalā ʿalami
verses.en: Muhammad — his religion is truth, and by it we live; Muhammad, in sum, is truth raised as a standard.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ ذِكْرُهُ رُوحٌ لِأَنْفُسِنَا ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ شُكْرُهُ فَرْضٌ عَلٰى الْأُمَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun dhikruhu rūḥun li-anfusinā · Muḥammadun shukruhu farḍun ʿalā l-umami
verses.en: Muhammad — his remembrance is life to our souls; Muhammad — gratitude for him is a duty upon the nations.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ زِينَةُ الدُّنْيَا وَبَهْجَتُهَا ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ كَاشِفُ الْغُمَّاتِ وَالظُّلَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun zīnatu d-dunyā wa bahjatuhā · Muḥammadun kāshifu l-ghummāti wa ẓ-ẓulami
verses.en: Muhammad is the adornment of this world and its delight; Muhammad is the lifter of sorrows and darknesses.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ سَيِّدٌ طَابَتْ مَنَاقِبُهُ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ صَاغَهُ الرَّحْمٰنُ بِالنِّعَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun sayyidun ṭābat manāqibuhu · Muḥammadun ṣāghahu r-Raḥmānu bi-n-niʿami
verses.en: Muhammad is a master whose virtues are sweet; Muhammad — the All-Merciful fashioned him with favours.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ صَفْوَةُ الْبَارِي وَخِيرَتُهُ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ طَاهِرٌ مِنْ سَائِرِ التُّهَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun ṣafwatu l-Bārī wa khīratuhu · Muḥammadun ṭāhirun min sāʾiri t-tuhami
verses.en: Muhammad is the chosen of the Maker and His elect; Muhammad is pure of every accusation.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ ضَاحِكٌ لِلضَّيْفِ مُكْرِمُهُ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ جَارُهُ وَاللّٰهِ لَمْ يُضَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun ḍāḥikun li-ḍ-ḍayfi mukrimuhu · Muḥammadun jāruhu wa-Llāhi lam yuḍami
verses.en: Muhammad smiles at the guest and honours him; Muhammad's neighbour — by Allah — is never wronged.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ طَابَتِ الدُّنْيَا بِبِعْثَتِهِ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ جَاءَ بِالْآيَاتِ وَالْحِكَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun ṭābati d-dunyā bi-biʿthatihi · Muḥammadun jāʾa bi-l-āyāti wa l-ḥikami
verses.en: Muhammad — with his sending the world grew sweet; Muhammad came with signs and with wisdom.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ يَوْمَ بَعْثِ النَّاسِ شَافِعُنَا ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ نُورُهُ الْهَادِي مِنَ الظُّلَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun yawma baʿthi n-nāsi shāfiʿunā · Muḥammadun nūruhu l-hādī mina ẓ-ẓulami
verses.en: Muhammad, on the day mankind is raised, is our intercessor; Muhammad — his light is the guide out of the darknesses.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ قَائِمٌ لِلّٰهِ ذُو هِمَمٍ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ خَاتَمٌ لِلرُّسْلِ كُلِّهِمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun qāʾimun li-Llāhi dhū himamin · Muḥammadun khātamun li-r-rusli kullihimi
verses.en: Muhammad stands for Allah, possessed of high resolve; Muhammad is the seal of all the messengers.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālih
verses.en: O Allah, bless him, grant him peace, and pour Your blessings upon him and his family.

DALAIL_CHAPTERS.note: The title page of the book, giving its full name and its author.

verses.ar: دَلَائِلُ الْخَيْرَاتِ وَشَوَارِقُ الْأَنْوَارِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ عَلٰى النَّبِيِّ الْمُخْتَارِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
verses.en: Waymarks of Benefits and the Risings of Lights, on invoking blessings upon the Chosen Prophet — may Allah bless him and grant him peace.

verses.ar: الْمَعْرُوفُ بِاخْتِصَارِهِ ۞ دَلَائِلُ الْخَيْرَاتِ
verses.en: Known for short as: Dalāʾil al-Khayrāt.

verses.ar:
لِلْإِمَامِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمٰنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ الْجَزُولِيِّ الْحَسَنِيِّ
(807–870 هـ / 1404–1465 م)
verses.en:
By the Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān ibn Abī Bakr ibn Sulaymān al-Jazūlī al-Ḥasanī
(807–870 AH / 1404–1465 CE)

DALAIL_CHAPTERS.note: The duʿāʾ recited before beginning Dalāʾil al-Khayrāt, followed by the istighfār, the tasbīḥ and the opening recitations. The Qurʾānic passages are given in Arabic and transliteration only.

verses.ar: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
verses.tr: Bismi-Llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm
verses.en: In the name of Allah, the All-Merciful, the Most Merciful.

verses.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۞ حَسْبِيَ اللّٰهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ ۞ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
verses.tr: Al-ḥamdu li-Llāhi Rabbi l-ʿālamīn. Ḥasbiya-Llāhu wa-niʿma l-wakīl. Wa-lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-Llāhi l-ʿAliyyi l-ʿAẓīm
verses.en: Praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. Allah is enough for me, and how excellent a guardian. There is no power and no strength save by Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّي اَبْرَأُ مِنْ حَوْلِي وَقُوَّتِي اِلٰى حَوْلِكَ وَقُوَّتِكَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma innī abraʾu min ḥawlī wa-quwwatī ilā ḥawlika wa-quwwatik
verses.en: O Allah, I disown my own power and strength, and turn to Your power and Your strength.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّي نَوَيْتُ اَنْ اَتَقَرَّبَ اِلَيْكَ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَنَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُولِكَ سَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالٰى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَعَلَيْهِمْ اَجْمَعِينَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma innī nawaytu an ataqarraba ilayka bi-ṣ-ṣalāti ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿabdika wa-nabiyyika wa-rasūlika sayyidi l-mursalīn, ṣallā-Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama wa-ʿalayhim ajmaʿīn
verses.en: O Allah, I intend to draw near to You by invoking blessings upon our master Muhammad — Your servant, Your prophet and Your messenger, the master of the messengers — may Allah Most High bless him and grant him peace, and them all.

verses.ar: اِمْتِثَالًا لِاَمْرِكَ وَتَصْدِيقًا لِنَبِيِّكَ ۞ وَمَحَبَّةً فِيهِ وَشَوْقًا اِلَيْهِ ۞ وَتَعْظِيمًا لِقَدْرِهِ ۞ وَلِكَوْنِهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالٰى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ اَهْلًا لِذٰلِكَ
verses.tr: Imtithālan li-amrika wa-taṣdīqan li-nabiyyik. Wa-maḥabbatan fīhi wa-shawqan ilayh. Wa-taʿẓīman li-qadrih. Wa-li-kawnihi ṣallā-Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama ahlan li-dhālik
verses.en: In obedience to Your command and in affirmation of Your prophet; out of love for him and longing for him; in reverence for his worth; and because he — may Allah Most High bless him and grant him peace — is worthy of it.

verses.ar: فَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي بِفَضْلِكَ وَاِحْسَانِكَ وَاَزِلْ حِجَابَ الْغَفْلَةِ عَنْ قَلْبِي وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
verses.tr: Fa-taqabbalhā minnī bi-faḍlika wa-iḥsānik, wa-azil ḥijāba l-ghaflati ʿan qalbī, wa-jʿalnī min ʿibādika ṣ-ṣāliḥīn
verses.en: So accept it from me by Your grace and Your kindness; lift the veil of heedlessness from my heart, and place me among Your righteous servants.

verses.ar: وَوَفِّقْنِي لِقِرَاءَتِهَا عَلٰى الدَّوَامِ بِجَاهِهِ عِنْدَكَ وَمَكَانَتِهِ لَدَيْكَ وَمَحَبَّتِكَ لَهُ وَمَحَبَّتِهِ لَكَ وَبِالسِّرِّ الَّذِي بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالٰى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
verses.tr: Wa-waffiqnī li-qirāʾatihā ʿalā d-dawāmi bi-jāhihi ʿindaka wa-makānatihi ladayk, wa-maḥabbatika lahu wa-maḥabbatihi lak, wa-bi-s-sirri lladhī baynaka wa-baynahu ṣallā-Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallam
verses.en: Grant me the grace to recite it always — by his standing with You and his place before You, by Your love for him and his love for You, and by the secret that is between You and him, may Allah Most High bless him and grant him peace.

verses.ar: وَضَاعِفِ اللّٰهُمَّ مَحَبَّتِي فِيهِ وَعَرِّفْنِي بِحَقِّهِ وَرُتَبِهِ
verses.tr: Wa-ḍāʿifi-Llāhumma maḥabbatī fīhi wa-ʿarrifnī bi-ḥaqqihi wa-rutabih
verses.en: O Allah, multiply my love for him, and make known to me his right and his ranks.

verses.ar: وَكَرِّمْنِي بِاتِّبَاعِهِ وَالْقِيَامِ بِاَدَبِهِ وَسُنَّتِهِ
verses.tr: Wa-karrimnī bi-ttibāʿihi wa-l-qiyāmi bi-adabihi wa-sunnatih
verses.en: Honour me with following him, and with upholding his manners and his way.

verses.ar: وَاجْمَعْنِي عَلَيْهِ وَمَتِّعْنِي بِرُؤْيَتِهِ وَاَسْعِدْنِي بِمُكَالَمَتِهِ
verses.tr: Wa-jmaʿnī ʿalayhi wa-mattiʿnī bi-ruʾyatihi wa-asʿidnī bi-mukālamatih
verses.en: Gather me about him, let me delight in seeing him, and make me happy with his speech.

verses.ar: وَارْفَعْ عَنِّي الْعَلَائِقَ وَالْعَوَائِقَ وَالْوَسَائِطَ وَالْحِجَابَ وَشَنِّفْ سَمْعِي مَعَهُ بِلَذِيذِ الْخِطَابِ
verses.tr: Wa-rfaʿ ʿannī l-ʿalāʾiqa wa-l-ʿawāʾiqa wa-l-wasāʾiṭa wa-l-ḥijāb, wa-shannif samʿī maʿahu bi-ladhīdhi l-khiṭāb
verses.en: Lift from me all attachments, obstacles, intermediaries and veils; and adorn my hearing, in his company, with the sweetness of his address.

verses.ar: وَهَيِّئْنِي لِلتَّلَقِّي مِنْهُ وَاَهِّلْنِي لِخِدْمَتِهِ
verses.tr: Wa-hayyiʾnī li-t-talaqqī minhu wa-ahhilnī li-khidmatih
verses.en: Ready me to receive from him, and make me fit for his service.

verses.ar: وَاجْعَلْ صَلَاتِي عَلَيْهِ نُورًا نَيِّرًا كَامِلًا مُكَمِّلًا طَاهِرًا مُطَهِّرًا مَاحِيًا كُلَّ ظُلْمٍ وَظُلْمَةٍ وَشَكٍّ وَشِرْكٍ وَكُفْرٍ وَزُورٍ وَوِزْرٍ
verses.tr: Wa-jʿal ṣalātī ʿalayhi nūran nayyiran, kāmilan mukammilan, ṭāhiran muṭahhiran, māḥiyan kulla ẓulmin wa-ẓulmatin wa-shakkin wa-shirkin wa-kufrin wa-zūrin wa-wizr
verses.en: Make my blessing upon him a light, and radiant; complete, and completing; pure, and purifying — effacing every wrong and every darkness, every doubt, idolatry, disbelief, falsehood and burden of sin.

verses.ar: وَاجْعَلْهَا سَبَبًا لِلتَّمْحِيصِ وَمَرْقًى لِاَنَالَ بِهَا اَعْلٰى مَقَامِ الْاِخْلَاصِ وَالتَّخْصِيصِ حَتّٰى لَا يَبْقٰى فِيَّ رَبَّانِيَّةٌ لِغَيْرِكَ وَحَتّٰى اَصْلُحَ لِحَضْرَتِكَ
verses.tr: Wa-jʿalhā sababan li-t-tamḥīṣ, wa-marqan li-anāla bihā aʿlā maqāmi l-ikhlāṣi wa-t-takhṣīṣ, ḥattā lā yabqā fiyya rabbāniyyatun li-ghayrik, wa-ḥattā aṣluḥa li-ḥaḍratik
verses.en: Make it a means of purification and an ascent, that by it I may reach the highest station of sincerity and election — until no lordship of any other than You remains in me, and until I am fit for Your presence.

verses.ar: وَاَكُونَ مِنْ اَهْلِ خُصُوصِيَّتِكَ مُسْتَمْسِكًا بِاَدَبِهِ وَسُنَّتِهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالٰى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مُسْتَمِدًّا بِهِ مِنْ حَضْرَتِكَ فِي كُلِّ وَقْتٍ وَحِينٍ
verses.tr: Wa-akūna min ahli khuṣūṣiyyatik, mustamsikan bi-adabihi wa-sunnatihi ṣallā-Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallam, mustamiddan bihi min ḥaḍratika fī kulli waqtin wa-ḥīn
verses.en: And that I may be among the people of Your special favour, holding fast to his manners and his way — may Allah Most High bless him and grant him peace — drawing through him from Your presence at every time and moment.

verses.ar: يَا اللّٰهُ يَا نُورُ يَا حَقُّ يَا مُبِينُ يَا حَقُّ يَا مُبِينُ يَا حَقُّ يَا مُبِينُ
verses.tr: Yā Allāh, yā Nūr, yā Ḥaqq, yā Mubīn, yā Ḥaqq, yā Mubīn, yā Ḥaqq, yā Mubīn
verses.en: O Allah, O Light, O Truth, O Manifest; O Truth, O Manifest; O Truth, O Manifest.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ زِدْهُ شَرَفًا عَلٰى شَرَفِهِ الَّذِي اَوْلَيْتَهُ ۞ وَعِزًّا عَلٰى عِزِّهِ الَّذِي اَعْطَيْتَهُ ۞ وَنُورًا عَلٰى نُورِهِ الَّذِي مِنْهُ خَلَقْتَهُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma zidhu sharafan ʿalā sharafihi lladhī awlaytah. Wa-ʿizzan ʿalā ʿizzihi lladhī aʿṭaytah. Wa-nūran ʿalā nūrihi lladhī minhu khalaqtah
verses.en: O Allah, increase him in honour upon the honour You conferred on him; in might upon the might You gave him; and in light upon the light from which You created him.

verses.ar: وَاَعْلِ مَقَامَهُ فِي مَقَامَاتِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَدَرَجَتَهُ فِي دَرَجَاتِ النَّبِيِّينَ
verses.tr: Wa-aʿli maqāmahu fī maqāmāti l-mursalīn, wa-darajatahu fī darajāti n-nabiyyīn
verses.en: Raise his station among the stations of the messengers, and his degree among the degrees of the prophets.

verses.ar: وَاَسْئَلُكَ رِضَاكَ وَرِضَاهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
verses.tr: Wa-asʾaluka riḍāka wa-riḍāh, yā Rabba l-ʿālamīn
verses.en: And I ask You for Your good pleasure and his, O Lord of the worlds.

verses.ar: مَعَ الْعَافِيَةِ الدَّائِمَةِ وَالْمَوْتِ عَلٰى الْكِتَابِ وَالسُّنَّةِ وَالْجَمَاعَةِ
verses.tr: Maʿa l-ʿāfiyati d-dāʾimah, wa-l-mawti ʿalā l-Kitābi wa-s-Sunnati wa-l-jamāʿah
verses.en: Together with lasting well-being, and death upon the Book, the Sunnah and the community.

verses.ar: وَكَلِمَتَيِ الشَّهَادَةِ عَلٰى تَحْقِيقِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ تَغْيِيرٍ وَلَا تَبْدِيلٍ
verses.tr: Wa-kalimatayi sh-shahādati ʿalā taḥqīqihā min ghayri taghyīrin wa-lā tabdīl
verses.en: And upon the two words of the testimony, realised in truth, without change or alteration.

verses.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا ارْتَكَبْتُهُ بِمَنِّكَ وَفَضْلِكَ وَجُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ يَا اَكْرَمَ الْاَكْرَمِينَ
verses.tr: Wa-ghfir lī mā rtakabtuhu bi-mannika wa-faḍlika wa-jūdika wa-karamik, yā Akrama l-akramīn
verses.en: And forgive me what I have committed, by Your favour, Your grace, Your generosity and Your bounty, O Most Generous of the generous.

verses.ar: وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ
verses.tr: Wa-ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi wa-sallam
verses.en: And may Allah bless our master Muhammad, his family and his companions, and grant them peace.

verses.ar: اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّٰهَ الْعَظِيمَ (3)
verses.tr: Astaghfiru-Llāha l-ʿAẓīm (3)
verses.en: I seek the forgiveness of Allah, the Magnificent. (3)

verses.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَلَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَاللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ ۞ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ (3)
verses.tr: Subḥāna-Llāhi wa-l-ḥamdu li-Llāh, wa-lā ilāha illā-Llāhu wa-Llāhu akbar. Wa-lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-Llāhi l-ʿAliyyi l-ʿAẓīm (3)
verses.en: Glory be to Allah; praise belongs to Allah; there is no god but Allah; Allah is greater. There is no power and no strength save by Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent. (3)

verses.ar: حَسْبِيَ اللّٰهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ (3)
verses.tr: Ḥasbiya-Llāhu wa-niʿma l-wakīl (3)
verses.en: Allah is enough for me, and how excellent a guardian. (3)

verses.ar: اَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ۞ بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۞ قُلْ هُوَ اللّٰهُ اَحَدٌ ۞ اَللّٰهُ الصَّمَدُ ۞ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۞ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا اَحَدٌ (3)
verses.tr: Aʿūdhu bi-Llāhi mina sh-shayṭāni r-rajīm. Bismi-Llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm. Qul huwa-Llāhu aḥad. Allāhu ṣ-Ṣamad. Lam yalid wa-lam yūlad. Wa-lam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥad (3)

verses.ar: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۞ قُلْ اَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۞ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۞ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ اِذَا وَقَبَ ۞ وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۞ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ اِذَا حَسَدَ
verses.tr: Bismi-Llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm. Qul aʿūdhu bi-Rabbi l-falaq. Min sharri mā khalaq. Wa-min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab. Wa-min sharri n-naffāthāti fī l-ʿuqad. Wa-min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad

verses.ar: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۞ قُلْ اَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۞ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۞ اِلٰهِ النَّاسِ ۞ مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۞ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۞ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
verses.tr: Bismi-Llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm. Qul aʿūdhu bi-Rabbi n-nās. Maliki n-nās. Ilāhi n-nās. Min sharri l-waswāsi l-khannās. Alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūri n-nās. Mina l-jinnati wa-n-nās

verses.ar: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۞ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۞ اَلرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۞ مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ ۞ اِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَاِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ ۞ اِهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ ۞ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
verses.tr: Bismi-Llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm. Al-ḥamdu li-Llāhi Rabbi l-ʿālamīn. Ar-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm. Māliki yawmi d-dīn. Iyyāka naʿbudu wa-iyyāka nastaʿīn. Ihdinā ṣ-ṣirāṭa l-mustaqīm. Ṣirāṭa lladhīna anʿamta ʿalayhim, ghayri l-maghḍūbi ʿalayhim wa-lā ḍ-ḍāllīn

verses.ar: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۞ الٓمٓ ۞ ذٰلِكَ الْكِتَابُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ هُدًى لِلْمُتَّقِينَ ۞ اَلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَاةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ ۞ وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَا اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْكَ وَمَا اُنْزِلَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ وَبِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ ۞ اُولٰئِكَ عَلٰى هُدًى مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَاُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.tr: Bismi-Llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm. Alif Lām Mīm. Dhālika l-kitābu lā rayba fīh, hudan li-l-muttaqīn. Alladhīna yuʾminūna bi-l-ghaybi wa-yuqīmūna ṣ-ṣalāta wa-mimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn. Wa-lladhīna yuʾminūna bimā unzila ilayka wa-mā unzila min qablika wa-bi-l-ākhirati hum yūqinūn. Ulāʾika ʿalā hudan min Rabbihim wa-ulāʾika humu l-mufliḥūn

DALAIL_CHAPTERS.note: The ninety-nine Names, as set out in Dalāʾil al-Khayrāt.

verses.ar: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
verses.tr: Bismi-Llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm
verses.en: In the name of Allah, the All-Merciful, the Most Merciful.

verses.ar: هُوَ اللّٰهُ الَّذِى لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ
verses.tr: Huwa-Llāhu lladhī lā ilāha illā Hū
verses.en: He is Allah, other than whom there is no god.

verses.ar: الرَّحْمٰنُ
verses.tr: Ar-Raḥmān

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّي اَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ اَنْ اُشْرِكَ بِكَ شَيْئًا وَاَنَا اَعْلَمُ وَاَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا اَعْلَمُ ۞ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min an ushrika bika shayʾan wa-anā aʿlam, wa-astaghfiruka limā lā aʿlam. Innaka Anta ʿAllāmu l-ghuyūb
verses.en: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from associating anything with You knowingly, and I ask Your forgiveness for what I do not know. You are the Knower of all that is hidden.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ اَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِكَ شَيْئًا نَعْلَمُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا نَعْلَمُهُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma innā naʿūdhu bika min an nushrika bika shayʾan naʿlamuh, wa-nastaghfiruka limā lā naʿlamuh
verses.en: O Allah, we seek refuge with You from associating anything with You that we know of, and we ask Your forgiveness for what we do not know.

DALAIL_CHAPTERS.note: The chief of the prayers for forgiveness, from the Prophet ﷺ.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ ۞ خَلَقْتَنِي وَاَنَا عَبْدُكَ ۞ وَاَنَا عَلٰى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma Anta Rabbī lā ilāha illā Ant. Khalaqtanī wa-anā ʿabduk. Wa-anā ʿalā ʿahdika wa-waʿdika mā staṭaʿt
verses.en: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I hold to Your covenant and Your promise as far as I am able.

verses.ar: اَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ
verses.tr: Aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣanaʿt
verses.en: I seek refuge with You from the evil of what I have done.

verses.ar: اَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَاَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي
verses.tr: Abūʾu laka bi-niʿmatika ʿalayya wa-abūʾu bi-dhanbī
verses.en: I acknowledge before You Your favour upon me, and I acknowledge my sin.

verses.ar: فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي فَاِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ
verses.tr: Fa-ghfir lī dhunūbī, fa-innahu lā yaghfiru dh-dhunūba illā Ant
verses.en: So forgive me my sins, for none forgives sins but You.

DALAIL_CHAPTERS.titleEnglish: The Names of the Prophet ﷺ
DALAIL_CHAPTERS.note: The two hundred and one names, as gathered by Imam al-Jazūlī.

verses.ar: اَسْمَاءُ سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِائَتَانِ وَوَاحِدٌ وَهِيَ هٰذِهِ
verses.tr: Asmāʾu sayyidinā wa-mawlānā Muḥammadin ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallama miʾatāni wa-wāḥidun wa-hiya hādhihi
verses.en: The names of our master and patron Muhammad — may Allah bless him and grant him peace — are two hundred and one, and they are these.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى مَنِ اسْمُهُ مُحَمَّدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalā mani-smuhu Muḥammad
verses.en: O Allah, bless, greet and sanctify him whose name is Muḥammad — the much-praised.

verses.ar: طَهِّرْ قُلُوبَنَا مِنْ كُلِّ وَصْفٍ يُبَاعِدُنَا عَنْ مُشَاهَدَتِكَ وَمَحَبَّتِكَ

verses.en: purify our hearts of every trait that keeps us far from witnessing You and from loving You;

verses.ar: وَاَمِتْنَا عَلٰى السُّنَّةِ وَالْجَمَاعَةِ وَالشَّوْقِ اِلٰى لِقَائِكَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْاِكْرَامِ

verses.en: and let us die upon the Sunnah, the community, and longing to meet You, O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity.

verses.ar: وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى اٰلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمًا
verses.tr: Wa-ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalā sayyidinā wa-mawlānā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi wa-sallama taslīmā
verses.en: And may Allah bless our master and patron Muhammad, and his family and companions, and grant them abundant peace.

DALAIL_CHAPTERS.note: The first portion of Monday's ḥizb, opening with the section on the manner of invoking blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ. A long sequence of ṣalawāt is followed by the duʿāʾ that is hoped to be answered, recited after the blessings.

verses.ar: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
verses.tr: Bismi-Llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm
verses.en: In the name of Allah, the All-Merciful, the Most Merciful.

verses.ar: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ
verses.tr: Ṣallā llāhu ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi wa sallam.
verses.en: Allah’s blessings and peace be upon our lord and master Muhammad and upon his family and Companions.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ ۞ وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa azwājihi wa dhurriyyatihi kamā ṣallayta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa azwājihi wa dhurriyyatihi kamā bārakta ʿalā āli sayyidinā Ibrāhīma innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his wives and his descendants, just as You blessed our master Abraham, and sanctify our master Muhammad and his wives and descendants, just as You sanctified our master Abraham. For You are the Praiseworthy, the Mighty.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ ۞ وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihi kamā ṣallayta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā bārakta ʿalā āli sayyidinā Ibrāhīma fī l-ʿālamīna innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his family, just as You blessed our master Abraham, and sanctify our master Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, just as You sanctified our master Abraham and the family of Abraham in all worlds. For You are the Praiseworthy, the Mighty.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ ۞ وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā bārakta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed our master Abraham, and sanctify our master Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, just as You sanctified our master Abraham. For You are the Praiseworthy, the Mighty.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-ummiyyi wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the Unlettered Prophet, and the family of our master Muhammad.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا ‖ مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿabdika wa rasūlik.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, Your slave and Your Messenger.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Ibrāhīma innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham. For You are the Praiseworthy, the Mighty.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā bārakta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Ibrāhīma innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, sanctify our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You sanctified our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham. For You are the Praiseworthy, the Mighty.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَتَرَحَّمْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَرَحَّمْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa tarraḥam ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā tarraḥamta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Ibrāhīma innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, be merciful to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You were merciful to our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham. For You are the Praiseworthy, the Mighty.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَتَحَنَّنْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَحَنَّنْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa taḥannan ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā taḥannanta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Ibrāhīma innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, be kind to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You were kind to our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham. For You are the Praiseworthy, the Mighty.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا سَلَّمْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa sallim ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā sallamta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Ibrāhīma innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, grant peace to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You granted peace to our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham. For You are the Praiseworthy, the Mighty.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَارْحَمْ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا وَآلَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَرَحِمْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي ‖ الْعَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-rḥam sayyidinā Muḥammadan wa-āla sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta wa-raḥimta wa-bārakta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Ibrāhīma fī l-ʿālamīna innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and be merciful to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and sanctify our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed, were merciful to, and sanctified our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham in the worlds. For You are the Praiseworthy, the Mighty.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ أُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi wa azwājihi ummahāti l-mu’minīna wa dhurriyyatihi wa ahli baytihi kamā ṣallayta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the Prophet, and his wives, the Mothers of the Believers, and his descendants and the People of his House, just as You blessed our master Abraham. For You are the Praiseworthy, the Mighty.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā bārakta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You bless our master Abraham. For You are the Praiseworthy, the Mighty.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ دَاحِيَ الْمَدْحُوَّاتِ، وَبَارِئَ الْمَسْمُوكَاتِ، وَجَبَّارَ الْقُلُوبِ عَلٰى فِطْرَتِهَا شَقِيِّهَا وَسَعِيدِهَا، اجْعَلْ شَرَائِفَ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَنَوَامِيَ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَرَأْفَةَ تَحَنُّنِكَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ الْفَاتِحِ لِمَا أُغْلِقَ، وَالخَاتِمِ لِمَا سَبَقَ، وَالمُعْلِنِ الْحَقَّ بِالحَقِّ، وَالدَّامِغِ لِجَيْشَاتِ الْأَبَاطِيلِ كَمَا حُمِّلَ، فَاضْطَلَعَ بِأَمْرِكَ بِطَاعَتِكَ، مُسْتَوْفِزًا فِي مَرْضَاتِكَ، وَاعِيًا لِوَحْيِكَ، حَافِظًا لِعَهْدِكَ، مَاضِيًا عَلٰى نَفَاذِ أَمْرِكَ، حَتَّى أَوْرَى قَبَسًا لِقَابِسٍ، آلَاءُ اللّٰهِ تَصِلُ بِأَهْلِهِ ‖ أَسْبَابَهُ، بِهِ هُدِيَتِ الْقُلُوبُ بَعْدَ خَوْضَاتِ الْفِتَنِ وَالإِثْمِ، وَأَبْهَجَ مُوضِحَاتِ الْأَعْلَامِ، وَنَائِرَاتِ الْأَحْكَامِ، وَمُنِيرَاتِ الْإِسْلَامِ، فَهُوَ أَمِينُكَ الْمَأْمُونُ، وَخَازِنُ عِلْمِكَ الْمَخْزُونِ، وَشَهِيدُكَ يَوْمَ الدِّينِ، وَبَعِيثُكَ نِعْمَةً، وَرَسُولُكَ بِالْحَقِّ رَحْمَةً
verses.tr: Allāhumma dāḥiya l-madḥūwāti wa bāri’a l-masmūkāti wa jabbāra l-qulūbi ʿalā fiṭratihā shaqiyyihā wa saʿīdihā, ijʿal sharā’ifa ṣalawātika wa nawāmi barakātika wa ra’fata taḥannunika ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿabdika wa rasūlika, al-fātiḥi limā ughliqa wa l-khātimi limā sabaqa wa l-muʿlini l-ḥaqqa bi-l-ḥaqqi wa d-dāmiġi li-jayshāti l-abāṭīli, kamā ḥummila fa-ḍṭalaʿa bi-amrika bi-ṭāʿatika, mustawfiẓan fī marḍātika, wāʿiyal li-waḥyika, ḥāfiẓan li-ʿahdika, māḍiyan ʿalā nafādhi amrika, ḥattā awrā qabasan li-qābisin, ālā’u llāhi taṣilu bi-ahlihi asbābahu, bihi hudiya ti l-qulūbu baʿda khawḍāti l-fitani wa l-ithmi, wa abhaja muḍiḥāti l-aʿlāmi, wa nā’irāti l-aḥkāmi, wa munīrāti l-islāmi, fa-huwa amīnuka l-ma’mūnu, wa khāzinu ʿilmika l-makhzūni, wa shahīduka yawma d-dīni, wa baʿīthuka niʿmatan wa rasūluka bi-l-ḥaqqi raḥmah.
verses.en: O Allah, the Leveller of the plains, the Maker of the firmament, and the Moulder of hearts into the good and the bad, grant Your noblest blessings, most fruitful favours, and most loving kindness to our master Muhammad, Your slave and Your Messenger, the Opener of what was locked and the Seal of what has gone before, the announcer of truth with truth, and the refuter of the forces of falsehood. He took upon himself the responsibility of Your command in obedience to You, speedily seeking Your pleasure, earnestly heeding Your revelation, keeping Your promise, carrying out and executing Your command, so that, by kindling a burning brand for the seeker, his family gain access through him to the blessings of Allah. Hearts were guided through him after having entered into discord and sin, and he gladdened with evident signs, with enlightening laws and illuminating Islam. And he is Your trustworthy one and safe custodian of Your secret knowledge, Your witness on the Day of Judgement and Your envoy, a favour for us and Your Messenger, in truth, a mercy for us.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ افْسَحْ لَهُ فِي عَدْنِكَ، وَاجْزِهِ مُضَاعَفَاتِ الْخَيْرِ مِن فَضْلِكَ مُهَنَّئَاتٍ لَهُ غَيْرَ مُكَدَّرَاتٍ، مِنْ فَوْزِ ثَوَابِكَ الْمَحْلُولِ، وَجَزِيلِ عَطَائِكَ الْمَعْلُولِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ifsaḥ lahu fī ʿadnika, wa jzihi muḍāʿafāti l-khayri min faḍlika muhannātin lahu ghayra mukaddarātin min fawzi thawābika l-maḥlūli wa jazīli ʿaṭā’ika l-maʿlūl.
verses.en: O Allah, widen for him his place in Your Eden and reward him doubly with the goodness of Your favour, granting him untarnished felicitations from the victory of Your reward, which is plentiful and fitting, and from Your lofty gift.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ أَعْلِ عَلٰى بِنَاءِ النَّاسِ بِنَاءَهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ مَثْوَاهُ لَدَيْكَ وَنُزُلَهُ، وَأَتْمِمْ لَهُ نُورَهُ، وَاجْزِهِ مِنِ ابْتِعَاثِكَ لَهُ مَقْبُولَ الشَّهَادَةِ، وَمَرْضِيَّ الْمَقَالَةِ، ذَا مَنْطِقٍ عَدْلٍ، وَخُطَّةٍ فَصْلٍ، وَبُرْهَانٍ عَظِيمٍ ۞ ﴿إِنَّ اللّٰهَ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتَهۥ يُصَلُّونَ عَلٰى النَّبِىِّ ۚ يـٰٓأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ صَلُّواْ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُواْ تَسْلِيمًا ﴾ ۞ لَبَّيْكَ اللّٰهُمَّ رَبِّى ‖ وَسَعْدَيْكَ صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهِ الْبَرِّ الرَّحِيمِ، وَالمَلَائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ، وَالنَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ، وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ، وَمَا سَبَّحَ لَكَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۞ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ، خَاتِمِ النَّبِيِّينَ، وَسَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَإِمَامِ الْمُتَّقِينَ، وَرَسُولِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، الشَّاهِدِ الْبَشِيرِ، الدَّاعِي إِلَيْكَ بِإِذْنِكَ، السِّرَاجِ الْمُنِيرِ، وَعَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma aʿli ʿalā binā’i n-nāsi binā’ahu, wa akrim mathwāhu ladayka wa nuzulahu, wa atmim lahu nūrahu, wa jzihi min ibʿāthika lahu maqbūla sh-shahādahi, wa marḍiyya l-maqālati, dhā manṭiqin ʿadlin wa khuṭṭatin faṣlin wa burhānin ʿaẓīm. Inna llāha wa malā’ikatahu yuṣallūna ʿalā n-nabiyyi, yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū ṣallū ʿalayhi wa sallimū taslīmā. Labbayka llāhumma rabbī wa saʿdayka, ṣalawātu llāhi l-barri r-raḥīmi, wa l-malā’ikati l-muqarrabīna, wa n-nabiyyīna wa ṣ-ṣiddīqīna, wa sh-shuhadā’i wa ṣ-ṣāliḥīna, wa mā sabbaḥa laka min shay’in yā rabba l-ʿālamīna, ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ibn ʿAbdillāh, khātami n-nabiyyīna, wa sayyidi l-mursalīna, wa imāmi l-muttaqīna, wa rasūli rabbi l-ʿālamīna, ash-shāhidi l-bashīri, ad-dāʿī ilayka bi-idhnika, as-sirāji l-munīri, wa ʿalayhi s-salām.
verses.en: O Allah, raise that which he has built up over all that mankind has built up, and ennoble his place and his sojourn with You, and complete for him his light and reward him with Your approval so that his testimony is accepted and his word is pleasing to You, making him the one whose utterance is just and whose course is distinct and whose argument is mighty. Verily, Allah and His Angels bless the Prophet. O you who believe, ask Allah to bless him and grant him abundant peace. I am here, O Allah, at Your service and at Your command, my Lord. The blessings of Allah, the Good, the Merciful, and of His closest angels and of the Prophets and of the sincere ones, and of the martyrs and of the good ones, and whatever else exists, which glorifies You, O Lord of the Worlds, are for our master Muhammad, son of Abdullah, the Seal of the Prophets and Master of the Messengers, the Leader of the Pious and the Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds, the Witness, the Bringer of Good Tidings, the Caller to You by Your leave, the Lamp, the illuminated one upon him be peace.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَبَرَكَاتِكَ وَرَحْمَتَكَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَإِمَامِ الْمُتَّقِينَ، وَخَاتِمِ النَّبِيِّينَ، سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِك، إِمَامِ الْخَيْرِ، وَقَائِدِ الْخَيْرِ، وَرَسُولِ الرَّحْمَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ijʿal ṣalawātika wa barakātika wa raḥmataka ʿalā sayyidi l-mursalīna, wa imāmi l-muttaqīna, wa khātimi n-nabiyyīna, sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿabdika wa rasūlika, imāmi l-khayri, wa qā’idi l-khayri, wa rasūli r-raḥmah.
verses.en: O Allah, grant Your blessings and Your favours and Your mercy to the Master of the Messengers and the Leader of the Pious and Seal of the Prophets, our master Muhammad, Your slave and Your Messenger, the Pioneer of Goodness and Guide to the Goodness, the Messenger of Mercy.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ ابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُودًا يَغْبِطُهُ فِيهِ الْأَوَّلُونَ وَالآخِرُونَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ibʿathhu maqāman maḥmūdan yaghbiṭuhu fīhi l-awwalūna wa l-ākhirūna.
verses.en: O Allah, send him to the Most Praised Station, the envy of those who came first and those who came last.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed our master Abraham. For You are the Praiseworthy, the Mighty.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا ‖ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā bārakta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, sanctify our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You sanctified our master Abraham. For You are the Praiseworthy, the Mighty.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ وَأَوْلَادِهِ، وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَأَصْهَارِهِ، وَأَنْصَارِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ، وَمُحِبِّيهِ وَأُمَّتِهِ وَعَلَيْنَا مَعَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā ālihi wa-aṣḥābihi wa-awlādihi wa-azwājihi wa-dhurriyyatihi wa-ahl baytihi wa-aṣhārihi wa-anṣārihi wa-ashyāʿihi wa-muḥibbīhi wa-ummatihi wa-ʿalaynā maʿahum ajmaʿīna yā arḥama r-rāḥimeen.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, his family, his Companions, his children, his wives, his descendants, the People of his House, his relations by marriage, his Helpers, his adherents, his lovers, his nation, and all of us along with them, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَّمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَمَرْتَنَا بِالصَّلاةِ عَلَيْهِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ كَمَا يُحِبُّ أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada man ṣallā ʿalayhi, wa-ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada man lam yuṣalli ʿalayhi, wa-ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā amartanā biṣ-ṣalāti ʿalayhi, wa-ṣalli ʿalayhi kamā yuḥibbu an yuṣallā ʿalayhi.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad as many times as those who have asked for his blessings upon him, and bless our master Muhammad as many times as those who have not asked for his blessings upon him. And bless him as we have been ordered to ask You to bless him, and bless him just as he loves to be blessed.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَمَرْتَنَا أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā amartanā an nuʿsalliya ‘alayhi.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as we have been ordered to ask for blessings upon him.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā huwa ahluhu.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as he deserves.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَاهُ لَهُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā tuḥibbu wa-tarḍāhu lahū.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad just as You like and just as You are pleased with him.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا رَبَّ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَعْطِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدَ نِ الدَّرَجَةَ وَالوَسِيلَةَ ‖ فِي الْجَنَّةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma yā rabba sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-aʿṭi sayyidanā Muḥammadan ad-darajata wa-l-wasīlata fī l-jannati.
verses.en: O Allah, O Lord of our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and grant to our master Muhammad the rank of the Closest Access in the Garden.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا رَبَّ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، اِجْزِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma yā rabba sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ijzi sayyadinā Muḥammadan ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallama mā huwa ahluhu.
verses.en: O Allah, O Lord of our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, reward our master Muhammad, may Allah bless him and give him peace just as he is deserving.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā ahl baytihi.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad and the People of his House.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ شَيْءٌ ۞ وَارْحَمْ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا وَآلَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ شَيْءٌ ۞ وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى مِنَ الْبَرَكَةِ شَيْءٌ ۞ وَسَلِّمْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى مِنَ السَّلَامِ شَيْءٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ḥattā lā yabqā mina ṣ-ṣalāti shayʾun, wa-rḥam sayyidinā Muḥammadan wa-āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ḥattā lā yabqā mina r-raḥmati shayʾun, wa-bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ḥattā lā yabqā mina l-barakāti shayʾun, wa-sallim ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ḥattā lā yabqā mina s-salāmi shayʾun.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad until there remains not a single drop of blessings. O Allah, favour our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad until there remains not a single drop of favour. O Allah, have mercy on our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad until there remains not a single drop of mercy. O Allah, grant peace to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad until there remains not a single drop of peace.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْأَوَّلِينَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي النَّبِيِّينَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْمُرْسَلِينَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْمَلَا الْأَعْلَى إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin fī l-awwalīna, wa-ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin fī l-ākhirīna, wa-ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin fī n-nabiyyīna, wa-ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin fī l-mursalīna, wa-ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin fī l-malaʾi l-aʿlā ilā yawmi d-dīn.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad among the first, bless our master Muhammad among the last, bless our master Muhammad among the Prophets, bless our master Muhammad among the Messengers, and bless our master Muhammad in the Heavenly Assembly until the Day of Reckoning.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ أَعْطِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدَ نِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَالشَّرَفَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الْكَبِيرَةَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma aʿṭi sayyidinā Muḥammadan al-wasīlata wa-l-faḍīlata wa-sh-sharafa wa-d-darajata l-kabīrata.
verses.en: O Allah grant our master Muhammad the position of the Closest Access the Pre-eminence and the noblest and greatest rank.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ ‖ إِنِّي آمَنْتُ بِسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَلَمْ أَرَهُ، فَلَا تَحْرِمْنِي فِي الْجِنَانِ رُؤْيَتَهُ، وَارْزُقْنِي صُحْبَتَهُ، وَتَوَفَّنِي عَلٰى مِلَّتِهِ، وَاسْقِنِي مِنْ حَوْضِهِ مَشْرَبًا رَّوِيًّا، سَائِغًا هَنِيْئًا، لَا نَظْمَأُ بَعْدَهُ أَبَدًا، إِنَّكَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma innī āmantu bi-sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-lam arahu fa-lā taḥrimnī fī l-jināni ruʾyatahu wa-rzuqnī ṣuḥbatahu wa-tawaffanī ʿalā millatihi wa-sqinī min ḥawḍihi mashraban rawiyyān sāʾighan hanīʾan lā naẓmaʾu baʿdahu abadan innaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.
verses.en: O Allah I have believed in our master Muhammad and I have not seen him so do not deprive my heart of a vision of him and provide me with his companionship and have me die on his way and lead me to drink after from his Pool plentifully, blissfully, heartily, a drink after which we will never feel thirst. Indeed, You have Power over all things.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ أَبْلِغْ رُوحَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِنِّي تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَامًا
verses.tr: Allāhumma abliġ rūḥa sayyidinā Muḥammadin minnī taḥiyyatan wa-salāman.
verses.en: O Allah send to the soul of our master Muhammad my greetings and my salutations.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَكَمَا آمَنْتُ بِهِ وَلَمْ أَرَهُ، فَلَا تَحْرِمْنِي فِي الْجِنَانِ رُؤْيَتَهُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa-kamā āmantu bihi wa-lam arahu fa-lā taḥrimnī fī l-jināni ruʾyatahu.
verses.en: O Allah just as I have believed in him without seeing him, so do not deprive my heart of a vision of him.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ شَفَاعَةَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ نِ الْكُبْرَى، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ الْعُلْيَا، وَآتِهِ سُؤْلَهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ وَالْأُولَى، كَمَا آتَيْتَ سَيِّدَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَسَيِّدَنَا مُوسَى
verses.tr: Allāhumma taqabbal shafāʿata sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-kubrā wa-rfaʿ darajatahu l-ʿulyā wa-ātihi suʾlahu fī l-ākhirati wa-l-ūlā kamā ātayta sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa-sayyidinā Mūsā.
verses.en: O Allah accept the great intercession of our master Muhammad, raise his rank high and give him that which asks for in the Hereafter and in this Present life just as You gave to our master Abraham and our liege-lord Moses.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ ۞ وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Ibrāhīma, wa-bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā bārakta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa-ʿalā āli sayyidinā Ibrāhīma innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad just as You blessed our master Abraham and the family of Abraham and sanctify our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad just as You sanctified our master Abraham and the family of Abraham for are the Praiseworthy, the Mighty.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُولِكَ، وَسَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِكَ وَصَفِيِّكَ، وَسَيِّدِنَا مُوسَى ‖ كَلِيمِكَ وَنَجِيِّكَ، وَسَيِّدِنَا عِيسَى رُوحِكَ وَكَلِمَتِكَ، وَعَلٰى جَمِيعِ مَلَائِكَتِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ وَأَنْبِيَائِكَ، وَخِيَرَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَأَصْفِيَائِكَ، وَخَاصَّتِكَ وَأَوْلِيَائِكَ مِنْ أَهْلِ أَرْضِكَ وَسَمَائِكَ ۞ وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ، وَكَمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ، وَكُلَّمَا ذَكَرَهُ الذَّاكِرُونَ، وَغَفَلَ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِ الْغَافِلُونَ، وَعَلٰى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ، وَعِتْرَتِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمًا
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyika wa-rasūlika wa-ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma khalīlika wa-ṣafiyyika wa-ʿalā sayyidinā Mūsā kalīmika wa-najiyyika wa-ʿalā sayyidinā ʿĪsā rūḥika wa-kalimatika wa-ʿalā jamīʿi malāʾikatika wa-rusulika wa-anbiyāʾika wa-khīratika min khalqika wa-aṣfiyāʾika wa-khāṣṣatika wa-awliyāʾika min ahli arḍika wa-samāʾika, wa ṣallā llāhu ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada khalqihi wa riḍā nafsihi wa zinata ʿarshihi wa midāda kalimātihi, wa kamā huwa ahluhu, wa kullamā dhakarahu dh-dhākirūna wa ghafala ʿan dhikrihi l-ghāfilūna, wa ʿalā ahli baytihi wa ʿitratihi ṭ-ṭāhirīna, wa sallama taslīma.
verses.en: O Allah, bless, sanctify and grant peace to our master Muhammad Your prophet, Your Prophet, Your Messenger. And also our master Abraham, Your Friend and Pure one and our liege-lord Moses, Your Interlocutor and Intimate. And also our liege-lord Jesus, Your Spirit and Word, all the angels, Messengers and Prophets, the righteous ones from Your creation, the pure ones, the elected ones and Your saints from the folk of Your earth and Your heaven. And may Allah's blessings be for our master Muhammad in all of His creation, to the extent of His pleasure in the decoration of the Throne in the ink of His words, to the measure that he deserves, and whenever those who remember him do so and whenever those who neglect to remember him do so, and may these blessings be also for the People of his House and the pure perfumed descendants, on whom may there be peace, over and over again.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، وَعَلٰى جَمِيعِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالمُقَرَّبِينَ، وَجَمِيعِ عِبَادِ اللّٰهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، عَدَدَ مَا أَمْطَرَتِ السَّمَاءُ مُنْذُ بَنَيْتَهَا ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَنْبَتَتِ الْأَرْضُ مُنْذُ دَحَوْتَهَا ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا ‖ مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ النُّجُومِ فِي السَّمَاءِ فَإِنَّكَ أَحْصَيْتَهَا ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا تَنَفَّسَتِ الْأَرْوَاحُ مُنْذُ خَلَقْتَهَا ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ وَمَا تَخْلُقُ، وَمَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ وَأَضْعَافَ ذٰلِكَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā azwājihi wa dhurriyyatihi, wa ʿalā jamīʿi n-nabiyyīna wa l-mursalīna, wa l-malā’ikati wa l-muqarrabīna, wa jamīʿi ʿibādi llāhi ṣ-ṣāliḥīna, ʿadada mā amṭarati s-samā’u mundhu banaytahā, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā anbata ti l-arḍu mundhu daḥawtahā, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada n-nujūmi fī s-samā’i, fa-innaka aḥṣaytahā, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā tanaffasati l-arwāḥu mundhu khalaqtahā, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā khalaqta wa mā takhluqu wa mā aḥāṭa bihi ʿilmuka wa aḍʿāfa dhālika.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his wives and progeny and all the Prophets and Messengers and closest angels and all the righteous slaves of Allah in all the rain sky has rained since it was formed and bless our master Muhammad in everything the earth has produced since it was spread out. And bless our master Muhammad as many times as there are stars in the sky and You alone are their counter. And bless our master Muhammad in every breath of every soul from the moment You created them. And bless our master Muhammad in everything You have already created and in what You will create and in whatever is encompassed by Your Knowledge and then double all of that.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ عَدَدَ خَلْقِكَ، وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِكَ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ، وَمَبْلَغَ عِلْمِكَ وَآيَاتِكَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalayhim ʿadada khalqika, wa riḍā nafsika, wa zinata ʿarshika, wa midāda kalimātika, wa mablaġa ʿilmika, wa āyātik.
verses.en: O Allah, bless them in all of Your Creation and as much as it pleases Yourself, in the decoration of Your Throne, in the ink Your Words and to the extent of Your Knowledge and Signs.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَاةً تَفُوقُ وَتَفْضُلُ صَلَاةَ الْمُصَلِّينَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ الْخَلْقِ أَجْمَعِينَ، كَفَضْلِكَ عَلٰى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalayhim ṣalātan tafūqu wa tafḍulu ṣalāta l-muṣallīna ʿalayhim mina l-khalqi ajmaʿīna ka-faḍlika ʿalā jamīʿi khalqik.
verses.en: O Allah, bless them, with blessings excellent and more gracious, with blessings equal to all requests for blessings ever uttered by the whole of creation just as in like measure the whole of creation enjoys Your favour.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً مُّسْتَمِرَّةَ الدَّوَامِ، عَلٰى مَرِّ اللَّيَالِي وَالأَيَّامِ، مُتَّصِلَةَ الدَّوَامِ، لَا انْقِضَاءَ لَهَا وَلَا انْصِرَامَ، عَلٰى مَرِّ اللَّيَالِي وَالْأَيَّامِ، عَدَدَ كُلِّ وَابِلٍ وَطَلٍّ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalayhim ṣalātan dā’imatan mustamirra d-dawāmi, ʿalā marri l-layāli wa l-ayyāmi, muttasilata ad-dawām, lā inqiḍā’a lahā wa lā inṣirāma, ʿalā marri l-layāli wa-l-ayyām ʿadada kulli wābilin wa-ṭallin.
verses.en: O Allah, bless them, with eternal and permanent blessings, for as long as the duration of all future nights and days, never-ending and perpetual, with blessings equal to the duration of all the days and nights which have already passed with blessings as copious as the rain contained in every downpour and in every shower which have ever fallen.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ، وَسَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِكَ، وَعَلٰى جَمِيعِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَأَصْفِيَائِكَ، مِنْ ‖ أَهْلِ أَرْضِكَ وَسَمَائِكَ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِكَ وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِكَ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ وَمُنْتَهَى عِلْمِكَ، وَزِنَةَ جَمِيعِ مَخْلُوقَاتِكَ، صَلَاةً مُكَرَّرَةً أَبَدًا، عَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَى عِلْمُكَ، وَمِلْءَ مَا أَحْصَى عِلْمُكَ، وَأَضْعَافَ مَا أَحْصَى عِلْمُكَ، صَلَاةً تَزِيدُ وَتَفُوقُ وَتَفْضُلُ صَلَاةَ الْمُصَلِّينَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ الْخَلْقِ أَجْمَعِينَ، كَفَضْلِكَ عَلٰى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyika wa sayyidinā Ibrāhīma khalīlika wa-ʿalā jamīʿi anbiyāʾika wa-aṣfiyāʾika min ahli arḍika wa-samāʾika ʿadada khalqika wa-riḍā nafsika wa-zinata ʿarshika wa-midāda kalimātika wa-muntahā ʿilmika wa-zinata jamīʿi makhlūqātika ṣalātan mukarraratan abadan ʿadada mā aḥṣā ʿilmuka wa-milʾa mā aḥṣā ʿilmuka wa-aḍʿāfa mā aḥṣā ʿilmuka ṣalātan tazīdu wa-tafūqu wa-tafḍulu ṣalāta l-muṣallīna ʿalayhim mina l-khalqi ajmaʿīna ka-faḍlika ʿalā jamīʿi khalqika.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad Your Prophet, and our master Abraham, your Friend, and all the Prophets and pure ones from the folk of Your earth and Your heaven, in all of Your creation and as it pleases Yourself, in the decoration of Your Throne, in the ink of Your words, to the extent of Your Knowledge and Adornment of Your created beings with blessings repeated eternally as much as Your knowledge and to the depth of Your Knowledge and then double this with blessings, abundant and excellent and gracious, blessings equal to all the requests for blessings ever uttered by all of creation just as in like measure the whole of creation enjoys Your favour.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ تَدْعُو بِهٰذَا الدُّعَاءِ فَإِنَّهُ مَرْجُوٌّ الْإِجَابَةِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ عَلٰى النَّبِيِّ صَلَى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
verses.tr: Thumma tadʿū bihādhā d-duʿāʾi fa-innahu marjūwu l-ijābati in shāʾa llāhu ba'ada ṣ-ṣalāti ʿalā n-nabiyy ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam.
verses.en: Then make this supplication, for it is to be hoped it will be answered, Allah willing after asking for blessings upon the Prophet, may Allah grant him peace.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِمَّنْ لَزِمَ مِلَّةَ نَبِيِّكَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ۞ وَعَظَّمَ حُرْمَتَهُ ۞ وَأَعَزَّ كَلِمَتَهُ ۞ وَحَفِظَ عَهْدَهُ وَذِمَّتَهُ ۞ وَنَصَرَ حِزْبَهُ ۞ وَدَعْوَتَهُ ۞ وَكَثَّرَ تَابِعِيهِ وَفِرْقَتَهُ ۞ وَوَافَى زُمْرَتَهُ ۞ وَلَمْ يُخَالِفْ سَبِيلَهُ وَسُنَّتَهُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ajʿalnī mimman lazima millata nabiyyika sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam, wa-ʿaẓẓama ḥurmatahu, wa-aʿazza kalimatuhu, wa-ḥafiẓa ʿahdahu wa-dhimmatahu, wa-naṣara ḥizbahu, wa-daʿwatuhu, wa-kaththara tābiʿīhi wa-firqatahu, wa-wāfā zumratuhu, wa-lam yukhālif sabīlahu wa-sunnatahu.
verses.en: O Allah grant me to be from among those who stick close to the way of Your Prophet, our master Muhammad, the blessings of Allah be always upon him. Strengthen his holiness, empower his words, protect his promise and security, and give victory to his party and calling and increase those who pledge him and his company allegiance. And grant that we may die in his company and do not allow us to stray from his path and way.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ ‖ الْاِسْتِمْسَاكَ بِسُنَّتِهِ ۞ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْإِنْحِرَافِ عَمَّا جَاءَ بِهِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka al-istimsāka bi-sunnatihi, wa-aʿūdhu bika mina l-inḥirāfi ʿammā jāʾa bihi.
verses.en: O Allah, I ask You the for loyalty to his way and seek refuge in You from all deviation from it.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ مِنْهُ سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ نَبِيُّكَ وَرَسُولُكَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ۞ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا اسْتَعَاذَكَ مِنْهُ سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ نَّبِيُّكَ وَرَسُولُكَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka min khayri mā saʾalaka minhu sayyidinā Muḥammadu nabiyyuka wa-rasūluka ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam, wa-aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā istaʿādhaka minhu sayyidinā Muḥammadu nabiyyuka wa-rasūluka ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam.
verses.en: O Allah I ask of You the good that our master Muhammad, Your Prophet and Your Messenger (may Allah grant him peace and bless him) asked of You, and I seek refuge in You from the evil from which our master Muhammad Your Prophet and Your Messenger (may Allah grant him peace and bless him) sought refuge.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنْ شَرِّ الْفِتَنِ ۞ وَعَافِنِي مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمِحَنِ ۞ وَأَصْلِحْ مِنِّي مَا ظَهَرَ وَمَا بَطَنَ ۞ وَنَقِّ قَلْبِي مِنَ الْحِقْدِ وَالْحَسَدِ ۞ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ عَلَيَّ تِبَاعَةً لِّأَحَدٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma iʿṣimnī min sharri l-fitani, wa-ʿāfinī min jamīʿi l-miḥani, wa-aṣliḥ minnī mā ẓahara wa-mā baṭana, wa-naqqi qalbī mina l-ḥiqdi wa-l-ḥasadi, wa-lā tajʿal ʿalayya tibāʿatan li-aḥadin.
verses.en: O Allah protect me from evil of discord and absolve me from all tests and purify me from within and without and cleanse my heart from hatred and envy and do not allow anyone to oppress me.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْأَخْذَ بِأَحْسَنِ مَا تَعْلَمُ ۞ وَالتَّرْكَ لِسَيِّئِ مَا تَعْلَمُ ۞ وَأَسْأَلُكَ التَّكَفُّلَ بِالرِّزْقِ ۞ وَالزُّهْدَ فِي الْكَفَافِ ۞ وَالمَخْرَجَ بِالْبَيَانِ مِنْ كُلِّ شُبْهَةٍ ۞ وَالْفَلَجَ بِالصَّوَابِ فِي كُلِّ حُجَّةِ ۞ وَالْعَدْلَ فِي الْغَضَبِ وَالرِّضَى، وَالتَّسْلِيمَ لِمَا يَجْرِي بِهِ الْقَضَاءُ ۞ ‖ وَالْاِقْتِصَادَ فِي الْفَقْرِ وَالْغِنَى ۞ وَالتَّوَاضُعَ فِي الْقَوْلِ وَالْفِعْلِ ۞ وَالصِّدْقَ فِي الْجِدِّ وَالْهَزْلِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka al-akhdha bi-aḥsani mā taʿlamu, wa-t-tarka li-sayyiʾi mā taʿlamu, wa-asʾaluka at-takaffula bir-rizqi, wa-z-zuhda fīl-kafāfi, wal-makhraja bil-bayāni min kulli shubhatan, wal-falaja bi-ṣ-ṣawābi fī kulli ḥujjah, wal-ʿadla fīl-ghaḍabi war-riḍā wat-taslīma limā yajrī bihil-qaḍā, wal-iqtiṣāda fī l-faqri wa-l-ghinā, wa-t-tawāḍuʿa fī l-qawli wal-fiʿli, waṣ-ṣidqa fīl-jiddi wal-hazli.
verses.en: O Allah I ask You for the good that You know and to let me pass by the evil that You know and I ask You to provide me with provision, for indifference to begin physically satisfied, a clear way out from every uncertainty, a proper stance in every argument, justice in anger and pleasure, peace whatever fate ordains, providence in thought and wealth, humility in my words and actions and sincerity in my seriousness and in my jesting.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّ لِي ذُنُوبًا فِيمَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ، وَذُنُوبًا فِيمَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَلْقِكَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma inna lī dhunūban fīmā baynī wa-baynak wa-dhunūban fīmā baynī wa-bayna khalqik.
verses.en: O Allah, indeed there are sins between me and You and there are sins between me and Your creation.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ مَا كَانَ لَكَ مِنْهَا فَاغْفِرْهُ لِي ۞ وَمَا كَانَ مِنْهَا لِخَلْقِكَ فَتَحَمَّلْهُ عَنِّي ۞ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ إِنَّكَ وَاسِعُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma mā kāna laka minhā fa-ghfirhu lī, wa-mā kāna minhā li-khalqika fa-taḥammalhu ʿannī, wa-aghninī bi-faḍlika innaka wāsiʿu l-maghfirati.
verses.en: O Allah, what is this for You, so forgive me my sins and whatever arises from them, bear them for me and enrich me with Your favour, for Your forgiveness spreads wide.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ نَوِّرْ بِالْعِلْمِ قَلْبِي ۞ وَاسْتَعْمِلْ بِطَاعَتِكَ بَدَنِي ۞ وَخَلِّصْ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ سِرِّي ۞ وَاشْغَلْ بِالْاِعْتِبَارِ فِكْرِي ۞ وَقِنِي شَرَّ وَسَاوِسِ الشَّيْطَانِ ۞ وَأَجِرْنِي مِنْهُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ ۞ حَتَّى لَا يَكُونَ لَهُ عَلَيَّ سُلْطَانٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma nawwir bi-l-ʿilmi qalbī, wa-staʿmil bi-ṭāʿatika badanī, wa-khalliṣ mina l-fitani sirrī, wa-shghal bi-l-iʿtibāri fikrī, wa-qinī sharra wasāwisi sh-shayṭāni, wa-ajirnī minhu yā raḥmān, ḥattā lā yakūna lahu ʿalayya sulṭānun.
verses.en: O Allah, enlighten the knowledge of my heart and render my body obedient to You and purify me from inner discord and occupy me with contemplation and protect me from the whisperings of Satan and save me from him, O Compassionate One, until he no longer has any power over me.

DALAIL_CHAPTERS.note: The second ḥizb, recited on Tuesday — a long litany of ṣalawāt naming the Prophet ﷺ by his stations and epithets, opening with the supplication for refuge and closing with peace upon him and praise of the Lord of the worlds. It ends with the opening of the second quarter, an addition recited beyond the day's portion.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا تَعْلَمُ ۞ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا تَعْلَمُ ۞ وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ مِنْ كُلِّ مَا تَعْلَمُ ۞ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ وَلَا نَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka min khayri mā taʿlamu, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā taʿlamu, wa astaghfiruka min kulli mā taʿlamu, innaka taʿlamu wa lā naʿlamu, wa anta ʿallāmu l-ghuyūb.
verses.en: O Allah I ask You the good of what You know and I seek refuge in You from the evil of what You know and I seek Your forgiveness for everything You know, for You indeed know and we do not know and indeed You are the Knower of the Unseen.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ ارْحَمْنِي مِنْ زَمَانِي هٰذَا ۞ وَإِحْدَاقِ الْفِتَنِ وَتَطَاوُلِ أَهْلِ الْجُرْأَةِ عَلَيَّ وَاسْتِضْعَافِهِمْ إِيَّايَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma irḥamnī min zamānī hādhā wa iḥdāqi l-fitani, wa taṭāwuli ahli l-jurāʾati ʿalayya wa istisḍʿāfihim īyāya.
verses.en: O Allah, have mercy on me in this time from the encirclement of discord, from the oppression of the insolent and their deficiencies and all such ills.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنْكَ فِي عِيَاذٍ مَنِيعٍ، وَحِرْزٍ حَصِينٍ، مِنْ جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ حَتَّى تُبَلِّغَنِي أَجَلِي مُعَافًى
verses.tr: Allāhumma ajʿalnī minka fī ʿiyādin manīʿin, wa ḥirzin ḥaṣīnin, min jamīʿi khalqika ḥattā tuballighanī ajalī muʿāfā.
verses.en: O Allah, give me an unassailable refuge in You, an impenetrable protection with You from all of Your creation until I come to a virtuous end.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَنْبَغِي الصَّلَاةُ عَلَيْهِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَجِبُ الصَّلَاةُ عَلَيْهِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَمَرْتَ أَنْ ‖ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ نِ الَّذِي نُورُهُ مِنْ نُورِ الْأَنْوَارِ، وَأَشْرَقَ بِشُعَاعِ سِرِّهِ الْأَسْرَارُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada man ṣallā ʿalayhi, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada man lam yuṣalli ʿalayhi, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā tanbaghī ṣ-ṣalātu ʿalayhi, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā tajibu ṣ-ṣalātu ʿalayhi, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā amarta an yuṣallā ʿalayhi, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī nūruhu min nūri l-anwār, wa ashraqa bi-shuʿāʿi sirrihi l-asrār.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as many times as those who have asked for blessings upon him. O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as many times as those who have not asked for blessings upon him and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad with as much blessings as is fitting for him and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad with as much blessings as is his due. And bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as You have ordered him to be blessed. And, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad whose Light is from the Light of Lights and who with a ray from his Secrets illuminated all Secrets.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الْأَبْرَارِ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ahli baytihi l-abrār ajmaʿīn.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad and upon all of his righteous family members altogether.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ بَحْرِ أَنْوَارِكَ، وَمَعْدِنِ أَسْرَارِكَ، وَلِسَانِ حُجَّتِكَ، وَعَرُوسِ مَمْلَكَتِكَ، وَإِمَامِ حَضْرَتِكَ، وَخَاتِمِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ، صَلَاةً تَدُومُ بِدَوَامِكَ، وَتَبْقَى بِبَقَائِكَ، صَلَاةً تُرْضِيكَ وَتُرْضِيهِ، وَتَرْضَى بِهَا عَنَّا يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihi baḥri anwārika, wa maʿdini asrārika, wa lisāni ḥujjatika, wa ʿarusi mamlakatika, wa imāmi ḥaḍratika, wa khātami anbiyāʾika, ṣalātan tadūmu bi-dawāmika wa tabqā bi-baqāʾika, ṣalātan turḍīka wa turḍīhi, wa tarḍā bihā ʿannā yā arḥama r-rāḥimīn.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his family, the Sea of Your Lights, the Mine of Your Secrets, the Tongue of Your Proof, the Bridegroom of Your Kingdom, the Leader of Your Presence and the Seal of Your Prophets with blessings which last as long as You last and remain as long as You remain, blessings which please You which please him, and which make You pleased with us, O Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ الْحِلِّ وَالْحَرَامِ، وَرَبَّ الْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ، وَرَبَّ الْبَيْتِ الْحَرَامِ، وَرَبَّ الرُّكْنِ وَالمَقَامِ ۞ أَبْلِغْ لِسَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِنَّا السَّلَامَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma rabba l-ḥilli wa l-ḥarām, wa rabba l-mashʿari l-ḥarām, wa rabba l-bayti l-ḥarām, wa rabba r-rukni wa l-maqām, abliġ li-sayyidina wa mawlana muhammadin minnas salaam.
verses.en: O Allah, Lord of the Hil and the Haram, Lord of the Sanctuary, Lord of the Sacred House, and Lord of the Corner and Station of Abraham (these are all places connected with pilgrimage of Mecca). Send peace from us to our liege-lord and master Muhammad.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ سَيِّدِ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالآخِرِينَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin sayyidi l-awwalīna wa l-ākhirīn.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our liege-lord and master Muhammad the master of the First and the Last.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي كُلِّ وَقْتٍ وَحِينٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlāna Muḥammadin fī kulli waqtin wa ḥī.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our liege-lord and master Muhammad at every moment and every instant.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ ‖ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَى إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin fī l-malaʾi l-aʿlā ilā yawm ad-dīn.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our liege-lord and master Muhammad in the Heavenly Assembly until the Day of Judgement.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى تَرِثَ الْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ḥattā taritha l-arḍa wa man ʿalayhā wa anta khayru l-wārithīn.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our liege-lord and master Muhammad until the earth bequeaths itself and what is on it to You and You are the best of those who inherit.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ نِ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ ۞ وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-ummī wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīm, innaka ḥamīdun majīd, wa bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-ummī kamā bārakta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīm, innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our liege-lord and master Muhammad, the Unlettered Prophet, and the family of Muhammad just as You blessed our master Abraham, for You are Praiseworthy, the Mighty. And bless our liege-lord and master Muhammad, the Unlettered Prophet, and the family of Muhammad just as You blessed our master Abraham, for You are Praiseworthy, the Mighty.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ، وَجَرَى بِهِ قَلَمُكَ، وَسَبَقَتْ بِهِ مَشِيئَتُكَ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ مَلَائِكَتُكَ، صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً بِدَوَامِكَ، بَاقِيَةً بِفَضْلِكَ وَإِحْسَانِكَ، إِلَى أَبَدِ الْأَبَدِ، أَبَدًا، لَا نِهَايَةَ لِأَبَدِيَّتِهِ، وَلَا فَنَاءَ لِدَيْمُومِيَّتِهِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā aḥāṭa bihi ʿilmuka, wa jarā bihi qalamuka, wa sabaqat bihi mashīʾatuka, wa ṣallat ʿalayhi malāʾikatuka, ṣalātan dāʾimatan bi-dawāmika, bāqiyatan bi-faḍlika wa iḥsānika, ilā abad al-abad, lā nihāyata li-abadiyyatihā wa lā fanāʾa li-daymūmiyyatih.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all that Your knowledge encompasses, in everything that Your pen writes, in all that Your Will preordains, and as often as Your angels have blessed him, with eternal blessings, lasting as long as You last, remaining, by Your Grace and Your Generosity, until the end of eternity, never-ending, with no beginning to them, and no disappearing of them, for ever and ever.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ ‖ عِلْمُكَ، وَأَحْصَاهُ كِتَابُكَ، وَشَهِدَتْ بِهِ مَلَائِكَتُكَ، وَارْضَ عَنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، وَارْحَمْ أُمَّتَهُ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā aḥāṭa bihi ʿilmuka wa aḥṣāhu kitābuka wa shahidat bihi malāʾikatuka, wa-rḍa ʿan aṣḥābihi wa irḥam ummatahu innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as much as You know him, as much as Your Book encompasses as the witnessing of Your angels and be pleased with his Companions and be merciful on his nations for You are Praiseworthy the Mighty.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى جَمِيعِ أَصْحَابِ سَيِّدِنَا مُّحَمَّدٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā jamīʿi aṣḥābihi sayyidinā Muḥammad.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of the lord Muhammad, and all the Companions of our master Muhammad.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ ۞ وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīm, wa bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā bārakta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīm wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Ibrāhīm fī l-ʿālamīn innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of the lord Muhammad just as You blessed our master Abraham and bless our master Muhammad and the family of the lord Muhammad just as You blessed our master Abraham in all the worlds for You are the Praiseworthy, the Mighty.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ بِخُشُوعِ الْقَلْبِ عِندَ السُّجُودِ ۞ لَكَ يَا سَيِّدِي بِغَيْرِ جُحُودٍ ۞ وَبِكَ يَا اللّٰهُ يَا جَلِيلُ فَلَا شَيْءَ يُدَانِيكَ فِي غَلِيظِ الْعُهُودِ ۞ وَبِكُرْسِيِّكَ الْمُكَلَّلِ بِالنُّورِ إِلَى عَرْشِكَ الْعَظِيمِ الْمَجِيدِ ۞ وَبِمَا كَانَ تَحْتَ عَرْشِكَ حَقًّا ۞ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَخْلُقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَصَوْتَ الرُّعُودِ ۞ ذَاكَ إِذْ كُنْتَ مِثْلَ مَا لَمْ تَزَلْ قَطُّ إِلٰهًا عُرِفْتَ بِالتَّوْحِيدِ ۞ فَاجْعَلْنِي ‖ مِنَ الْمُحِبِّينَ الْمَحْبُوبِينَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ الْعَارِفِيْنَ الْعَاشِقِينَ لَكَ ۞ يَا اللّٰهُ يَا اللّٰهُ يَا اللّٰهُ يَا اللّٰهُ يَا اللّٰهُ يَا اللّٰهُ يَا اللّٰهُ يَا اللّٰهُ يَا وَدُودُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma bi-khushūʿi l-qalbi ʿinda s-sujūd laka yā sayyidī bi-ghayri juḥūd wa bika yā Allāhu yā Jalīl fa-lā shayʾa yudānīka fī ghalīẓi l-ʿuhūd, wa bi-kursiyyika l-mukallali bi-n-nūr ilā ʿarshika l-ʿaẓīm al-majīd, wa bimā kāna taḥta ʿarshika ḥaqqan qabla an takhlaqa s-samāwāti wa ṣawta r-raʿūd, dhāka idh kunta mithla mā lam tazal qaṭṭ ilāhan ʿurifta bi-t-tawḥīd, fajʿalnī mina l-muḥibbīn al-maḥbūbīn al-muqarrabīn al-ʿārifīn al-ʿāshiqīn laka yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Wadūd.
verses.en: O Allah, with heart humbled in prostration before You, You my Lord, with no unbelief, and for Your sake, O Allah, O Sublime. Nothing can match You in inviolable promises. And for the sake of Your Footstool adorned with light as far as Your Mighty and Powerful Throne. And for the sake of that which lay beneath Your Throne truly before You created the Heavens and the sound of Your thunder. And since You are infinite, a deity to be known only through Unity, then count me among Your Lovers, Your Beloved ones, Your Near ones, Your Knowers and Your Desires, O Allah. O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Bestower of Love.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Sayyidinā wa Mawlana Muḥammadin ʿadada mā aḥāṭa bihi ʿilmuka.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our Lord and our patron Muhammad, in a number equal to all that Your knowledge encompasses.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَاهُ كِتَابُكَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Sayyidinā wa Mawlana Muḥammadin ʿadada mā aḥṣāhu kitābuka.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our lord and master Muhammad as much as Your Book has encompassed.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا نَفَذَتْ بِهِ قُدْرَتُكَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Sayyidinā wa Mawlana Muḥammadin ʿadada mā nafadhat bihi qudratuka.
