verses.en: O Allah, just as You chose them as envoys to Your Messengers, trustees over Your Revelation, and witnesses over Your creation; opened for them the folds of Your veils, and let them look upon the hidden things of Your Unseen; chose from among them keepers of Your Garden and bearers of Your Throne; made them the most numerous of Your hosts; favored them above [ordinary] creation; settled them in the highest heavens; kept them free from disobedience and baseness; and sanctified them from every fault and defect — so bless them with everlasting blessings that increase their honor, and make us worthy, through this, of their asking forgiveness for us.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى جَمِيعِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ الَّذِينَ شَرَحْتَ صُدُورَهُمْ، وَأَوْدَعْتَهُمْ حِكْمَتَكَ، وَطَوَّقْتَهُمْ نُبُوَّتَكَ، وَأَنْزَلْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ كُتُبَكَ، وَهَدَيْتَ بِهِمْ خَلْقَكَ، وَدَعَوْا إِلَى تَوْحِيدِكَ، وَشَوَّقُوا إِلَى وَعْدِكَ، وَخَوَّفُوا مِنْ وَعِيدِكَ، وَأَرْشَدُوا إِلَى سَبِيلِكَ، وَقَامُوا بِحُجَّتِكَ وَدَلِيلِكَ ۞ وَسَلِّمِ اللّٰهُمَّ عَلَيْهِمْ تَسْلِيمًا ۞ وَهَبْ لَنَا بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa ṣalli ʿalā jamīʿi anbiyāʾika wa rusulikal ladhīna sharaḥta ṣudūrahum, wa awdaʿtahum ḥikmataka, wa ṭawwaqtahum nubuwwataka, wa anzalta ʿalayhim kutubaka, wa hadayta bihim khalqaka, wa daʿaw ilā tawḥīdika, wa shawwaqū ilā waʿdika, wa khawwafū min waʿīdika, wa arshadū ilā sabīlika, wa qāmū bi ḥujjatika wa dalīlika, wa sallimi Allāhumma ʿalayhim taslīmā, wa hab lanā biṣ ṣalāti ʿalayhim ajran ʿaẓīmā
verses.en: O Allah, bless all of Your Prophets and Messengers, whose hearts You have opened, to whom You entrusted Your Wisdom, whom You crowned with Your Prophethood, upon whom You sent down Your Books, and by whom You guided Your creation; who called to Your Oneness, gave glad tidings of Your Promise, warned of Your Threat, guided to Your Path, and upheld Your Proof and Your Evidence. Grant them abundant peace, O Allah, and through this asking of blessings upon them, grant us a mighty reward.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً مَقْبُولَةً تُؤَدِّي بِهَا عَنَّا حَقَّهُ الْعَظِيمَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan dāʾimatan maqbūlatan tuʾaddī bihā ʿannā ḥaqqahul ʿaẓīm
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad with blessings everlasting and accepted, through which we discharge his tremendous right over us.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَاحِبِ الْحُسْنِ وَالْجَمَالِ، ‖ وَالْبَهْجَةِ وَالْكَمَالِ، وَالْبَهَاءِ وَالنُّورِ، وَالْوِلْدَانِ وَالْحُورِ، وَالْغُرَفِ وَالْقُصُورِ، وَاللِّسَانِ الشَّكُورِ، وَالْقَلْبِ الْمَشْكُورِ، وَالْعَلَمِ الْمَشْهُورِ، وَالْجَيْشِ الْمَنْصُورِ، وَالْبَنِينَ وَالْبَنَاتِ، وَالْأَزْوَاجِ الطَّاهِرَاتِ، وَالْعُلُوِّ عَلٰى الدَّرَجَاتِ، وَالزَّمْزَمِ وَالْمَقَامِ، وَالْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ، وَاجْتِنَابِ الْآثَامِ، وَتَرْبِيَةِ الْأَيْتَامِ، وَالْحَجِّ وَتِلَاوَةِ الْقُرْآنِ، وَتَسْبِيحِ الرَّحْمٰنِ، وَصِيَامِ رَمَضَانَ، وَاللِّوَاءِ الْمَعْقُودِ، وَالْكَرَمِ وَالْجُودِ، وَالْوَفَاءِ بِالْعُهُودِ، صَاحِبِ الرَّغْبَةِ وَالتَّرْغِيبِ، وَالْبَغْلَةِ وَالنَّجِيبِ، وَالْحَوْضِ وَالْقَضِيبِ، النَّبِيِّ الْأَوَّابِ، النَّاطِقِ بِالصَّوَابِ، الْمَنْعُوتِ فِي الْكِتَابِ، النَّبِيِّ عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ، النَّبِيِّ كَنْزِ اللّٰهِ، النَّبِيِّ حُجَّةِ اللّٰهِ، النَّبِيِّ مَنْ أَطَاعَهُ فَقَدْ أَطَاعَ اللّٰهَ وَمَنْ عَصَاهُ فَقَدْ عَصَى اللّٰهَ، النَّبِيِّ الْعَرَبِيِّ، الْقُرَشِيِّ الزَّمْزَمِيِّ، الْمَكِّيِّ التِّهَامِيِّ، ‖ صَاحِبِ الْوَجْهِ الْجَمِيلِ، وَالطَّرْفِ الْكَحِيلِ، وَالْخَدِّ الْأَسِيلِ، وَالْكَوْثَرِ وَالسَّلْسَبِيلِ ۞ قَاهِرِ الْمُضَادِّينَ، مُبِيدِ الْكَافِرِينَ، وَقَاتِلِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ ۞ قَائِدِ الْغُرِّ الْمُحَجَّلِينَ إِلَى جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ، وَجِوَارِ الْكَرِيمِ ۞ صَاحِبِ سَيِّدِنَا جِبْرِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَرَسُولِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَشَفِيعِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ، وَغَايَةِ الْغَمَامِ، وَمِصْبَاحِ الظَّلَامِ، وَقَمَرِ التَّمَامِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣāḥibil ḥusni wal jamāli, wal bahjati wal kamāli, wal bahāʾi wan nūri, wal wildāni wal ḥūri, wal ghurafi wal quṣūri, wal lisānish shakūri, wal qalbil mashkūri, wal ʿalamil mashhūri, wal jayshil manṣūri, wal banīna wal banāti, wal azwājiṭ ṭāhirāti, wal ʿuluwwi ʿalad darajāti, waz zamzami wal maqāmi, wal mashʿaril ḥarāmi, wajtinābil āthāmi, wa tarbiyatil aytāmi, wal ḥajji wa tilāwatil qurʾāni, wa tasbīḥir raḥmāni, wa ṣiyāmi Ramaḍāna, wal liwāʾil maʿqūdi, wal karami wal jūdi, wal wafāʾi bil ʿuhūdi, ṣāḥibir raghbati wat targhībi, wal baghlati wan najībi, wal ḥawḍi wal qaḍībi, an nabiyyil awwābi, an nāṭiqi biṣ ṣawābi, al manʿūti fil kitābi, an nabiyyi ʿAbdillāhi, an nabiyyi kanzi Llāhi, an nabiyyi ḥujjati Llāhi, an nabiyyi man aṭāʿahu faqad aṭāʿa Llāha wa man ʿaṣāhu faqad ʿaṣā Llāh, an nabiyyil ʿarabiyyi, al qurashiyyiz zamzamiyyi, al makkiyyit tihāmiyyi, ṣāḥibil wajhil jamīli, waṭ ṭarfil kaḥīli, wal khaddil asīli, wal kawthari was salsabīli, qāhiril muḍāddīna, mubīdil kāfirīna, wa qātilil mushrikīna, qāʾidil ghurril muḥajjalīna ilā jannātin naʿīmi, wa jiwāril karīmi, ṣāḥibi sayyidinā Jibrīla ʿalayhis salām, wa rasūli rabbil ʿālamīna, wa shafīʿil mudhnibīna, wa ghāyatil ghamāmi, wa miṣbāḥiẓ ẓalāmi, wa qamarit tamām
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, possessor of beauty and comeliness, of splendor and perfection, of radiance and light, of youthful attendants and maidens of Paradise, of chambers and palaces, of a grateful tongue and a thankful heart, of renowned standing and the victorious army, of sons and daughters, of pure wives, of the loftiest of ranks, of Zamzam and the Station of Abraham, of the Sacred Site, of avoiding sin, of raising orphans, of the Hajj and the recitation of the Qur'an, of glorifying the All-Merciful, of fasting Ramadan, of the bound banner, of nobility and generosity, of keeping covenants; possessor of longing for Allah and of kindling it in others, of the noble mount, of the Pool and the staff; the returning Prophet, the speaker of truth, the one described in the Scriptures; the Prophet, servant of Allah; the Prophet, treasure of Allah; the Prophet, proof of Allah; the Prophet whom to obey is to obey Allah, and whom to disobey is to disobey Allah; the Arab Prophet, of Quraysh, of Zamzam, of Mecca, of Tihamah; possessor of the handsome face, the kohled eyes, the smooth cheek, and the springs of Kawthar and Salsabil; subduer of adversaries, destroyer of unbelievers, slayer of polytheists, leader of those with bright faces and limbs to the Gardens of Bliss and the company of the Generous; companion of our master Gabriel, peace be upon him; Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds, intercessor for sinners, farthest reach of the clouds, lamp of the darkness, and full moon.

verses.ar: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ مِنْ أَطْهَرِ جِبِلَّةٍ، صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً عَلٰى الْأَبَدِ غَيْرَ مُضْمَحِلَّةٍ ۞ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ صَلَاةً يَتَجَدَّدُ بِهَا حُبُورُهُ، وَيُشَرَّفُ بِهَا فِي الْمِيعَادِ بَعْثُهُ وَنُشُورُهُ ۞ فَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ الْأَنْجُمِ الطَّوَالِعِ ۞ صَلَاةً تَجُودُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْوَدَ الْغُيُوثِ الْهَوَامِعِ، أَرْسَلَهُ مِنْ أَرْجَحِ الْعَرَبِ مِيزَانًا، وَأَوْضَحِهَا بَيَانًا، وَأَفْصَحِهَا لِسَانًا، وَأَشْمَخِهَا إِيمَانًا، ‖ وَأَعْلَاهَا مَقَامًا، وَأَحْلَاهَا كَلَامًا، وَأَوْفَاهَا ذِمَامًا، وَأَصْفَاهَا رَغَامًا ۞ فَأَوْضَحَ الطَّرِيقَةَ، وَنَصَحَ الْخَلِيقَةَ، وَشَهَّرَ الْإِسْلَامَ، وَكَسَّرَ الْأَصْنَامَ، وَأَظْهَرَ الْأَحْكَامَ، وَحَظَرَ الْحَرَامَ، وَعَمَّ بِالْإِنْعَامِ
verses.tr: Ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihil muṣṭafayna min aṭhari jibillatin, ṣalātan dāʾimatan ʿalal abadi ghayra muḍmaḥillatin, ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ṣalātan yatajaddadu bihā ḥubūruhu, wa yusharrafu bihā fil mīʿādi baʿthuhu wa nushūruhu, fa ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihil anjumiṭ ṭawāliʿi, ṣalātan tajūdu ʿalayhim ajwadal ghuyūthil hawāmiʿi, arsalahu min arjaḥil ʿarabi mīzānan, wa awḍaḥihā bayānan, wa afṣaḥihā lisānan, wa ashmakhihā īmānan, wa aʿlāhā maqāman, wa aḥlāhā kalāman, wa awfāhā dhimāman, wa aṣfāhā raghāman, fa awḍaḥaṭ ṭarīqata, wa naṣaḥal khalīqata, wa shahharal islāma, wa kassaral aṣnāma, wa aẓharal aḥkāma, wa ḥaẓaral ḥarāma, wa ʿamma bil inʿām
verses.en: May Allah bless him and his family, the Chosen Ones from the purest lineage, with blessings everlasting forever, never fading; may Allah bless him and his family with blessings by which his joy is ever renewed, and by which his resurrection and rising on the Promised Day are honored. So may Allah bless him and his family, the rising stars, with blessings more generous than the most abundant pouring rains. He sent him forth as the most just in measure of all the Arabs, the clearest in explanation, the most eloquent in speech, the loftiest in faith, the highest in station, the sweetest in word, the most faithful to his bond, and the purest in disposition. He made the Way clear, counseled creation, made Islam known, shattered the idols, made the ordinances plain, forbade the unlawful, and encompassed all with his favor.

verses.ar: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ فِي كُلِّ مَحْفِلٍ وَمَقَامٍ، أَفْضَلَ الصَّلَاةِ وَالسَّلَامِ ۞ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ عَوْدًا وَبَدْءًا، صَلَاةً تَكُونُ ذَخِيرَةً وَوِرْدًا ۞ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ صَلَاةً تَامَّةً زَاكِيَةً ۞ وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ صَلَاةً يَتْبَعُهَا رَوْحٌ وَرَيْحَانٌ، وَيَعْقُبُهَا مَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِضْوَانٌ
verses.tr: Ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi fī kulli maḥfilin wa maqāmin, afḍalaṣ ṣalāti was salāmi, ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ʿawdan wa badʾan, ṣalātan takūnu dhakhīratan wa wirdan, ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ṣalātan tāmmatan zākiyyatan, wa ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi ṣalātan yatbaʿuhā rawḥun wa rayḥānun, wa yaʿqubuhā maghfiratun wa riḍwān
verses.en: May Allah's blessings be upon him and his family, in every gathering and station, the finest of blessings and peace; may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family, again and anew, blessings that are a treasure and a constant practice; may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family, complete and pure blessings; and may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family, blessings followed by comfort and fragrance, and succeeded by forgiveness and good pleasure.

verses.ar: وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى أَفْضَلِ مَنْ طَابَ مِنْهُ النِّجَارُ، وَسَمَا بِهِ الْفَخَارُ، وَاسْتَنَارَتْ بِنُورِ جَبِينِهِ الْأَقْمَارُ، وَتَضَاءَلَتْ عِنْدَ جُودِ يَمِينِهِ الْغَمَائِمُ وَالْبِحَارُ ۞ سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الَّذِي بِبَاهِرِ آيَاتِهِ أَضَاءَتِ الْأَنْجَادُ وَالْأَغْوَارُ، ‖ وَبِمُعْجِزَاتِ آيَاتِهِ نَطَقَ الْكِتَابُ وَتَوَاتَرَتِ الْأَخْبَارُ
verses.tr: Wa ṣallallāhu ʿalā afḍali man ṭāba minhun nijāru, wa samā bihil fakhāru, wastanārat bi nūri jabīnihil aqmāru, wa taḍāʾalat ʿinda jūdi yamīnihil ghamāʾimu wal biḥāru, sayyidinā wa nabiyyinā Muḥammadinil ladhī bi bāhiri āyātihi aḍāʾatil anjādu wal aghwāru, wa bi muʿjizāti āyātihi naṭaqal kitābu wa tawātaratil akhbār
verses.en: And may Allah's blessings be upon the finest of those from whom noble lineage sprang, through whom glory was exalted, by the light of whose brow the moons were illumined, before whose generous right hand the clouds and seas seemed small — our master and Prophet Muhammad, through whose dazzling signs the highlands and lowlands were lit, and through whose miraculous verses the Book spoke and reports were transmitted in succession.

verses.ar: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ الَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا لِنُصْرَتِهِ، وَنَصَرُوهُ فِي هِجْرَتِهِ، فَنِعْمَ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ وَنِعْمَ الْأَنْصَارُ ۞ صَلَاةً نَامِيَةً دَائِمَةً مَا سَجَعَتْ فِي أَيْكِهَا الْأَطْيَارُ، وَهَمَعَتْ بِوَبْلِهَا الدِّيمَةُ الْمِدْرَارُ، ضَاعَفَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ دَائِمَ صَلَوَاتِهِ
verses.tr: Ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi wa aṣḥābihil ladhīna hājarū li nuṣratihi, wa naṣarūhu fī hijratihi, fa niʿmal muhājirūna wa niʿmal anṣāru, ṣalātan nāmiyatan dāʾimatan mā sajaʿat fī aykihal aṭyāru, wa hamaʿat bi wablihād dīmatul midrāru, ḍāʿafa Allāhu ʿalayhi dāʾima ṣalawātih
verses.en: May Allah's blessings be upon him, his family, and his Companions who emigrated to aid him and who aided him in his emigration — blessed indeed were the Emigrants, and blessed the Helpers — with blessings that grow and endure for as long as birds coo in their groves and steady, abundant rain pours down; may Allah multiply His everlasting blessings upon him.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الْكِرَامِ، صَلَاةً مَّوْصُولَةً دَائِمَةَ الِاتِّصَالِ بِدَوَامِ ذِي الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihiṭ ṭayyibīnal kirāmi, ṣalātan mawṣūlatan dāʾimatal ittiṣāli bi dawāmi dhil jalāli wal ikrām
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his good and noble family, with blessings joined and perpetually connected, abiding with the abiding of the Possessor of Majesty and Honor.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الَّذِي هُوَ قُطْبُ الْجَلَالَةِ، وَشَمْسُ النُّبُوَّةِ وَالرِّسَالَةِ، وَالْهَادِي مِنَ الضَّلَالَةِ، وَالْمُنْقِذُ مِنَ الْجَهَالَةِ ۞ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةَ الِاتِّصَالِ وَالتَّوَالِي، مُتَعَاقِبَةً بِتَعَاقُبِ الْأَيَّامِ وَاللَّيَالِي
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadinil ladhī huwa quṭbul jalālati, wa shamsun nubuwwati war risālati, wal hādī minaḍ ḍalālati, wal munqidhu minal jahālati, ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallama ṣalātan dāʾimatal ittiṣāli wat tawālī, mutaʿāqibatan bi taʿāqubil ayyāmi wal layālī
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, who is the Pole of Majesty, the Sun of Prophethood and the Message, the Guide away from error, and the Deliverer from ignorance; may Allah bless and grant him peace, with blessings perpetually joined and continuous, succeeding one another as the days and nights succeed one another.

DALAIL_CHAPTERS.note: The eighth ḥizb — a supplementary portion recited on Monday, appended after the seven daily portions are complete. Opens with an extended sequence of ṣalawāt (one verse marked to be recited three times), then moves into a duʿāʾ by the Most Beautiful Names and the Greatest Name, closing with a plea for the knowledge and fear of Allah. The Book Version pagination is still to be set.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الزَّاهِدِ، رَسُولِ الْمَلِكِ الصَّمَدِ الْوَاحِدِ، صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً إِلَى مُنْتَهَى الْأبَدِ، بِلَا انْقِطَاعٍ وَلَا نَفَادٍ، صَلَاةً تُنْجِينَا بِهَا مِنْ حَرِّ جَهَنَّمَ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi z-zāhidi, rasūli l-maliki ṣ-ṣamadi l-wāḥidi, ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallama ṣalātan dāʾimatan ilā muntahā l-abadi, bilā inqiṭāʿin wa lā nafādin, ṣalātan tunjīnā bihā min ḥarri jahannama wa biʾsa l-mihādu
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the ascetic Prophet, the Messenger of the Only Eternal King, and Allah's blessings and peace be upon him — blessings that are eternal, reaching the farthest limit of eternity, with no break or depletion, blessings which save us from the heat of Hellfire, an evil resting place.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَسَلِّمْ، صَلَاةً لَا يُحْصَى لَهَا عَدَدٌ، وَلَا يُعَدُّ لَهَا مَدَدٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-ummiyyi wa ʿalā ālihi wa sallim, ṣalātan lā yuḥṣā lahā ʿadadun, wa lā yuʿaddu lahā madadun
verses.en: O Allah, bless and grant peace to our master Muhammad, the Unlettered Prophet, and his family, blessings which are uncountable and blessings whose supply is never exhausted.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تُكْرِمُ بِهَا مَثْوَاهُ، وَتُبَلِّغُ بِهَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنَ الشَّفَاعَةِ رِضَاهُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tukrimu bihā mathwāhu, wa tuballighu bihā yawma l-qiyāmati mina sh-shafāʿati riḍāhu
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad with blessings that ennoble his abode, and blessings that bring him, on the Day of Judgement, the pleasure of intercession.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأَصِيلِ، السَّيِّدِ النَّبِيلِ، الَّذِي جَاءَ بِالْوَحْيِ وَالتَّنْزِيلِ، وَأَوْضَحَ بَيَانَ التَّأْوِيلِ، وَجَاءَهُ الْأَمِينُ سَيِّدُنَا جِبْرِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، بِالْكَرَامَةِ وَالتَّفْضِيلِ، وَأَسْرَى بِهِ الْمَلِكُ الْجَلِيلُ، فِي اللَّيْلِ الْبَهِيمِ الطَّوِيلِ، فَكَشَفَ لَهُ عَنْ أَعْلَى ‖ الْمَلَكُوتِ، وَأَرَاهُ سَنَاءَ الْجَبَرُوتِ، وَنَظَرَ إِلَى قُدْرَةِ الْحَيِّ الدَّائِمِ الْبَاقِي الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ، صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، صَلَاةً مَّقْرُونَةً بِالْجَمَالِ، وَالْحُسْنِ وَالْكَمَالِ، وَالْخَيْرِ وَالْإِفْضَالِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-aṣīli, s-sayyidi n-nabīli, alladhī jāʾa bi l-waḥyi wa t-tanzīli, wa awḍaḥa bayāna t-taʾwīli, wa jāʾahu l-amīnu sayyidunā Jibrīlu ʿalayhi s-salāmu, bi l-karāmati wa t-tafḍīli, wa asrā bihi l-maliku l-jalīlu, fi l-layli l-bahīmi ṭ-ṭawīli, fakashafa lahu ʿan aʿlā l-malakūti, wa arāhu sanāʾa l-jabarūti, wa naẓara ilā qudrati l-ḥayyi d-dāʾimi l-bāqī lladhī lā yamūtu, ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallama, ṣalātan maqrūnatan bi l-jamāli, wa l-ḥusni wa l-kamāli, wa l-khayri wa l-ifḍāli
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the Prophet of noble origin, the highbred master, who came with inspiration and revelation and made plain the meaning of interpretation; to whom came the trustworthy one, our master Gabriel, peace be upon him, with honor and distinction; whom the Glorious King caused to journey by night through the long, dark night, and unveiled to him the heights of the Kingdom of Heaven, and showed him the splendor of the Omnipotence, and who gazed upon the power of the Living, the Eternal, the Abiding, the One Who never dies. Allah's blessings and peace be upon him — blessings joined with beauty, with charm and perfection, with goodness and grace.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الْأَقْطَارِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ وَرَقِ الْأَشْجَارِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ زَبَدِ الْبِحَارِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الْأَنْهَارِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ رَمْلِ الصَّحَارِي وَالْقِفَارِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ ثِقْلِ الْجِبَالِ وَالْأَحْجَارِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ وَأَهْلِ النَّارِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الْأَبْرَارِ وَالْفُجَّارِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا يَخْتَلِفُ ‖ بِهِ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada l-aqṭāri, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada waraqi l-ashjāri, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada zabadi l-biḥāri, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada l-anhāri, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada ramli ṣ-ṣaḥārī wa l-qifāri, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada thiqli l-jibāli wa l-aḥjāri, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada ahli l-jannati wa ahli n-nāri, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada l-abrāri wa l-fujjāri, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā yakhtalifu bihi l-laylu wa n-nahāru
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as many times as the regions of the earth. And bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as many times as there are leaves on the trees. And bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in as much abundance as there is foam upon the sea. And bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as many times as there are rivers. And bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as many times as there are grains of sand in the desert and in the wilderness. And bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as many times as the weight of all mountains and all rocks. And bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as many times as there are dwellers of the Garden and dwellers of the Fire. And bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as many times as there are righteous ones and as many times as there are corrupt ones. And bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as many times as the night has alternated with the day.

verses.ar: وَاجْعَلِ اللّٰهُمَّ صَلَاتَنَا عَلَيْهِ حِجَابًا مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَسَبَبًا لِإِبَاحَةِ دَارِ الْقَرَارِ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ ۞ وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلٰى آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ ۞ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ الْمُبَارَكِينَ، وَصَحَابَتِهِ الْأَكْرَمِينَ، وَأَزْوَاجِهِ أُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، صَلَاةً مَوْصُولَةً تَتَرَدَّدُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
verses.tr: Wajʿali llāhumma ṣalātanā ʿalayhi ḥijāban min ʿadhābi n-nāri, wa sababan li-ibāḥati dāri l-qarāri, innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-ghaffāru, wa ṣallā llāhu ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin, wa ʿalā ālihi ṭ-ṭayyibīna, wa dhurriyyatihi l-mubārakīna, wa ṣaḥābatihi l-akramīna, wa azwājihi ummahāti l-muʾminīna, ṣalātan mawṣūlatan tataraddadu ilā yawmi d-dīni
verses.en: And make, O Allah, our asking for blessings upon him a shield giving us protection from the punishment of the Fire, and a means of gaining entry to the Abode of Permanence, for You are the Mighty, the Forgiving. And Allah's blessings and peace be upon our master Muhammad, and upon his virtuous family, his blessed descendants, his honored Companions, and his wives, the Mothers of the Believers — blessings continual and frequent until the Day of Judgement.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِ الْأَبْرَارِ، وَزَيْنِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ الْأَخْيَارِ، وَأَكْرَمِ مَنْ أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَأَشْرَقَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهَارُ (3)
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidi l-abrāri, wa zayni l-mursalīna l-akhyāri, wa akrami man aẓlama ʿalayhi l-laylu wa ashraqa ʿalayhi n-nahāru (3)
verses.en: O Allah, bless the Master of the righteous, Adornment of the choicest Messengers, the noblest of all ever cloaked in the darkness of night or bathed in the light of day. (3)

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ يَا ذَا الْمَنِّ الَّذِي لَا يُكَافَى امْتِنَانُهُ ۞ وَالطَّوْلِ الَّذِي لَا يُجَازَى إِنْعَامُهُ وَإِحْسَانُهُ ۞ نَسْأَلُكَ بِكَ وَلَا نَسْأَلُكَ بِأَحَدٍ غَيْرِكَ ۞ أَنْ تُطْلِقَ أَلْسِنَتَنَا عِنْدَ السُّؤَالِ ۞ وَتُوَفِّقَنَا لِصَالِحِ الْأَعْمَالِ ۞ وَتَجْعَلَنَا مِنَ الْآمِنِينَ يَوْمَ الرَّجْفِ والزَّلَازِلِ، يَا ذَا الْعِزَّةِ وَالْجَلَالِ ۞ أَسْأَلُكَ يَا ‖ نُورَ النُّورِ، قَبْلَ الْأَزْمِنَةِ وَالدُّهُورِ ۞ أَنْتَ الْبَاقِي بِلَا زَوَالِ، الْغَنِيُّ بِلَا مِثَالِ، الْقُدُّوسُ الطَّاهِرُ، الْعَلِيُّ الْقَاهِرُ، الَّذِي لَا يُحِيطُ بِهِ مَكَانٌ، وَلَا يَشْتَمِلُ عَلَيْهِ زَمَانٌ ۞ أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَسْمَائِكَ الْحُسْنَى كُلِّهَا، وَبِأَعْظَمِ أَسْمَائِكَ إِلَيْكَ، وَأَشْرَفِهَا عِنْدَكَ مَنْزِلَةً، وَأَجْزَلِهَا عِنْدَكَ ثَوَابًا، وَأَسْرَعِهَا مِنْكَ إِجَابَةً ۞ وَبِاسْمِكَ الْمَخْزُونِ الْمَكْنُونِ، الْجَلِيلِ الْأَجَلِّ، الْكَبِيرِ الْأَكْبَرِ، الْعَظِيمِ الْأَعْظَمِ، الَّذِي تُحِبُّهُ، وَتَرْضَى عَمَّنْ دَعَاكَ بِهِ، وَتَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُ دُعَاءَهُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma yā dhā l-manni lladhī lā yukāfā imtinānuhu, wa ṭ-ṭawli lladhī lā yujāzā inʿāmuhu wa iḥsānuhu, nasʾaluka bika wa lā nasʾaluka bi aḥadin ghayrika, an tuṭliqa alsinatanā ʿinda s-suʾāli, wa tuwaffiqanā li-ṣāliḥi l-aʿmāli, wa tajʿalanā mina l-āminīna yawma r-rajfi wa z-zalāzili, yā dhā l-ʿizzati wa l-jalāli, asʾaluka yā nūra n-nūri, qabla l-azminati wa d-duhūri, anta l-bāqī bilā zawāli, al-ghaniyyu bilā mithāli, al-quddūsu ṭ-ṭāhiru, al-ʿaliyyu l-qāhiru, alladhī lā yuḥīṭu bihi makānun, wa lā yashtamilu ʿalayhi zamānun, asʾaluka bi asmāʾika l-ḥusnā kullihā, wa bi aʿẓami asmāʾika ilayka, wa ashrafihā ʿindaka manzilatan, wa ajzalihā ʿindaka thawāban, wa asraʿihā minka ijābatan, wa bi ismika l-makhzūni l-maknūni, l-jalīli l-ajalli, l-kabīri l-akbari, l-ʿaẓīmi l-aʿẓami, lladhī tuḥibbuhu, wa tarḍā ʿamman daʿāka bihi, wa tastajību lahu duʿāʾahu
verses.en: O Allah, O Master of Favor whose bounty cannot be repaid, and Bestower of Grace whose kindness and good deeds cannot be requited, we ask by You alone and by none other, that You loosen our tongues in beseeching You, grant us success in righteous deeds, and make us among those secure on the Day of Convulsions and Earthquakes, O Master of Might and Majesty. I ask You, O Light of the Light which was before all Times and Ages, You are the Abiding with no ending, the Rich with no equal, the Holy, the Pure, the High, the Powerful, the One neither encompassed by space nor bound by time. I ask You by all of Your most beautiful Names, and by the greatest of Your Names, the most noble to You in rank, the most abundant to You in reward, and the swiftest of them in eliciting Your response; and by Your protected, hidden Name — the most exalted of the exalted, the greatest of the great, the most magnificent of the magnificent — the Name You love, and by which You are pleased with whoever calls upon You, and whose prayer, offered by it, You accept.

verses.ar: أَسْأَلُكَ اللّٰهُمَّ بِلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْحَنَّانُ الْمَنَّانُ، بَدِيعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ ۞ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْكَبِيرُ الْمُتَعَالِ ۞ وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيمِ الْأَعْظَمِ الَّذِي إِذَا دُعِيتَ بِهِ أَجَبْتَ، وَإِذَا سُئِلْتَ بِهِ أَعْطَيْتَ ۞ وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ ‖ الَّذِي يَذِلُّ لِعَظَمَتِهِ الْعُظَمَاءُ وَالْمُلُوكُ وَالسِّبَاعُ وَالْهَوَامُّ وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْتَهُ، يَا اللّٰهُ يَا رَبِّ اسْتَجِبْ دَعْوَتِي، يَا مَنْ لَهُ الْعِزَّةُ وَالْجَبَرُوتُ، يَا ذَا الْمُلْكِ وَالْمَلَكُوتِ، يَا مَنْ هُوَ حَيٌّ لَّا يَمُوتُ ۞ سُبْحَانَكَ رَبِّ مَا أَعْظَمَ شَأْنَكَ، وَأَرْفَعَ مَكَانَكَ
verses.tr: Asʾaluka llāhumma bilā ilāha illā anta l-ḥannānu l-mannānu, badīʿu s-samāwāti wa l-arḍi, dhū l-jalāli wa l-ikrāmi, ʿālimu l-ghaybi wa sh-shahādati l-kabīru l-mutaʿāli, wa asʾaluka bi ismika l-ʿaẓīmi l-aʿẓami lladhī idhā duʿīta bihi ajabta, wa idhā suʾilta bihi aʿṭayta, wa asʾaluka bi ismika lladhī yadhillu li-ʿaẓamatihi l-ʿuẓamāʾu wa l-mulūku wa s-sibāʿu wa l-hawāmmu wa kullu shayʾin khalaqtahu, yā llāhu yā rabbi istajib daʿwatī, yā man lahu l-ʿizzatu wa l-jabarūtu, yā dhā l-mulki wa l-malakūti, yā man huwa ḥayyun lā yamūtu, subḥānaka rabbi mā aʿẓama shaʾnaka, wa arfaʿa makānaka
verses.en: I ask You, O Allah — there is no god but You — the Compassionate, the Benefactor, the Originator of the Heavens and the Earth, Master of Glory and Honor, Knower of the Unseen and the Seen, the Great, the Exalted. And I ask You by Your Greatest Name, by which, when we pray, our prayer is granted, and by which, when we ask, our request is granted. And I ask You by the Name before whose might the mighty ones, the kings, the beasts, the creeping things, and everything You have created are humbled. O Allah, O Lord, answer my prayer, O You to Whom belong Might and Omnipotence, O Master of Sovereignty and the Kingdom, O the Living Who never dies. Glory to You, my Lord — how tremendous is Your affair, and how exalted is Your station.

verses.ar: أَنْتَ رَبِّي، يَا مُتَقَدِّسًا فِي جَبَرُوتِهِ، إِلَيْكَ أَرْغَبُ، وَإِيَّاكَ أَرْهَبُ ۞ يَا عَظِيمُ يَا كَبِيرُ، يَا جَبَّارُ يَا قَادِرُ يَا قَوِيُّ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا عَظِيمُ، تَعَالَيْتَ يَا عَلِيمُ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا عَظِيمُ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا جَلِيلُ ۞ أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيمِ التَّامِّ الْكَبِيرِ، أَنْ لَا تُسَلِّطَ عَلَيْنَا جَبَّارًا عَنِيدًا ۞ وَلَا شَيْطَانًا مَرِيدًا ۞ وَلَا إِنْسَانًا حَسُودًا ۞ وَلَا ضَعِيفًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، وَلَا شَدِيدًا، وَلَا بَارًّا وَلَا فَاجِرًا وَلَا عَبِيدًا وَلَا عَنِيدًا
verses.tr: Anta rabbī, yā mutaqaddisan fī jabarūtihi, ilayka arghabu, wa iyyāka arhabu, yā ʿaẓīmu yā kabīru, yā jabbāru yā qādiru yā qawiyyu, tabārakta yā ʿaẓīmu, taʿālayta yā ʿalīmu, subḥānaka yā ʿaẓīmu, subḥānaka yā jalīlu, asʾaluka bi ismika l-ʿaẓīmi t-tāmmi l-kabīri, an lā tusalliṭa ʿalaynā jabbāran ʿanīdan, wa lā shayṭānan marīdan, wa lā insānan ḥasūdan, wa lā ḍaʿīfan min khalqika, wa lā shadīdan, wa lā bārran wa lā fājiran wa lā ʿabīdan wa lā ʿanīdan
verses.en: You are my Lord, Holy in Your Omnipotence; to You I turn in longing, and You alone I fear. O Great, O Immense, O Almighty, O Capable, O Strong — You have blessed Yourself, O Great One; You have exalted Yourself, O Knowing One; glory to You, O Great One; glory to You, O Splendid One. I ask You by Your great, perfect and mighty Name, not to give any tyrant, obstinate one, power over us, nor any rebellious devil, nor any envious person, nor any weak or oppressive one among Your creation, nor any dutiful or corrupt one, nor any enslaved or stubborn one.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فَإِنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللّٰهُ الَّذِي ‖ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْوَاحِدُ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ۞ يَا هُوَ يَا مَنْ لَّا هُوَ إِلَّا هُوَ، يَا مَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، يَا أَزَلِيُّ يَا أَبَدِيُّ، يَا دَهْرِيُّ يَا دَيْمُومِيُّ، يَا مَنْ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ، يَا إِلَهَنَا وَإِلَهَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِلَهًا وَاحِدًا، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka fa innī ash-hadu annaka anta llāhu lladhī lā ilāha illā anta l-wāḥidu l-aḥadu ṣ-ṣamadu lladhī lam yalid wa lam yūlad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥadun, yā huwa yā man lā huwa illā huwa, yā man lā ilāha illā huwa, yā azaliyyu yā abadiyyu, yā dahriyyu yā daymūmiyyu, yā man huwa l-ḥayyu lladhī lā yamūtu, yā ilāhanā wa ilāha kulli shayʾin ilāhan wāḥidan, lā ilāha illā anta
verses.en: O Allah, I ask You, and I bear witness that You are Allah, there is no god but You, the One, the Unique, the Self-Sufficient, Who neither begets nor is begotten, and there is none comparable to Him. O He, O the One besides Whom there is no He, O the One besides Whom there is no god, O Pre-Eternal, O Post-Eternal, O Timeless, O Everlasting, O the Living Who never dies, O our God and the God of all things, one God — there is no god but You.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، الرَّحْمٰنَ الرَّحِيمَ، الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ، الدَّيَّانَ الْحَنَّانَ الْمَنَّانَ، الْبَاعِثَ الْوَارِثَ، ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ ۞ قُلُوبُ الْخَلَائِقِ بِيَدِكَ، نَوَاصِيهِمْ إِلَيْكَ، فَأَنْتَ تَزْرَعُ الْخَيْرَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ، وَتَمْحُو الشَّرَّ إِذَا شِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma fāṭira s-samāwāti wa l-arḍi, ʿālima l-ghaybi wa sh-shahādati, r-Raḥmāna r-Raḥīma, l-ḥayya l-qayyūma, d-dayyāna l-ḥannāna l-mannāna, l-bāʿitha l-wāritha, dhā l-jalāli wa l-ikrāmi, qulūbu l-khalāʾiqi bi yadika, nawāṣīhim ilayka, fa anta tazraʿu l-khayra fī qulūbihim, wa tamḥū sh-sharra idhā shiʾta minhum
verses.en: O Allah, Creator of the Heavens and the Earth, Knower of the Unseen and the Seen, the All-Merciful, the Most Merciful, the Living, the Self-Subsisting, the Requiter, the Compassionate, the Bestower of Grace, the Resurrector, the Inheritor, Master of Glory and Honor — the hearts of all creatures are in Your Hand, their very reins are Yours; You cause goodness to grow in their hearts, and You erase the evil from them as You will.

verses.ar: فَأَسْأَلُكَ اللّٰهُمَّ أَنْ تَمْحُوَ مِنْ قَلْبِي كُلَّ شَيْءٍ تَكْرَهُهُ ۞ وَأَنْ تَحْشُوَ قَلْبِي مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ، وَمَعْرِفَتِكَ وَرَهْبَتِكَ، وَالرَّغْبَةِ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ، وَالْأَمْنَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ ۞ وَاعْطِفْ عَلَيْنَا بِالرَّحْمَةِ وَالْبَرَكَةِ ‖ مِنْكَ ۞ وَأَلْهِمْنَا الصَّوَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ، فَنَسْأَلُكَ اللّٰهُمَّ عِلْمَ الْخَائِفِينَ ۞ وَإِنَابَةَ الْمُخْبِتِينَ ۞ وَإِخْلَاصَ الْمُوقِنِينَ ۞ وَشُكْرَ الصَّابِرِينَ ۞ وَتَوْبَةَ الصِّدِّيقِينَ
verses.tr: Fa asʾaluka llāhumma an tamḥuwa min qalbī kulla shayʾin takrahuhu, wa an taḥshuwa qalbī min khashyatika, wa maʿrifatika wa rahbatika, wa r-raghbati fīmā ʿindaka, wa l-amna wa l-ʿāfiyata, wa aʿṭif ʿalaynā bi r-raḥmati wa l-barakati minka, wa alhimnā ṣ-ṣawāba wa l-ḥikmata, fa nasʾaluka llāhumma ʿilma l-khāʾifīna, wa inābata l-mukhbitīna, wa ikhlāṣa l-mūqinīna, wa shukra ṣ-ṣābirīna, wa tawbata ṣ-ṣiddīqīna
verses.en: So I ask You, O Allah, to erase from my heart everything that You hate, and to fill my heart with fear of You, knowledge of You, awe of You, longing for what is with You, and security and well-being; and be gracious to us with mercy and blessing from You, and inspire in us what is right and wise. And I ask You, O Allah, for the understanding of those who fear, the turning of the humble, the sincerity of those who are certain, the gratitude of the patient, and the penitence of the truthful.

verses.ar: وَنَسْأَلُكَ اللّٰهُمَّ بِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ الَّذِي مَلَأَ أَرْكَانَ عَرْشِكَ، أَنْ تَزْرَعَ فِي قَلْبِي مَعْرِفَتَكَ حَتَّى أَعْرِفَكَ حَقَّ مَعْرِفَتِكَ، كَمَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ تُعْرَفَ بِهِ ۞ وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ، وَإِمَامِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ ۞ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمًا ۞ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
verses.tr: Wa nasʾaluka llāhumma bi nūri wajhika lladhī malaʾa arkāna ʿarshika, an tazraʿa fī qalbī maʿrifataka ḥattā aʿrifaka ḥaqqa maʿrifatika, kamā yanbaghī an tuʿrafa bihi, wa ṣallā llāhu ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin khātami n-nabiyyīna, wa imāmi l-mursalīna, wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi wa sallama tasliman, wa l-ḥamdu lillāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīna
verses.en: And we ask You, O Allah, by the light of Your Face which fills every corner of Your Throne, that You cause knowledge of You to grow in my heart, until I know You with the true knowledge that is due to You, as befits Your being known; and may Allah's blessings and abundant peace be upon our master Muhammad, the Seal of the Prophets and Leader of the Messengers, and upon his family and Companions, and praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.

DALAIL_CHAPTERS.note: The closing duʿāʾ of the Dalāʾil al-Khayrāt, recited on completing a full reading — asking that the reward of the blessings just recited bring comfort, forgiveness and the vision of the Prophet ﷺ, then interceding by him, and closing with a plea for mercy and steadfastness.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اشْرَحْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ صُدُورَنَا، وَيَسِّرْ بِهَا أُمُورَنَا، وَفَرِّجْ بِهَا هُمُومَنَا، وَاكْشِفْ بِهَا غُمُومَنَا، وَاغْفِرْ بِهَا ذُنُوبَنَا، وَاقْضِ بِهَا دُيُونَنَا، وَأَصْلِحْ بِهَا أَحْوَالَنَا، وَبَلِّغْ بِهَا آمَالَنَا، وَتَقَبَّلْ بِهَا تَوْبَتَنَا، وَاغْسِلْ بِهَا حَوْبَتَنَا، وَانْصُرْ بِهَا حُجَّتَنَا، وَطَهِّرْ بِهَا أَلْسِنَتَنَا، وَآنِسْ بِهَا وَحْشَتَنَا، وَارْحَمْ بِهَا غُرْبَتَنَا، وَاجْعَلْهَا نُورًا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا، وَمِنْ خَلْفِنَا، وَعَنْ أَيْمَانِنَا، وَعَنْ شَمَائِلِنَا، وَمِنْ فَوْقِنَا، وَمِنْ تَحْتِنَا، وَفِي حَيَاتِنَا وَمَوْتِنَا، وَفِي قُبُورِنَا وَحَشْرِنَا وَنَشْرِنَا، وَظِلًّا فِي يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلٰى رُؤُوسِنَا، وَثَقِّلْ بِهَا مَوَازِينَ حَسَنَاتِنَا، وَأَدِمْ بَرَكَاتِهَا عَلَيْنَا حَتَّى نَلْقَى ‖ نَبِيَّنَا وَسَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَنَحْنُ آمِنُونَ مُطْمَئِنُّونَ فَرِحُونَ مُسْتَبْشِرُونَ، وَلَا تُفَرِّقْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُ حَتَّى تُدْخِلَنَا مَدْخَلَهُ، وَتُؤْوِيَنَا إِلَى جِوَارِهِ الْكَرِيمِ مَعَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ وَحَسُنَ أُولَئِكَ رَفِيقًا
verses.tr: Allāhumma ishraḥ biṣ-ṣalāti ʿalayhi ṣudūranā, wa yassir bihā umūranā, wa farrij bihā humūmanā, wakshif bihā ghumūmanā, waghfir bihā dhunūbanā, waqḍi bihā duyūnanā, wa aṣliḥ bihā aḥwālanā, wa balligh bihā āmālanā, wa taqabbal bihā tawbatanā, waghsil bihā ḥawbatanā, wanṣur bihā ḥujjatanā, wa ṭahhir bihā alsinatanā, wa ānis bihā waḥshatanā, warḥam bihā ghurbatanā, wajʿalhā nūran bayna aydīnā, wa min khalfinā, wa ʿan aymāninā, wa ʿan shamāʾilinā, wa min fawqinā, wa min taḥtinā, wa fī ḥayātinā wa mawtinā, wa fī qubūrinā wa ḥashrinā wa nashrinā, wa ẓillan fī yawmi l-qiyāmati ʿalā ruʾūsinā, wa thaqqil bihā mawāzīna ḥasanātinā, wa adim barakātihā ʿalaynā ḥattā nalqā nabiyyanā wa sayyidanā Muḥammadan ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam, wa naḥnu āminūna muṭmaʾinnūna fariḥūna mustabshirūna, wa lā tufarriq baynanā wa baynahu ḥattā tudkhilanā madkhalahu, wa tuʾwiyanā ilā jiwārihi l-karīmi maʿa lladhīna anʿamta ʿalayhim mina n-nabiyyīna waṣ-ṣiddīqīna wash-shuhadāʾi waṣ-ṣāliḥīn, wa ḥasuna ulāʾika rafīqā
verses.en: O Allah, by sending blessings upon him, expand our chests, ease by it our affairs, relieve by it our worries, remove by it our distresses, forgive by it our sins, settle by it our debts, rectify by it our conditions, convey by it our hopes, accept by it our repentance, wash by it our faults, support by it our proof, purify by it our tongues, bring intimacy by it to our loneliness, and have mercy by it upon our estrangement. And make it a light before us, and behind us, on our right, and on our left, above us, and beneath us, in our life and our death, in our graves, our gathering, and our rising, and a shade on the Day of Resurrection over our heads. And make heavy by it the scales of our good deeds, and continue its blessings upon us until we meet our Prophet and our master Muhammad, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, while we are secure, at peace, joyful, and rejoicing. And do not separate between us and him until You admit us to his place of entry, and grant us shelter in his noble proximity, with those whom You have favored among the Prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous — and how excellent they are as companions.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا آمَنَّا بِهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَلَمْ نَرَهُ، فَمَتِّعْنَا اللّٰهُمَّ فِي الدَّارَيْنِ بِرُؤْيَتِهِ، وَثَبِّتْ قُلُوبَنَا عَلٰى مَحَبَّتِهِ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْنَا عَلٰى سُنَّتِهِ، وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلٰى مِلَّتِهِ، وَاحْشُرْنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ النَّاجِيَةِ وَحِزْبِهِ الْمُفْلِحِينَ، وَانْفَعْنَا بِمَا انْطَوَتْ عَلَيْهِ قُلُوبُنَا مِنْ مَحَبَّتِهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمَ لَا جَدَّ وَلَا مَالَ وَلَا بَنِينَ، وَأَوْرِدْنَا حَوْضَهُ الْأَصْفَى، وَاسْقِنَا بِكَأْسِهِ الْأَوْفَى، وَيَسِّرْ عَلَيْنَا زِيَارَةَ ‖ حَرَمِكَ وَحَرَمِهِ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تُمِيتَنَا، وَأَدِمْ عَلَيْنَا الْإِقَامَةَ بِحَرَمِكَ وَحَرَمِهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى أَنْ نَتَوَفَّى
verses.tr: Allāhumma innā āmannā bihi ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam wa lam narahu, fa mattiʿnā Allāhumma fī d-dārayni bi ruʾyatihi, wa thabbit qulūbanā ʿalā maḥabbatihi, wastaʿmilnā ʿalā sunnatihi, wa tawaffanā ʿalā millatihi, waḥshurnā fī zumratihi n-nājiyati wa ḥizbihi l-mufliḥīn, wanfaʿnā bimā inṭawat ʿalayhi qulūbunā min maḥabbatihi ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam yawma lā jadda wa lā māla wa lā banīn, wa awridnā ḥawḍahu l-aṣfā, wasqinā bi kaʾsihi l-awfā, wa yassir ʿalaynā ziyārata ḥaramika wa ḥaramihi min qabli an tumītanā, wa adim ʿalaynā l-iqāmata bi ḥaramika wa ḥaramihi ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam ilā an natawaffā
verses.en: O Allah, indeed we have believed in him, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, though we have not seen him — so grant us, O Allah, the joy of seeing him in both abodes. Make firm our hearts upon his love, employ us upon his Sunnah, and cause us to die upon his religion; gather us in his saved company and his successful party, and let us benefit from the love our hearts hold for him, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, on a Day when there is no lineage, nor wealth, nor children. Bring us to his purest Pool, and give us to drink from his fullest cup; make easy for us the visiting of Your sanctuary and his sanctuary before You cause us to die, and grant us lasting residence in Your sanctuary and his sanctuary, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, until we pass away.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَشْفِعُ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ إِذْ هُوَ أَوْجَهُ الشُّفَعَاءِ إِلَيْكَ، وَنُقْسِمُ بِهِ عَلَيْكَ إِذْ هُوَ أَعْظَمُ مَنْ أُقْسِمَ بِحَقِّهِ عَلَيْكَ، وَنَتَوَسَّلُ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ إِذْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ الْوَسَائِلِ إِلَيْكَ، نَشْكُو إِلَيْكَ يَا رَبِّ قَسْوَةَ قُلُوبِنَا، وَكَثْرَةَ ذُنُوبِنَا، وَطُولَ آمَالِنَا، وَتَكَاسُلَنَا عَنِ الطَّاعَاتِ، وَهُجُومَنَا عَلٰى الْمُخَالَفَاتِ، فَنِعْمَ الْمُشْتَكَى إِلَيْهِ أَنْتَ يَا رَبِّ، بِكَ نَسْتَنْصِرُ عَلٰى أَعْدَائِنَا وَأَنْفُسِنَا فَانْصُرْنَا، وَعَلٰى فَضْلِكَ نَتَوَكَّلُ فِي صَلَاحِنَا، فَلَا تَكِلْنَا إِلَى غَيْرِكَ يَا رَبَّنَا، وَإِلَى جَنَابِ رَسُولِكَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَنْتَسِبُ فَلَا تُبْعِدْنَا، وَبِبَابِكَ نَقِفُ فَلَا ‖ تَطْرُدْنَا، وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْأَلُ فَلَا تُخَيِّبْنَا
verses.tr: Allāhumma innā nastashfiʿu bihi ilayka idh huwa awjahu sh-shufaʿāʾi ilayka, wa nuqsimu bihi ʿalayka idh huwa aʿẓamu man uqsima bi ḥaqqihi ʿalayka, wa natawassalu bihi ilayka idh huwa aqrabu l-wasāʾili ilayka, nashkū ilayka yā rabbi qaswata qulūbinā, wa kathrata dhunūbinā, wa ṭūla āmālinā, wa takāsulanā ʿani ṭ-ṭāʿāti, wa hujūmanā ʿalā l-mukhālafāti, fa niʿma l-mushtakā ilayhi anta yā rabbi, bika nastanṣiru ʿalā aʿdāʾinā wa anfusinā fanṣurnā, wa ʿalā faḍlika natawakkalu fī ṣalāḥinā, fa lā takilnā ilā ghayrika yā rabbanā, wa ilā janābi rasūlika ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam nantasibu, fa lā tubʿidnā, wa bi bābika naqifu, fa lā taṭrudnā, wa iyyāka nasʾalu, fa lā tukhayyibnā
verses.en: O Allah, we seek his intercession with You, for he is the most honored of intercessors before You; we swear by him to You, for he is the greatest of those in whose right an oath may be made to You; and we take him as our means to You, for he is the nearest of means to You. We complain to You, O Lord, of the hardness of our hearts, the abundance of our sins, the length of our hopes, our laziness in obedience, and our rush toward disobedience — and how excellent a Refuge for complaint You are, O Lord. Through You we seek help against our enemies and against ourselves, so grant us help; and upon Your grace we rely for our rectification, so do not entrust us to any other, O our Lord. To the rank of Your Messenger, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, we claim belonging — so do not distance us. At Your door we stand — so do not turn us away. You alone we ask — so do not disappoint us.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ ارْحَمْ تَضَرُّعَنَا، وَآمِنْ خَوْفَنَا، وَتَقَبَّلْ أَعْمَالَنَا، وَأَصْلِحْ أَحْوَالَنَا، وَاجْعَلْ بِطَاعَتِكَ اشْتِغَالَنَا، وَإِلَى الْخَيْرِ مَآلَنَا، وَحَقِّقْ بِالزِّيَادَةِ آمَالَنَا، وَاخْتِمْ بِالسَّعَادَةِ آجَالَنَا، هٰذَا ذُلُّنَا ظَاهِرٌ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ، وَحَالُنَا لَا يَخْفَى عَلَيْكَ، أَمَرْتَنَا فَتَرَكْنَا، وَنَهَيْتَنَا فَارْتَكَبْنَا، وَلَا يَسَعُنَا إِلَّا عَفْوُكَ فَاعْفُ عَنَّا يَا خَيْرَ مَأْمُولٍ، وَأَكْرَمَ مَسْئُولٍ، إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ رَؤُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ، وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمًا، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ‖
verses.tr: Allāhumma irḥam taḍarruʿanā, wa āmin khawfanā, wa taqabbal aʿmālanā, wa aṣliḥ aḥwālanā, wajʿal biṭāʿatika ishtighālanā, wa ilā l-khayri maʾālanā, wa ḥaqqiq biz-ziyādati āmālanā, wakhtim bis-saʿādati ājālanā, hādhā dhullunā ẓāhirun bayna yadayka, wa ḥālunā lā yakhfā ʿalayka, amartanā fa taraknā, wa nahaytanā fartakabnā, wa lā yasaʿunā illā ʿafwuka fa aʿfu ʿannā yā khayra maʾmūlin, wa akrama masʾūlin, innaka ʿafuwwun ghafūrun raʾūfun raḥīmun yā arḥama r-rāḥimīn, wa ṣallā Allāhu ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi wa sallama tasliman, wal-ḥamdu lillāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.en: O Allah, have mercy on our humble pleading, grant us safety from our fears, accept our deeds, and rectify our conditions. Make our occupation Your obedience, and our end goodness; fulfill our hopes with increase, and seal our lifespans with happiness. This is our lowliness laid bare before You, and our state is not hidden from You: You commanded us, yet we abandoned; You forbade us, yet we transgressed. Nothing suffices us but Your pardon, so pardon us, O Best of those hoped in, and Most Generous of those asked. Indeed You are Ever-Pardoning, Ever-Forgiving, Most Kind, Most Merciful, O Most Merciful of the merciful. And may Allah bless our master Muhammad, and his family and Companions, and grant them abundant peace, and praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِوَالِدِينَا وَلِمُؤَلِّفِهِ، وَارْحَمْنَا وَارْحَمْهُمْ، وَاحْشُرْنَا وَإِيَّاهُمْ فِي زُمْرَةِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِفَضْلِكَ يَا رَحْمَانُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ghfir lanā wa li wālidīnā wa li muʾallifihi, warḥamnā warḥamhum, waḥshurnā wa iyyāhum fī zumrati n-nabiyyīna waṣ-ṣiddīqīna wash-shuhadāʾi waṣ-ṣāliḥīna yawma l-qiyāmati bi faḍlika yā Raḥmān
verses.en: O Allah, forgive us, our parents, and the author of this book; have mercy on us and on them; and gather us and them, on the Day of Resurrection, in the company of the Prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous — by Your grace, O All-Merciful.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِ الْأَبْرَارِ، وَزَيْنِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ الْأَخْيَارِ، وَأَكْرَمِ مَنْ أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَأَشْرَقَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهَارُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidi l-abrāri, wa zayni l-mursalīna l-akhyāri, wa akrami man aẓlama ʿalayhi l-laylu wa ashraqa ʿalayhi n-nahāru
verses.en: O Allah, bless the Master of the righteous, Adornment of the choicest Messengers, the noblest of all ever cloaked in the darkness of night or bathed in the light of day.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ تَقْرَأُ هٰذِهِ الْكَلِمَاتِ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ مَرَّةً وَهِيَ
verses.tr: Thumma taqraʾu hādhihi l-kalimāti arbaʿa ʿashrata marratan wa hiya
verses.en: Then recite these words fourteen times, and they are:

verses.ar:
اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى بَدْرِ التَّمَامِ
اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى نُورِ الظَّلَامِ
اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مِفْتَاحِ دَارِ السَّلَامِ
اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى الشَّفِيعِ فِي جَمِيعِ الْأَنَامِ (14)
verses.tr:
Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā badri t-tamām
Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā nūri ẓ-ẓalām
Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā miftāḥi dāri s-salām
Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sh-shafīʿi fī jamīʿi l-anām (14)
verses.en:
O Allah, bless the full moon of perfection.
O Allah, bless the light in the darkness.
O Allah, bless the key to the Abode of Peace.
O Allah, bless the intercessor for all creation. (14)

verses.ar: ثُمَّ تَقْرَأُ هٰذِهِ الْأَبْيَاتَ الْمَنْسُوبَةَ لِلْمُؤَلِّفِ ‖
verses.tr: Thumma taqraʾu hādhihi l-abyāta l-mansūbata lil-muʾallif
verses.en: Then recite these verses attributed to the author:

verses.ar:
يَا رَحْمَةَ اللّٰهِ إِنِّي خَائِفٌ وَجِلُ
يَا نِعْمَةَ اللّٰهِ إِنِّي مُفْلِسٌ عَانِي
وَلَيْسَ لِي عَمَلٌ أَلْقَى الْعَلِيمَ بِهِ
سِوَى مَحَبَّتِكَ الْعُظْمَى وَإِيمَانِي
فَكُنْ أَمَانِيَ مِنْ شَرِّ الْحَيَاةِ وَمِنْ
شَرِّ الْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ إِحْرَاقِ جُثْمَانِي
وَكُنْ غِنَايَ الَّذِي مَا بَعْدَهُ فَلَسٌ
وَكُنْ فَكَاكِي مِنْ أَغْلَالِ عِصْيَانِي
تَحِيَّةَ الصَّمَدِ الْمَوْلَى وَرَحْمَتَهُ
مَا غَنَّتِ الْوُرْقُ فِي أَوْرَاقِ أَغْصَانِي
عَلَيْكَ يَا عُرْوَتِي الْوُثْقَى وَيَا سَنَدِي
الْأَوْفَى وَمَنْ مَدْحُهُ رَوْحِي وَرَيْحَانِي
verses.tr:
Yā raḥmata llāhi innī khāʾifun wajilu
Yā niʿmata llāhi innī muflisun ʿānī
Wa laysa lī ʿamalun alqā l-ʿalīma bihi
Siwā maḥabbatika l-ʿuẓmā wa īmānī
Fa kun amāniya min sharri l-ḥayāti wa min
Sharri l-mamāti wa min iḥrāqi juthmānī
Wa kun ghināya lladhī mā baʿdahu falasun
Wa kun fakākī min aghlāli ʿiṣyānī
Taḥiyyata ṣ-ṣamadi l-mawlā wa raḥmatahu
Mā ghannati l-wurqu fī awrāqi aghṣānī
ʿAlayka yā ʿurwatī l-wuthqā wa yā sanadī
l-awfā wa man madḥuhu rawḥī wa rayḥānī
verses.en:
O mercy of Allah, truly I am fearful and trembling.
O grace of Allah, truly I am destitute and distressed.
I have no deed with which to meet the All-Knowing,
save my greatest love for you and my faith.
So be my safety from the evil of life, and from
the evil of death, and from the burning of my body.
Be for me the wealth after which there is no want,
and be my ransom from the shackles of my disobedience.
May the greeting of the Eternal Lord and His mercy
— as long as the doves sing in the leaves of my branches —
be upon you, O my firmest handhold, O my most
faithful support, whose praise is my spirit and my sweet basil.

verses.ar: اَلْفَاتِحَة
verses.tr: Al-Fātiḥah
verses.en: Recite al-Fātiḥah.

DIYA_CHAPTERS.note: The mawlid opens with twelve calls of blessing, each on the same first hemistich.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ حَبِيبِكَ الشَّافِعِ الْمُشَفَّعْ
verses.en: My Lord, send Your mercy upon Muḥammad — Your beloved, the intercessor whose intercession is accepted.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ أَعْلَى الْوَرَى رُتْبَةً وَأَرْفَعْ
verses.en: My Lord, send Your mercy upon Muḥammad — the highest and most exalted of mankind in station.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ أَسْمَى الْبَرَايَا جَاهًا وَأَوْسَعْ
verses.en: My Lord, send Your mercy upon Muḥammad — the most sublime of creation in rank, and the most far-reaching.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ وَاسْلُكْ بِنَا رَبِّ خَيْرَ مَهْيَعْ
verses.en: My Lord, send Your mercy upon Muḥammad — and take us, my Lord, down the widest and best of roads.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ وَعَافِنَا وَاشْفِ كُلَّ مُوجَعْ
verses.en: My Lord, send Your mercy upon Muḥammad — and grant us wellbeing, and cure everyone in pain.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ وَأَصْلِحِ الْقَلْبَ وَاعْفُ وَانْفَعْ
verses.en: My Lord, send Your mercy upon Muḥammad — and set the heart right, pardon our faults and benefit us.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ وَاكْفِ الْمُعَادِي وَاصْرِفْهُ وَارْدَعْ
verses.en: My Lord, send Your mercy upon Muḥammad — and spare us the one who bears us enmity — turn him away and deter him.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ نَحُلُّ فِي حِصْنِكَ الْمُمْنَعْ
verses.en: My Lord, send Your mercy upon Muḥammad — and let us dwell within Your impregnable fortress.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ رَبِّ ارْضَ عَنَّا رِضَاكَ الْأَرْفَعْ
verses.en: My Lord, send Your mercy upon Muḥammad — my Lord, be pleased with us with Your most exalted pleasure.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ وَاجْعَلْ لَنَا فِي الْجِنَانِ مَجْمَعْ
verses.en: My Lord, send Your mercy upon Muḥammad — and grant us a place of gathering in the gardens of paradise.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ رَافِقْ بِنَا خَيْرَ خَلْقِكَ أَجْمَعْ
verses.en: My Lord, send Your mercy upon Muḥammad — and grant us the company of the best of all Your creation.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمْ
verses.en: My Lord, send Your mercy upon Muḥammad — my Lord, send Your mercy and peace upon him.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ
verses.en: O Allāh, send Your mercy, peace and blessings upon him and upon his family.

DIYA_CHAPTERS.titleEnglish: 2 · The Taʿawwudh and the Qurʾānic Openings

verses.ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
verses.en: I seek refuge in Allāh from Satan, the accursed.

verses.ar: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
verses.en: In the Name of Allāh, the All-Merciful, the Compassionate.

verses.ar: ﴿إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا ۞ لِيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللّٰهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهۥ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَاطًا مُسْتَقِيمًا ۞ وَيَنْصُرَكَ اللّٰهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا﴾
verses.en: Indeed We have granted you a manifest victory, that Allāh may forgive you what is past of your fault and what is to come, and complete His favour upon you, and guide you on a straight path, and that Allāh may help you with a mighty help. (al-Fatḥ 48:1–3)

verses.ar: ﴿لَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ ۞ فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللّٰهُ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ﴾
verses.en: There has come to you a Messenger from among yourselves; grievous to him is your suffering, deeply concerned for you, and to the believers gentle and compassionate. But if they turn away, say: Allāh is sufficient for me. There is no god but He. In Him I have put my trust, and He is the Lord of the mighty Throne. (al-Tawba 9:128–129)

verses.ar: ﴿إِنَّ اللّٰهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهۥ يُصَلُّونَ عَلٰى النَّبِيِّ ۞ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا﴾
verses.en: Indeed Allāh and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who believe, send blessings upon him and greet him with a worthy salutation. (al-Aḥzāb 33:56)

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ
verses.en: O Allāh, send Your mercy, peace and blessings upon him and upon his family.

DIYA_CHAPTERS.titleEnglish: 3 · Praise, and the Call to the Lovers

verses.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي هَدَانَا ۞ بِعَبْدِهِ الْمُخْتَارِ مَنْ دَعَانَا
verses.en: Praise be to the One who guided us through His chosen slave, who summoned us.

verses.ar: إِلَيْهِ بِالإِذْنِ وَقَدْ نَادَانَا ۞ لَبَّيْكَ يَا مَنْ دَلَّنَا وَحَدَانَا
verses.en: To Him, with His leave; and indeed he called us. At your service, O you who showed us the way and urged us on.

verses.ar: صَلَّى عَلَيْكَ اللّٰهُ بَارِئُكَ الَّذِي ۞ بِكَ يَا مُشَفَّعُ خَصَّنَا وَحَبَانَا
verses.en: May Allāh, your Maker, send His mercy upon you — He who through you, O accepted intercessor, singled us out and favoured us.

verses.ar: مَعَ آلِكَ الْأَطْهَارِ مَعْدِنِ سِرِّكَ الْأَسْمَى ۞ فَهُمْ سُفْنُ النَّجَاةِ حِمَانَا
verses.en: And upon your pure family, the mine of your loftiest secret; they are the ships of salvation, and our sanctuary.

verses.ar: وَعَلٰى صَحَابَتِكَ الْكِرَامِ حُمَاةِ دِينِكَ ۞ أَصْبَحُوا لِوَلَائِهِ عُنْوَانَا
verses.en: And upon your noble companions, the defenders of your religion; they became the very emblem of loyalty to him.

verses.ar: وَالتَّابِعِينَ لَهُمْ بِصِدْقٍ مَا حَدَا ۞ حَادِي الْمَوَدَّةِ هَيَّجَ الْأَشْجَانَا
verses.en: And upon those who follow them in truth, for as long as the driver of the caravan of love sings and stirs up longing.

verses.ar: وَاللّٰهِ مَا ذُكِرَ الْحَبِيبُ لَدَى الْمُحِبِّ ۞ إِلَّا وَأَضْحَى وَالِهًا نَشْوَانَا
verses.en: By Allāh, never is the Beloved mentioned before one who loves him but that he is left enraptured and overcome with joy.

verses.ar: أَيْنَ الْمُحِبُّونَ الَّذِينَ عَلَيْهِمُ ۞ بَذْلُ النُّفُوسِ مَعَ النَّفَائِسِ هَانَا
verses.en: Where are the lovers, for whom the giving up of their souls and of every precious thing comes easily?

verses.ar: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ بِذِكْرِ طٰهٰ الْمُصْطَفَى ۞ إِلَّا بِهِ انْتَعَشُوا وَأَذْهَبَ رَانَا
verses.en: They never hear Ṭā-Hā the Chosen One mentioned but that they are revived by it, and the rust is taken from their hearts.

verses.ar: فَاهْتَاجَتِ الْأَرْوَاحُ تَشْتَاقُ اللِّقَا ۞ وَتَحِنُّ تَسْأَلُ رَبَّهَا الرِّضْوَانَا
verses.en: The souls are stirred, yearning for the meeting, longing, asking their Lord for His good pleasure.

verses.ar: حَالُ الْمُحِبِّينَ كَذَا فَاسْمَعْ إِلَى ۞ سِيَرِ الْمُشَفَّعِ وَارْهِفِ الْآذَانَا
verses.en: Such is the state of the lovers. So listen to the life of the accepted intercessor, and lend a keen ear.

verses.ar: وَانْصِتْ إِلَى أَوْصَافِ طٰهٰ الْمُجْتَبَى ۞ وَاحْضِرْ لِقَلْبِكَ يَمْتَلِئْ وِجْدَانَا
verses.en: Attend to the description of Ṭā-Hā the Elect, and bring your heart present — it will be filled with ecstasy.

verses.ar: يَا رَبَّنَا صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ دَائِمًا ۞ عَلٰى حَبِيبِكَ مَنْ إِلَيْكَ دَعَانَا
verses.en: Our Lord, send Your mercy and peace perpetually upon Your beloved, the one who called us to You.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ
verses.en: O Allāh, send Your mercy, peace and blessings upon him and upon his family.

verses.ar: نَبَّأَنَا اللّٰهُ فَقَالَ جَاءَكُمْ ۞ نُورٌ فَسُبْحَانَ الَّذِي أَنْبَانَا
verses.en: Allāh announced to us, saying: “There has come to you a light.” Glory be to the One who told us.

verses.ar: وَالنُّورُ طٰهٰ عَبْدُهُ مَنْ بِهِ ۞ فِي ذِكْرِهِ أَعْظِمْ بِهِ مَنَّانَا
verses.en: And the light is Ṭā-Hā, His slave, through whom — as the Reminder says — how magnificent a gift He gave!

verses.ar: هُوَ رَحْمَةُ الْمَوْلَى تَأَمَّلْ قَوْلَهُ ۞ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا وَاغْدُ بِهِ فَرْحَانَا
verses.en: He is the mercy of our Master. Reflect on His words: “let them rejoice” — so go about rejoicing in him.

verses.ar: مُسْتَمْسِكًا بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَى ۞ وَمُعْتَصِمًا بِحَبْلِ اللّٰهِ مَنْ أَنْشَانَا
verses.en: Holding fast to the most trustworthy handhold, and clinging to the rope of Allāh, who brought us into being.

verses.ar: وَاسْتَشْعِرَنْ أَنْوَارَ مَنْ قِيلَ مَتَى ۞ كُنْتَ نَبِيًّا قَالَ آدَمُ كَانَا
verses.en: And feel the lights of the one who, when asked “When were you a prophet?”, answered: while Adam was still —

verses.ar: بَيْنَ التُّرَابِ وَبَيْنَ مَاءٍ فَاسْتَفِقْ ۞ مِنْ غَفْلَةٍ عَنْ ذَا وَكُنْ يَقْظَانَا
verses.en: between earth and water. So rouse yourself from heedlessness of this, and be awake.

verses.ar: وَاعْبُرْ إِلَى أَسْرَارِ رَبِّي لَمْ يَزَلْ ۞ يَنْقُلُنِي بَيْنَ الْخِيَارِ مُصَانَا
verses.en: And cross over to the secrets: my Lord never ceased to carry me, protected, through the best of loins.

verses.ar: لَمْ تَفْتَرِقْ مِنْ شُعْبَتَيْنِ إِلَّا أَنَا ۞ فِي خَيْرِهَا حَتَّى بُرُوزِي آنَا
verses.en: No lineage ever branched in two but that I was in the better of them, until the hour of my emergence came.

verses.ar: فَأَنَا خِيَارٌ مِنْ خِيَارٍ قَدْ خَرَجْتُ ۞ مِنْ نِكَاحٍ لِي إِلَهِي صَانَا
verses.en: So I am the choice of the choice; I came forth through lawful marriage, which my God kept pure for me.

verses.ar: طَهَّرَهُ اللّٰهُ حَمَاهُ اخْتَارَهُ ۞ وَمَا بَرَا كَمِثْلِهِ إِنْسَانَا
verses.en: Allāh purified him, protected him, chose him; and He never created a human being like him.

verses.ar: وَبِحُبِّهِ وَبِذِكْرِهِ وَالنَّصْرِ وَالتَّوْقِيرِ ۞ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ قَدْ أَوْصَانَا
verses.en: To love him, to mention him, to give him victory and to honour him — the Lord of the Throne has enjoined all this upon us.

verses.ar: يَا رَبَّنَا صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ دَائِمًا ۞ عَلٰى حَبِيبِكَ مَنْ إِلَيْكَ دَعَانَا
verses.en: Our Lord, send Your mercy and peace perpetually upon Your beloved, the one who called us to You.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ
verses.en: O Allāh, send Your mercy, peace and blessings upon him and upon his family.

verses.ar: هٰذَا وَقَدْ نَشَرَ الْإِلَهُ نُعُوتَهُ ۞ فِي الْكُتْبِ بَيَّنَهَا لَنَا تِبْيَانَا
verses.en: And the Divine has spread his qualities abroad in the revealed books, setting them out for us plainly.

verses.ar: أَخَذَ مِيثَاقَ النَّبِيِّينَ لَمَا ۞ آتَيْتُكُمْ مِنْ حِكْمَةٍ إِحْسَانَا
verses.en: He took the covenant of the prophets: for all the wisdom and goodness I have given you —

verses.ar: وَجَاءَكُمْ رَسُولُنَا لَتُؤْمِنُنَّ ۞ وَتَنْصُرُونَ وَتُصْبِحُونَ أَعْوَانَا
verses.en: if Our Messenger comes to you, you shall surely believe in him, give him victory, and become his helpers.

verses.ar: قَدْ بَشَّرُوا أَقْوَامَهُمْ بِالْمُصْطَفَى ۞ أَعْظِمْ بِذٰلِكَ رُتْبَةً وَمَكَانَا
verses.en: They gave their peoples the good news of the Chosen One. How great a rank and a standing that is!

verses.ar: فَهْوَ وَإِنْ جَاءَ الْأَخِيرَ مُقَدَّمٌ ۞ يَمْشُونَ تَحْتَ لِوَاءِ مَنْ نَادَانَا
verses.en: Though he came last, he is given precedence; they will walk beneath the banner of the one who called us.

verses.ar: يَا أُمَّةَ الْإِسْلَامِ أَوَّلُ شَافِعٍ ۞ وَمُشَفَّعٍ أَنَا قَطُّ لَا أَتَوَانَى
verses.en: O community of Islam: the first to intercede, and the first whose intercession is accepted, is I — and I shall not hold back.

verses.ar: حَتَّى أُنَادَى ارْفَعْ وَسَلْ تُعْطَ وَقُلْ ۞ يُسْمَعْ لِقَوْلِكَ نَجْمُ فَخْرِكَ بَانَا
verses.en: Until I am called: rise, and ask and you shall be given, and speak and your word shall be heard — the star of your glory has risen.

verses.ar: وَلِوَاءُ حَمْدِ اللّٰهِ جَلَّ بِيَدِي ۞ وَلَأَوَّلًا آتِي أَنَا الْجِنَانَا
verses.en: The banner of the praise of Allāh Most High is in my hand, and I shall be the first to enter the gardens.

verses.ar: وَأَكْرَمُ الْخَلْقِ عَلٰى اللّٰهِ أَنَا ۞ فَلَقَدْ حَبَاكَ اللّٰهُ مِنْهُ حَنَانَا
verses.en: And I am the most honoured of creation with Allāh. Indeed Allāh has bestowed upon you tenderness from Himself.

verses.ar: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ فَتَرْضَى جَلَّ مَنْ ۞ مُعْطٍ تَقَاصَرَ عَنْ عَطَاهُ نُهَانَا
verses.en: And He shall give you until you are well pleased. Exalted is such a Giver, whose giving our minds fall short of grasping.

verses.ar: بِاللّٰهِ كَرِّرْ ذِكْرَ وَصْفِ مُحَمَّدٍ ۞ كَيْمَا تُزِيحَ عَنِ الْقُلُوبِ الرَّانَا
verses.en: By Allāh, repeat the mention of Muḥammad’s qualities again and again, that it may lift the rust from the hearts.

verses.ar: يَا رَبَّنَا صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ دَائِمًا ۞ عَلٰى حَبِيبِكَ مَنْ إِلَيْكَ دَعَانَا
verses.en: Our Lord, send Your mercy and peace perpetually upon Your beloved, the one who called us to You.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ
verses.en: O Allāh, send Your mercy, peace and blessings upon him and upon his family.

verses.ar: لَمَّا دَنَا وَقْتُ الْبُرُوزِ لِأَحْمَدَ ۞ عَنْ إِذْنِ مَنْ مَا شَاءَهُ قَدْ كَانَا
verses.en: When the time drew near for Aḥmad to come forth, by the leave of the One whose will is always done —

verses.ar: حَمَلَتْ بِهِ الْأُمُّ الْأَمِينَةُ بِنْتُ وَهْبٍ ۞ مَنْ لَهَا أَعْلَى الْإِلَهُ مَكَانَا
verses.en: the trustworthy mother, the daughter of Wahb, conceived him — she whose station the Divine raised high.

verses.ar: مِنْ وَالِدِ الْمُخْتَارِ عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ بْنِ ۞ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ رَأَى الْبُرْهَانَا
verses.en: By the father of the Chosen One, ʿAbd Allāh son of ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib, who saw the manifest proof.

verses.ar: قَدْ كَانَ يَغْمُرُ نُورُ طٰهٰ وَجْهَهُ ۞ وَسَرَى إِلَى الِابْنِ الْمَصُونِ عِيَانَا
verses.en: The light of Ṭā-Hā would flood his face, and passed to the protected son for all to see.

verses.ar: وَهْوَ ابْنُ هَاشِمٍ الْكَرِيمِ الشَّهْمِ بْنِ ۞ عَبْدِ مَنَافٍ ابْنِ قُصَيٍّ كَانَا
verses.en: And he was the son of Hāshim the generous and noble, son of ʿAbd Manāf, son of Quṣayy.

verses.ar: وَالِدُهُ يُدْعَى حَكِيمًا شَأْنُهُ ۞ قَدِ اعْتَلَى أَعْزِزْ بِذٰلِكَ شَانَا
verses.en: His father was called Ḥakīm — “the wise”; his standing was raised high. How mighty a standing that is!

verses.ar: وَاحْفَظْ أُصُولَ الْمُصْطَفَى حَتَّى تَرَى ۞ فِي سِلْسِلَاتِ أُصُولِهِ عَدْنَانَا
verses.en: And commit the lineage of the Chosen One to memory, until you reach ʿAdnān in the chain of his forefathers.

verses.ar: فَهُنَاكَ قِفْ وَاعْلَمْ بِرَفْعِهِ إِلَى ۞ إِسْمَاعِيلَ كَانَ لِلْأَبِ مِعْوَانَا
verses.en: There, stop — and know that it is traced back to Ismāʿīl, who was a helper to his father.

verses.ar: وَحِينَمَا حَمَلَتْ بِهِ آمِنَةٌ ۞ لَمْ تَشْكُ شَيْئًا يَأْخُذُ النِّسْوَانَا
verses.en: And when Āmina was carrying him, she complained of nothing of what befalls women with child.

verses.ar: وَبِهَا أَحَاطَ اللُّطْفُ مِنْ رَبِّ السَّمَا ۞ أَقْصَى الْأَذَى وَالْهَمَّ وَالأَحْزَانَا
verses.en: The gentleness of the Lord of the heavens encompassed her, and kept far from her all harm, worry and sorrow.

verses.ar: وَرَأَتْ كَمَا قَدْ جَاءَ مَا عُلِّمَتْ بِهِ ۞ أَنَّ الْمُهَيْمِنَ شَرَّفَ الْأَكْوَانَا
verses.en: And she saw, as has been related, what she was given to know: that the Guardian had ennobled all the worlds —

verses.ar: بِالطُّهْرِ مَنْ فِي بَطْنِهَا فَاسْتَبْشَرَتْ ۞ وَدَنَا الْمَخَاضُ فَأُتْرِعَتْ رِضْوَانَا
verses.en: through the pure one within her. So she rejoiced; the labour drew near, and she was filled to the brim with contentment.

verses.ar:
سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَاللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ (٤ مرات)
وَتَمَامُ الرَّابِعَةِ: وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ فِي كُلِّ لَحْظَةٍ أَبَدًا عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
verses.en: Glory be to Allāh, and praise be to Allāh, and there is no god but Allāh, and Allāh is greatest (four times); completing the fourth: and there is no power and no strength save by Allāh, the Most High, the Magnificent — in every instant, for ever, as many as His creation, as pleases Him, as weighs His Throne, and as the ink of His words.
verses.note: Recited here, at the foot of the page in the book · تُقَالُ هُنَا

verses.ar: وَتَجَلَّتِ الْأَنْوَارُ مِنْ كُلِّ الْجِهَاتِ ۞ فَوَقْتُ مِيلَادِ الْمُشَفَّعِ حَانَا
verses.en: And the lights shone out from every direction, for the hour of the accepted intercessor’s birth had come.

verses.ar: وَقُبَيْلَ فَجْرٍ أَبْرَزَتْ شَمْسُ الْهُدَى ۞ ظَهَرَ الْحَبِيبُ مُكَرَّمًا وَمُصَانَا
verses.en: And a little before dawn the sun of guidance came forth: the Beloved appeared, honoured and protected.

DIYA_CHAPTERS.note: The gathering stands here · مَحَلُّ الْقِيَامِ

verses.ar: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمْ
verses.en: The blessings of Allāh be upon Muḥammad; the blessings of Allāh and His peace be upon him.

verses.ar: يَا نَبِي سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ ۞ يَا رَسُولْ سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ
verses.en: O Prophet, peace be upon you. O Messenger, peace be upon you.

verses.ar: يَا حَبِيبْ سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ ۞ صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكَ
verses.en: O Beloved, peace be upon you. The blessings of Allāh be upon you.

verses.ar: أَبْرَزَ اللّٰهُ الْمُشَفَّعْ ۞ صَاحِبَ الْقَدْرِ الْمُرَفَّعْ
verses.en: Allāh has brought forth the accepted intercessor, the possessor of the exalted rank.

verses.ar: فَمَلَا النُّورُ النَّوَاحِي ۞ عَمَّ كُلَّ الْكَوْنِ أَجْمَعْ
verses.en: And the light filled every quarter; it took in the whole of creation entire.

verses.ar: نُكِّسَتْ أَصْنَامُ شِرْكٍ ۞ وَبِنَا الشِّرْكِ تَصَدَّعْ
verses.en: The idols of idolatry were thrown down, and the edifice of idolatry cracked apart.

verses.ar: وَدَنَا وَقْتُ الْهِدَايَةْ ۞ وَحِمَى الْكُفْرِ تَزَعْزَعْ
verses.en: The hour of guidance drew near, and the stronghold of disbelief was shaken.

verses.ar: مَرْحَبًا أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا ۞ بِكَ يَا ذَا الْقَدْرِ الْأَرْفَعْ
verses.en: Welcome, and welcome again, to you, O possessor of the loftiest rank.

verses.ar: يَا إِمَامَ أَهْلِ الرِّسَالَةْ ۞ مَنْ بِهِ الْآفَاتُ تُدْفَعْ
verses.en: O leader of the people of the message, through whom afflictions are driven away.

verses.ar: أَنْتَ فِي الْحَشْرِ مَلَاذٌ ۞ لَكَ كُلُّ الْخَلْقِ تَفْزَعْ
verses.en: On the day of gathering you are the refuge; to you all creation will flee.

verses.ar: وَيُنَادُونَ تَرَى مَا ۞ قَدْ دَهَا مِنْ هَوْلٍ أَفْظَعْ
verses.en: And they will call out: do you see what has come upon us, of terror most dreadful?

verses.ar: مَرْحَبًا مَرْحَبًا جَدَّ الْحُسَيْنِ ۞ مَرْحَبًا مَرْحَبًا يَا نُورَ عَيْنِي
verses.en: Welcome, welcome, O grandfather of Ḥusayn. Welcome, welcome, O light of my eye.

verses.ar: فَلَهَا أَنْتَ فَتَسْجُدْ ۞ وَتُنَادَى اشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ
verses.en: For it you are the one; you will prostrate, and be called: intercede, and your intercession is accepted.

verses.ar: فَعَلَيْكَ اللّٰهُ صَلَّى ۞ مَا بَدَا النُّورُ وَشَعْشَعْ
verses.en: So may Allāh send His mercy upon you, for as long as light appears and spreads its rays.

verses.ar: وَبِكَ الرَّحْمٰنَ نَسْأَلْ ۞ وَإِلَهُ الْعَرْشِ يَسْمَعْ
verses.en: And through you we ask the All-Merciful, and the Lord of the Throne hears.

verses.ar: رَبِّ فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي يَا اللّٰهْ ۞ بِبَرَكَةِ الْهَادِي الْمُشَفَّعْ يَا اللّٰهْ
verses.en: My Lord, forgive me my sins — O Allāh — by the blessing of the guide whose intercession is accepted — O Allāh.

verses.ar: يَا عَظِيمَ الْمَنِّ يَا رَبّ ۞ شَمِّلَنَا بِالْمُصْطَفَى اجْمَعْ
verses.en: O You of immense bounty, O Lord, gather us all together with the Chosen One.

verses.ar: وَبِهِ فَانْظُرْ إِلَيْنَا ۞ وَاعْطِنَا بِهِ كُلَّ مَطْمَعْ
verses.en: And for his sake look upon us, and through him grant us all that we hope for.

verses.ar: وَاكْفِنَا كُلَّ الْبَلَايَا ۞ وَادْفَعِ الْآفَاتِ وَارْفَعْ
verses.en: And spare us every trial, and drive off the afflictions and lift them away.

verses.ar: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمْ
verses.en: The blessings of Allāh be upon Muḥammad; the blessings of Allāh and His peace be upon him.

verses.ar: وَاسْقِنَا يَا رَبِّ أَغِثْنَا ۞ بِحَيًا هَطَّالٍ يَهْمَعْ
verses.en: And give us to drink, O Lord; come to our aid with a life-giving rain that pours down.

verses.ar: وَاخْتِمِ الْعُمْرَ بِحُسْنَى ۞ وَأَحْسِنِ الْعُقْبَى وَمَرْجَعْ
verses.en: And seal our lives with what is best, and make beautiful the outcome and the return.

verses.ar: وَصَلَاةُ اللّٰهِ تَغْشَى ۞ مَنْ لَهُ الْحُسْنُ تَجَمَّعْ
verses.en: And may the blessings of Allāh enfold the one in whom all beauty was gathered.

verses.ar: أَحْمَدَ الطُّهْرَ وَآلَهْ ۞ وَالصَّحَابَةْ مَا السَّنَا شَعْ
verses.en: Aḥmad the pure, and his family, and the companions — for as long as light shines out.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ
verses.en: O Allāh, send Your mercy, peace and blessings upon him and upon his family.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَشَرْتُ لِنَعْتِ مَنْ أَوْصَافُهُ ۞ تُحْيِي الْقُلُوبَ تُهَيِّجُ الْأَشْجَانَا
verses.en: I have pointed towards the description of one whose qualities give life to hearts and stir up longing.

verses.ar: وَاللّٰهُ قَدْ أَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ فَمَا يُسَا ۞ وِي الْقَوْلُ مِنَّا أَوْ يَكُونُ ثَنَانَا
verses.en: And Allāh Himself has praised him — so what is any word of ours worth, or what is our praise?

verses.ar: لٰكِنْ حُبًّا فِي السَّرَائِرِ قَدْ دَعَا ۞ لِمَدِيحِ صَفْوَةِ رَبِّنَا وَحَدَانَا
verses.en: Yet a love settled deep within called us, alone, to the praise of the purest of our Lord’s creation.

verses.ar: وَإِذِ امْتَزَجْنَا بِالْمَوَدَّةِ هَهُنَا ۞ نَرْفَعُ أَيْدِي فَقْرِنَا وَرَجَانَا
verses.en: And now that we are mingled here with that affection, we raise the hands of our poverty and our hope —

verses.ar: لِلْوَاحِدِ الْأَحَدِ الْعَلِيِّ إِلَهِنَا ۞ مُتَوَسِّلِينَ بِمَنْ إِلَيْهِ دَعَانَا
verses.en: to the One, the Unique, the Most High, our God, seeking a means through the one who called us to Him:

verses.ar: مُخْتَارِهِ وَحَبِيبِهِ وَصَفِيِّهِ ۞ زَيْنِ الْوُجُودِ بِهِ الْإِلَهُ حَبَانَا
verses.en: His chosen one, His beloved, His pure friend, the adornment of existence — through him the Divine favoured us.

verses.ar: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا رَبَّنَا يَا رَبَّنَا ۞ بِالْمُصْطَفَى اقْبَلْنَا أَجِبْ دَعْوَانَا
verses.en: Our Lord, our Lord, our Lord — by the Chosen One, accept us and answer our call.

verses.ar: أَنْتَ لَنَا أَنْتَ لَنَا يَا ذُخْرَنَا ۞ فِي هٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي أُخْرَانَا
verses.en: You are ours, You are ours, O our treasure, in this world of ours and in the next.

verses.ar: أَصْلِحْ لَنَا الْأَحْوَالَ وَاغْفِرْ ذَنْبَنَا ۞ وَلَا تُؤَاخِذْ رَبِّ إِنْ أَخْطَانَا
verses.en: Set our states right and forgive us our sin, and do not take us to task, my Lord, if we have erred.

verses.ar: وَاسْلُكْ بِنَا فِي نَهْجِ طٰهٰ الْمُصْطَفَى ۞ ثَبِّتْ عَلٰى قَدَمِ الْحَبِيبِ خُطَانَا
verses.en: And take us along the path of Ṭā-Hā the Chosen One; make our steps firm in the footprints of the Beloved.

verses.ar: أَرِنَا بِفَضْلٍ مِنْكَ طَلْعَةَ أَحْمَدَ ۞ فِي بَهْجَةٍ عَيْنُ الرِّضَا تَرْعَانَا
verses.en: By a grace from You, show us the countenance of Aḥmad in splendour, while the eye of Your good pleasure watches over us.

verses.ar: وَارْبِطْ بِهِ فِي كُلِّ حَالٍ حَبْلَنَا ۞ وَحِبَالَ مَنْ وَدَّ وَمَنْ وَالَانَا
verses.en: And bind our rope to him in every state, and the ropes of all who love us and stand by us,

verses.ar: وَالْمُحْسِنِينَ وَمَنْ أَجَابَ نِدَاءَنَا ۞ وَذَوِي الْحُقُوقِ وَطَالِبًا أَوْصَانَا
verses.en: and those who do good, and those who answered our call, and those who have rights over us, and whoever asked us to pray for them,

verses.ar: وَالْحَاضِرِينَ وَسَاعِيًا فِي جَمْعِنَا ۞ هَا نَحْنُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ أَنْتَ تَرَانَا
verses.en: and those present, and whoever worked to bring us together. Here we are before You — You see us.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ رَجَوْنَاكَ فَحَقِّقْ سُؤْلَنَا ۞ وَاسْمَعْ بِفَضْلِكَ يَا سَمِيعُ دُعَانَا
verses.en: We have set our hope in You, so fulfil what we ask, and by Your grace hear our supplication, O All-Hearing.

verses.ar: وَانْصُرْ بِنَا سُنَّةَ طٰهٰ فِي بِقَاعِ ۞ الْأَرْضِ وَاقْمَعْ كُلَّ مَنْ عَادَانَا
verses.en: And through us give victory to the sunna of Ṭā-Hā in every region of the earth, and restrain all who show us enmity.

verses.ar: وَانْظُرْ إِلَيْنَا وَاسْقِنَا كَأْسَ الْهَنَا ۞ وَاشْفِ وَعَافِ عَاجِلًا مَرْضَانَا
verses.en: And look upon us, and give us to drink from the cup of felicity, and swiftly cure and restore our sick.

verses.ar: وَاقْضِ لَنَا الْحَاجَاتِ وَأَحْسِنْ خَتْمَنَا ۞ عِنْدَ الْمَمَاتِ وَأَصْلِحَنْ عُقْبَانَا
verses.en: And settle our needs for us, and make our ending beautiful at the time of death, and set our outcome right.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ وَاجْمَعْنَا وَأَحْبَابًا لَنَا ۞ فِي دَارِكَ الْفِرْدَوْسِ يَا رَجْوَانَا
verses.en: O Lord, gather us and those we love in Your abode of Firdaws, O our hope.

verses.ar: بِالْمُصْطَفَى صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ ۞ مَا حَرَّكَتْ رِيحُ الصَّبَا أَغْصَانَا
verses.en: By the Chosen One — send Your mercy upon him and upon his family, for as long as the east wind stirs the branches.

verses.ar: ﴿سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ ۞ وَسَلَامٌ عَلٰى الْمُرْسَلِينَ ۞ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ﴾
verses.en: Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe. And peace be upon the messengers. And praise be to Allāh, Lord of the worlds. (al-Ṣāffāt 37:180–182)

verses.ar: أَبْتَدِئُ الْإِمْلَاءَ بِاسْمِ الذَّاتِ الْعَلِيَّةْ ۞ مُسْتَدِرًّا فَيْضَ الْبَرَكَاتِ عَلٰى مَا أَنَالَهُ وَأَوْلَاهْ ۞ وَأُثَنِّي بِحَمْدٍ مَوَارِدُهُ سَائِغَةٌ هَنِيَّةْ ۞ مُمْتَطِيًا مِنَ الشُّكْرِ الْجَمِيلِ مَطَايَاهْ ۞ وَأُصَلِّي وَأُسَلِّمُ عَلٰى النُّورِ الْمَوْصُوفِ بِالتَّقَدُّمِ وَالْأَوَّلِيَّةْ ۞ الْمُنْتَقِلِ فِي الْغُرَرِ الْكَرِيمَةِ وَالْجِبَاهْ ۞ وَأَسْتَمْنِحُ اللّٰهَ تَعَالَى رِضْوَانًا يَخُصُّ الْعِتْرَةَ الطَّاهِرَةَ النَّبَوِيَّةْ ۞ وَيَعُمُّ الصَّحَابَةَ وَالْأَتْبَاعَ وَمَنْ وَالَاهْ ۞ وَأَسْتَجْدِيهِ هِدَايَةً لِسُلُوكِ السُّبُلِ الْوَاضِحَةِ الْجَلِيَّةْ ۞ وَحِفْظًا مِنَ الْغَوَايَةِ فِي خِطَطِ الْخَطَإِ وَخُطَاهْ ۞ وَأَنْشُرُ مِنْ قِصَّةِ الْمَوْلِدِ النَّبَوِيِّ الشَّرِيفِ بُرُودًا حِسَانًا عَبْقَرِيَّةْ ۞ نَاظِمًا مِنَ النَّسَبِ الشَّرِيفِ عِقْدًا تُحَلَّى الْمَسَامِعُ بِحُلَاهْ ۞ وَأَسْتَعِينُ بِحَوْلِ اللّٰهِ تَعَالَى وَقُوَّتِهِ الْقَوِيَّةْ ۞ فَإِنَّهُ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللّٰهْ
verses.tr: Abtadi'u l-imlā'a bi-smi dh-dhāti l-ʿaliyyah, mustadirran fayḍa l-barakāti ʿalā mā anālahu wa awlāh, wa uthannī bi-ḥamdin mawāriduhu sā'ighatun haniyyah, mumtaṭīyan mina sh-shukri l-jamīli maṭāyāh, wa uṣallī wa usallimu ʿalā n-nūri l-mawṣūfi bi-t-taqaddumi wa l-awwaliyyah, al-muntaqili fi l-ghurari l-karīmati wa l-jibāh, wa astamniḥu Llāha taʿālā riḍwānan yakhuṣṣu l-ʿitrata ṭ-ṭāhirata n-nabawiyyah, wa yaʿummu ṣ-ṣaḥābata wa l-atbāʿa wa man wālāh, wa astajdīhi hidāyatan li-sulūki s-subuli l-waḍiḥati l-jaliyyah, wa ḥifẓan mina l-ghawāyati fī khiṭaṭi l-khaṭa'i wa khuṭāh, wa anshuru min qiṣṣati l-mawlidi n-nabawiyyi sh-sharīfi burūdan ḥisānan ʿabqariyyah, nāẓiman mina n-nasabi sh-sharīfi ʿiqdan tuḥalla l-masāmiʿu bi-ḥulāh, wa astaʿīnu bi-ḥawli Llāhi taʿālā wa quwwatihi l-qawiyyah, fa-innahu lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā bi-Llāh.
verses.en: I commence [this] composition in the Name of the Supreme Being, seeking the outpouring of abundant blessings upon whatever He may enable it to achieve and bring about. Next, I extol [Him] and offer thanks whose sources are pure and refreshing, while mounted on the steed of comely thankfulness. Blessings and peace I invoke upon the Light described as first and foremost, passed on in features and upon brows most noble. I ask Allah Most High to bestow especial good pleasure upon the pure Prophetic family, embracing also his Companions, Followers, and all that truly follow them. I ask Allah for guidance in travelling by pathways clear and radiant; and for protection from straying into or approaching the tracts of error. I shall unfold, from the story of the Prophet's nativity, garments fair and vivid, assembling from [his] noble lineage a necklace whose beauty regales the listener. And I seek help from the strength and power of Allah Most Mighty; for truly there is no power or strength but through Allah.

verses.ar:
عَطِّرِ اللّٰهُمَّ قَبْرَهُ الْكَرِيمَ بِعَرْفٍ شَذِيٍّ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَتَسْلِيمٍ
اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr:
ʿAṭṭiri Llāhumma qabrahu l-karīma bi-ʿarfin shadhiyyin min ṣalātin wa taslīmin
Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi.
verses.en:
Perfume, O Allah, his noble tomb with a fragrant scent of blessing and salutation.
(O Allah, exalt him, preserve him and bless him.)

BARZANJI_CHAPTERS.note: The gathering stands here · مَحَلُّ الْقِيَامِ

LITANY_CHAPTERS.note: Al-Wird al-Sharīf known as Ḥizb al-Ghāyāt — the litany of ultimate ends, for declaring the oneness of Allah, who fulfils all needs. Attributed to Mawlānā Jalāl ad-Dīn Muḥammad al-Balkhī ar-Rūmī (604–672 AH / 1207–1273 CE).

verses.ar: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
verses.tr: Bismi-Llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm
verses.en: In the name of Allah, the All-Merciful, the Most Merciful.

verses.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۞ وَالصَّلٰوةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلٰى رَسُولِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى اٰلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ اَجْمَعِينَ
verses.tr: Al-ḥamdu li-Llāhi Rabbi l-ʿālamīn · Wa-ṣ-ṣalātu wa-s-salāmu ʿalā Rasūlinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi ajmaʿīn
verses.en: Praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. Blessings and peace be upon our Messenger Muhammad, and upon his family and his companions, all of them.

verses.ar: لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللّٰهِ ۞ اَللّٰهُمَّ يَآ اِلٰهِى ۞ اَنَا الْعَبْدُ وَاَنْتَ اللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Lā ilāha illā-Llāh, Muḥammadun Rasūlu-Llāh · Allāhumma yā Ilāhī · Anā l-ʿabdu wa-Anta-Llāh
verses.en: There is no god but Allah; Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, O my God. I am the servant, and You are Allah.

verses.ar: وَاَنَا الْمُوَحِّدُ وَاَنْتَ الْوَاحِدُ
verses.tr: Wa-anā l-muwaḥḥidu wa-Anta l-Wāḥid
verses.en: I am the one who affirms Your oneness, and You are the One.

verses.ar: وَاَنَا الْعُبَيْدُ وَاَنْتَ الْمَعْبُودُ
verses.tr: Wa-anā l-ʿubaydu wa-Anta l-Maʿbūd
verses.en: I am the lowly little servant, and You are the One worshipped.

verses.ar: وَاَنَا مُمْكِنُ الْوُجُودِ وَاَنْتَ وَاجِبُ الْوُجُودِ
verses.tr: Wa-anā mumkinu l-wujūdi wa-Anta wājibu l-wujūd
verses.en: I am contingent in being, and You are necessary in being.

verses.ar: وَاَنَا الْمَخْلُوقُ وَاَنْتَ الْخَالِقُ
verses.tr: Wa-anā l-makhlūqu wa-Anta l-Khāliq
verses.en: I am the created, and You are the Creator.

verses.ar: وَاَنَا الْمَوْجُودُ وَاَنْتَ الْمُوجِدُ
verses.tr: Wa-anā l-mawjūdu wa-Anta l-Mūjid
verses.en: I am the one brought into being, and You are the One who brings into being.

verses.ar: وَاَنَا الْمُحْدَثُ وَاَنْتَ الْمُحْدِثُ الْاَزَلِىُّ
verses.tr: Wa-anā l-muḥdathu wa-Anta l-Muḥdithu l-Azalī
verses.en: I am the newly originated, and You are the Originator, the Beginningless.

verses.ar: وَاَنَا الْهَالِكُ وَاَنْتَ الْبَاقِى بِلَا زَوَالٍ
verses.tr: Wa-anā l-hāliku wa-Anta l-Bāqī bi-lā zawāl
verses.en: I am the one who perishes, and You are the Abiding, without ceasing.

verses.ar: وَاَنَا الْفَانِى وَاَنْتَ الدَّآئِمُ الْبَاقِى
verses.tr: Wa-anā l-fānī wa-Anta d-Dāʾimu l-Bāqī
verses.en: I am the one who passes away, and You are the Everlasting, the Abiding.
